Visual acuity, speech and hearing; hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to drive an automobile and operate computer keyboard and basic office equipment; subject to carrying, lifting, twisting and reaching to perform essential job functions. Working conditions are primarily in an office environment with occasional travel to other locations.

Education: Bachelor's Degree in related field or equivalent experience required.

Experience: Significant demonstrable experience in business-to-business marketing or work in a community-based organization.

Minimum of 2 years' customer service experience and two years' experience in training and public speaking for a diverse audience required. Ability to create or modify training material and develop practical application exercise related to required training material strongly preferred. Working knowledge of Workforce Service programs required. Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as proficient computer skills. Workforce Service experience or demonstrated ability to serve diverse populations required. Prefer working knowledge of all applicable local Workforce Service programs. Familiarity with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations preferred.

Skills/Abilities:

Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment with proven competency in handling stressful situations required. Ability to clearly and concisely communicate with staff and leadership via presentations, in person, telephone, written and oral. Excellent verbal and written communication skills including ability to do public speaking and conduct training sessions. Bilingual (Spanish/English) required. The ability to maintain confidentiality is a must.

Demonstrated ability to use various software programs (Microsoft Office) for correspondence, reports, statistical compilation, analysis and data base access.

Must be accustomed to working in a complex, fast-paced and confidential work environment. Ability to follow complex instructions, prioritize tasks, and effectively utilize resources to complete projects in a timely and accurate manner. Superior attention to detail is a must.

Additional Requirements: Must have valid driver's license and adequate vehicle insurance coverage.

jobs.description:
TRAINING

The Sales Trainee (ST) is a training role.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

Once an ASM or another qualified role is available, the certified ST must interview for that available role.

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

The ST role is an at-will position, meaning that the Company or ST can terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any reason or no reason at all, with or without cause.

Train with ASMs

Global Strategy for In-Store Execution measured by Winning vs Competition (WVC) & Perfect Store Audit (PSA).

Support the team with audits, blitz, building of displays, merchandising to effectively drive the sales business.

jobs.title: HSE Supervisor
jobs.description:
About the Role:

This HSE Supervisor is part of the Environment Health and Safety function. They are responsible for organizational programs and procedures to safeguard employees and surrounding communities. We are looking for a HSE Supervisor to join and strengthen our PJM site-level team. This role will support the management of EHS (Health, Safety and Environmental) programs relative to a major international Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical account in West Point, Pennsylvania.

This is a hands-on, site-based HSE role suited to someone from a construction background, ideally with experience supporting manufacturing sites in highly regulated environments.

This is an outstanding opportunity to grow your career in EHS and work in a proactive team environment.

This is a full time onsite role in West Point, PA. What You’ll Do:

• Assist in managing HSE programs and initiatives to meet regulatory requirements and client needs.
• Promotes visible leadership and a strong culture of safety, health, and wellbeing across the PJM team, contractors, suppliers, and subcontractors.
• Work closely with the site PJM team to ensure site-specific contractor plans, project safety requirements, and the appropriate hierarchy of controls are embedded into project execution.
• Assists the project management team with contractor safety oversight to ensure compliance with all client requirements and applicable regulations. Focuses on the development of JSAs/JHAs, preparation of required project documentation, hazard identification, and review of high-risk permit activities, including fall protection, LOTO, excavations, line breaking, and crane and rigging operations.
• Support contractor pre-qualification, onboarding, planning, and ongoing performance monitoring from an HSE perspective.
• Support contractor compliance to policy and safety requirements through daily field audits of active jobsites.
• Assists in leading EHS programs and initiatives to meet regulatory requirements and the specific needs of the client account.
• Support accident, incident, near-miss reporting, recording, and investigation in line with company and client procedures.
• Coach and support the PJM team and other stakeholders in the use of HSE tools, processes, and techniques, ensuring they understand and fulfil their HSE responsibilities.

What You’ll Need:

• High School Diploma or GED with 5+ years of job-related experience.
• Experience in construction safety is a plus
• Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Certified Hazardous Material Manager (CHMM), Occupational Health and Safety Technician (OHST), Construction Health & Safety Technician (CHST) are nice to have but not required.
• Working knowledge of federal, state and local health and safety, and environmental regulations is essential. Direct experience dealing with contractor management, regulatory agencies and/or compliance officers is preferred.
• A demonstrated passion for HSE and an ability to role model the expected behaviors.
• Experience working in manufacturing, construction, or facility maintenance needed.
• Must have experience in management of contractors, oversight of permitting related to high-risk work and fall protection plans, policies & safety procedures.
• Must have proficiency in conducting audits, inspections, and incident investigations.
• Experienced knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
• Good oral and written communication skills
• Client-focused approach.

SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

The scope of this position is to supervise all aspects of the freight payment process for Sika Corporation. jobs.title: Manager, Facilities Engineering
jobs.description:
NBCUniversal is looking for a Manager of Facilities Engineering! In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing a team of Engineers and support staff on the efficient operation, maintenance and repair of building envelopes, systems, equipment, infrastructure and grounds for both low and high rise buildings. You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, coordinate all maintenance activities, manage vendor relationships, and collaborate with contractors to ensure the facility operates efficiently, remains safe and is compliant with all regulations.

What You’ll Do:

• Oversee chiller plants and other critical infrastructure supporting the sites, data centers, and critical spaces
• Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, including critical infrastructure, to ensure continuous, efficient, and safe operations
• Manage all MEP and critical infrastructure preventative maintenance programs. Including creating and maintaining an annual service calendar
• Maintain accurate records of maintenance activity, equipment performance, repair history, and costs in the CMMS
• Coordinate and oversee annual LAFD REG4 testing
• Monitor N4 building automation systems (BAS) to optimize energy use, systems performance, and maintain comfortable environments for employees and guests. Provide updates to management and Central Monitoring teams on alarms and impacts on operations
• Develop weekly workplans and assign preventative, corrective and reactive maintenance work orders assigned through the CMMS and mobile platform with the assistance of the planner / scheduler
• Work closely with the Critical Infrastructure System team on the ArcGIS platform, projects and emergency response strategies
• Assist the Asset Management team developing and driving EAM processes and ensuring assets are tagged and data is accurate in the Master Asset List
• Participate in the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOP) and key performance indicators (KPI’s) with Facility Operations and the Asset Management team
• Manage vendor and 3rd party contracted services to ensure scope of work is completed as required. Includes having all documents and costs added to the asset in the CMMS
• Partner with NBCU departments to ensure compliance and safety tasks are addressed promptly (AQMD, OSHA, ADA and other regulatory requirements)
• Support emergency preparedness initiatives and attend drills and exercises related to fire, disaster response, and business continuity
• Work closely with the Director of Facilities and Facility Managers on capital project planning, annual operating budgets, including attending bid walks and assisting with project oversite when required
• Support of multiple sites and assign tasks to Engineering teams as required within the Los Angeles area
• Maintain OSHA 30-hour certification
• Other duties as assigned

Let’s Talk About You:

• Cool Under Pressure – You handle stressful situations with ease and professionalism while juggling multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
• Facilities Guru- You have extensive experience leading complex facility operations and engineering solutions. You are a pro at managing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems, along with general maintenance of grounds, facilities and otherwise
• Analytical expert- Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills
• Project Wrangler – expertise in seeing opportunities for improvement, gaining support, breaking down to bite-sized chunks, executing and seeking feedback will give you a superpower to strategically partner with clients and change workflow as opportunities arise
• Juggler – You know how to manage multiple tasks and priorities and move them all along effectively while keeping stakeholders updating and informed
• Executer – You get things done! Using strong business acumen, inciteful analytical skills, and superior organizational skills, troubleshooting skills, and diagnostic skills to manage through competing priorities within a matrixed environment
• Self-starter – You are motivated, can work with minimal guidance, and can identify helpful resources to get the job done

What You Have:

• High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
• 10+ years of experience in building engineering, facilities operations, critical infrastructure, or a related field.
• Working knowledge of Class A commercial building operations and applicable fire/life safety testing requirements, including Los Angeles REG 4 where relevant.
• Demonstrated proficiency with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building automation systems (BAS), including the ability to troubleshoot and coordinate repairs.
• Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and energy efficiency practices.
• Valid state Class C Driver’s License

What Will Make You Stand Out:

• OSHA 30-Hour General Industry certification, or ability to obtain/maintain certification within a company-designated timeframe.
• Associates degree or technical certification in building systems
• EPA Universal Certification for refrigerants
• Tridium N4 knowledge
• Relevant trade license HVAC, electrical, plumbing, low voltage

Additional Requirements:

• Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.
• Ability to work flexible hours and travel as needed

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. jobs.title: Associate Materials Scientist
jobs.description:
The Associate Scientist provides laboratory support in synthesizing salt forms and polymorphs of drug candidates and evaluates these forms for acceptability as drug substances with respect to chemical manufacturing and formulation into pharmaceutical products.  The successful candidate will engage in solid form characterization and in particle characterization.  The position is based in Groton, CT (USA).

Role Responsibilities:

• Conduct solid state characterization (e.g., X-ray powder diffraction, thermal analysis, moisture sorption, microscopy, spectroscopy) of small molecules of pharmaceutical relevance.
• Support multidisciplinary project teams and collaborate with colleagues to define and implement crystallization, polymorph, salt, and co-crystal screening activities according to project timelines.
• Support multidisciplinary project teams and collaborate with colleagues to define and implement API particle characterization activities according to project timelines.
• Conduct physical and surface characterization of powders of pharmaceutical relevance. This includes particle characterization (e.g., particle size, shape) and surface characterization (e.g., surface energy, surface roughness).
• Collaborate with colleagues in Medicinal Chemistry, Formulation and Biopharmaceutics to define and implement screening and characterization strategies consistent with solid form selection for clinical studies.
• Solve scientific problems using contemporary Materials Science experimental techniques.
• Contribute to the development of new scientific approaches and knowledge within the Materials Science organization.
• Ensure contemporaneous and accurate entries are made in the electronic laboratory notebook system according to accepted good practice.

• Bachelor’s Degree (BS) with 2+ years of experience or a Master’s degree (MS) in pharmaceutical science, chemistry, chemical engineering, or related field.
• Strong pharmaceutical, API, small molecules testing for drug production is strongly preferred
• Experience in solid state characterization techniques (such as x-ray powder diffraction, polarized light microscopy, differential scanning calorimetry, thermogravimetric analysis, spectroscopy, etc.). Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
• Experience and understanding of infrared spectroscopy (FTIR, NIR, FT-Raman) and/or SSNMR is an advantage.
• Experience with solving Materials Science problems, e.g., solid state chemistry and particle characterization using experimental approaches and team collaboration.
• Understanding of physical, analytical, and organic chemistry.
• Good organizational skills, the ability to work independently, and excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
• A strong interest and motivation to learn new technologies and concepts is expected.
• Some programming experience is a plus, but not required.

• Position is Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm Overtime as needed
• May be requested to work on weekends, overtime, and holidays based on business needs
• Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Groton, CT are encouraged to apply.
• Excellent full-time benefits, including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship

• Develop and execute sales strategies that drive revenue growth and expand market share.

• National or key account management
• Project sales

jobs.title: People Partner (Tech & Product)
jobs.description:
AT A GLANCE

Location: Cambridge

In-office expectation: Flexible hybrid, one to two days per week in office.

Employment type: Permanent

Salary: £60,000 - £70,000

Why this role exists: To give our Technology and Product teams a genuine strategic partner who shapes and owns the people strategy behind their goals, not someone who just runs HR process.




ABOUT REDGATE

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases their organisations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.




AI AT REDGATE

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company: domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match. AI handles the heavy lifting, our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.




WHY JOIN OUR PEOPLE TEAM


● There's genuine room to bring your own ideas to the wider People Partner team: templates, calibration frameworks, how a restructure gets structured, and shape those alongside your peers rather than working them out alone in your own corner.

● We're growing, and a lot of the people strategy isn't fixed yet. You'll have a real say in shaping it, not just delivering against decisions someone else already made.

● You'll support Technology and Product, in a way that fits how we do things at Redgate.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This isn't a role about running HR process. You'll operate as a genuine strategic partner to the Technology and Product leadership teams, helping shape, own, and deliver the people strategy that drives their goals and, in turn, Redgate's wider goals.

 - You'll sit inside the leadership team's regular rhythm, seeing the roadmap and trade-offs early enough to shape them, not just react once there's a people problem

 - Full ownership of the people strategy for Technology and Product: headcount plan, org design, succession, and retention, agreed directly with the functional exec

 - Real thought leadership beyond your own patch: spot patterns across functions (promotion criteria that don't hold up, gaps in how senior hires are onboarded) and bring them to the wider People Partner team

 - Coach and challenge leaders directly, including pushing back on a VP or exec when the data or your judgement says they've got it wrong

 - Find practical ways to bring AI into how the function and the People Partner team work, not as a bolt-on




WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

 - Solid experience as a strategic People Partner or HR Business Partner in a high-growth or fast-changing business, ideally tech or SaaS, partnering directly with product or engineering leadership

 - A commercial mindset: able to connect the business issue behind a people problem and the people issue behind a business problem, with a track record of turning that into commercial outcomes

 - Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and make decisions stick without relying on formal authority

 - Confident using people metrics (attrition, engagement, hiring velocity, time to fill) to diagnose what's really going on, not just report on it

 - Evidence of shaping how a People team works, not just delivering inside your own area, for example building a framework or fixing a broken process




WHAT WE OFFER

● Salary range: £60,000 - £70,000

● Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office

● Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off

● Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression

● Private health insurance

Link to full benefits page here https://example.com/benefits




WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?

● Your application will be reviewed by a person. We don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications, and every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

● You'll hear back within a few days. Whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

● Our interview process is straightforward and consistent. You'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.




BELONGING AT REDGATE

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

You can read more about how we approach belonging and inclusion at Redgate on our Belonging at Redgate page here. https://example.com/belonging

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
About our Company:

Universal DX, Inc. is an international Company with a highly experienced team focused on cracking cancer’s code. Through our multi-omics and bioinformatics models, we have figured out how to read the disease’s signals in blood with high accuracy to detect cancer in its earliest stages. Starting with a colorectal cancer screening liquid biopsy test, we are building a multi-cancer platform that can identify the unique DNA regions associated with different types of cancers.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to coordinate cGMP manufacturing, stability program execution within Manufacturing Operations. This onsite role will provide technical and operational oversight for schedules, sample pulls, testing readiness, traceability, records, and cross-functional follow-up while partnering closely with the FQC Technical Lead and Quality. The ideal candidate is organized, technically strong, comfortable with regulated laboratory workflows, and able to translate approved protocols into reliable day-to-day execution.

You will be part of a team that is passionate about developing novel diagnostic tests for the early detection of cancers. As part of the team, you will be in a Company that aims more than to become one of the leaders in the industry. We want to have a huge positive impact on society by achieving the ambitious purpose of “making cancer a curable disease by detecting it earlier”.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Universal DX. We are growing rapidly and starting our US operations by building up our team, starting our lab and business operations, and establishing strategic partnerships. We are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey in this expansive time for us.

Primary Focus:

GMP Manufacturing and stability program coordination, technical oversight, scheduling, traceability, and execution readiness.

How you’ll contribute:

• Coordinate cGMP manufacturing and stability programs.

• Develop and maintain FQC and stability schedules, including sample-pull and testing timelines.

• Coordinate stability sample storage, inventory, pulls, testing, and associated documentation.

• Ensure stability activities are executed according to approved protocols and defined time points.

• Maintain stability study records, trackers, sample inventories, and traceability.

• Monitor FQC and stability data for trends, unexpected results, and operational concerns.

• Coordinate technical review and escalation of unexpected or out-of-trend results with the FQC Technical Lead and Quality.

• Support preparation, execution, and completion of stability protocols and reports.

• Provide visibility into upcoming FQC/stability requirements, resource needs, risks, dependencies, and study milestones.

• Support continuous improvement of FQC and stability workflows, scheduling, and operational execution.

• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, R&D, and other stakeholders to ensure samples, methods, equipment, materials, and documentation are ready before scheduled activities.

• Support investigations, deviations, CAPA actions, audit/inspection requests, and data/record retrieval associated with assigned FQC and stability activities.

What you’ll bring:

• Master’s degree or PhD in Life Sciences, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• Typically 5+ years of experience in GMP manufacturing, biopharma, reagent manufacturing, QC, analytical development, stability, or a regulated laboratory environment.

• Hands-on experience with molecular biology and/or NGS-related laboratory workflows; experience supporting functional or performance-based QC testing is strongly preferred.

• Experience coordinating stability studies, sample inventories, scheduled pulls, laboratory testing, or similar time-point driven programs.

• Strong scheduling, traceability, technical documentation, data review, and cross-functional coordination skills.

• Ability to recognize trends, unexpected results, and execution risks and escalate them through the appropriate technical and Quality channels.

• Comfort working onsite in a hands-on manufacturing/laboratory environment and supporting multiple concurrent studies and manufacturing priorities.

What we’ll offer:

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

• 22 days of PTO with the possibility to carry over 10 days to the following year.

• Company Holidays, plus your Birthday off!

• Company-sponsored benefit plans, including medical, dental, and vision insurance plus life, STD, and LTD coverage, and 401(k).

• Flexible work schedule.

• And more to come!

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Universal DX. We are growing rapidly and starting our US operations by building up our team, starting our lab and business operations, and establishing strategic partnerships.

We are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey in this expansive time for us.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At RCX Sports, we proudly serve as the premier youth sport operating partner for the NFL, NHL, MLS, MLB, NBA, and WNBA. We provide officially licensed uniforms, comprehensive resources, and dedicated support, empowering league operators to run the very best youth sports leagues and events in their communities. Our mission is grounded in the transformative power of sports. We’re dedicated to ensuring every child has the opportunity to play the game they love. By empowering league operators to effectively run and maintain their programming season after season, we’re committed to making youth sports accessible and inclusive for all.

The Senior Revenue Operations Specialist is the internal owner of RCX Sports’ Salesforce environment and a key partner across Sales/Growth, League Success, Marketing, Technology, Customer Service, Finance, and Analytics. This role leads the transition of revenue operations work from external vendors to internal ownership, manages Salesforce administration and governance, improves data integrity, and builds the processes and automations that support sustainable participation and revenue growth.

Reporting to the Director of Analytics, this individual will combine hands-on Salesforce expertise with strong cross-functional partnerships. They will own the Salesforce request queue, release management, access and licensing, platform documentation, and CRM-side integrations, and will play a critical role in implementing a marketing automation platform, serving as the Salesforce and data lead alongside Marketing and Technology.

Job Responsibilities:

• Serve as RCX Sports’ internal Salesforce administrator and system owner, managing configuration, objects, fields, page layouts, permission sets, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and release management.

• Manage the Salesforce request queue across business teams, establishing clear intake, prioritization, communication, and turnaround expectations.

• Build and test changes in sandbox environments and maintain a disciplined, documented deployment process.

• Lead the transition of revenue operations work from external vendors to internal ownership, including structured knowledge transfer and documentation of workflows, automations, email templates, custom objects, field definitions, and integration logic.

• Manage user provisioning and deprovisioning, access governance, permissions, licenses, storage, and platform capacity.

• Improve Salesforce data integrity through deduplication, record hygiene, field standardization, required-field governance, and reconciliation across connected systems.

• Own the mapping and maintenance of data flowing into Salesforce, partnering with Technology on integration design and troubleshooting.

• Serve as the CRM-side owner for the marketing automation platform, including object and field mapping, lead and contact synchronization, matching and deduplication rules, consent and suppression handling, and campaign-to-opportunity attribution.

• Build and maintain revenue workflows and automations, including renewal and end-of-season prompts, onboarding milestones, lead routing, lead scoring, and standardized web-to-lead capture.

• Identify manual processes across revenue teams and implement scalable solutions that return time to the business.

• Use Salesforce pipelines, dashboards, and reports to surface operational insights that help customer-facing teams prioritize their efforts and remove bottlenecks.

• Maintain living documentation of Salesforce workflows, objects, fields, integrations, and dependencies.

• Partner with Analytics to establish certified metric definitions so Salesforce data aligns with company dashboards and reporting.

• Evaluate downstream reporting and data-governance impacts before approving or deploying platform changes.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• 5+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, Salesforce administration, or a related field.

• At least 2 years of experience serving as the primary owner of a Salesforce environment.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce Flow, validation rules, custom objects, permission sets, reports, and dashboards.

• Demonstrated experience improving data integrity through deduplication, record hygiene, field standardization, and reconciliation across systems.

• Experience managing Salesforce integrations with external systems and partnering with technical teams on APIs, middleware, and data mapping.

• Experience using sandbox environments and following structured testing, release, and change-management practices.

• Working knowledge of email and SMS consent requirements, including CAN-SPAM and TCPA, and sound judgment when handling personal data.

• Strong documentation, organization, and project-management skills.

• Ability to explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders and translate business needs into scalable system solutions.

• Ability to work independently, navigate incomplete documentation, lead a vendor transition, and establish effective intake and prioritization practices.

• A collaborative mindset and an understanding of shared platform ownership across Revenue Operations, Marketing, Technology, and Analytics.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience enabling AI capabilities within CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or AI-assisted workflows).

• Experience connecting Help Scout or other ticketing platforms with Salesforce to build a holistic contact management infrastructure.

• Understanding of the youth sports ecosystem, including families, coaches, league operators, and program partners.

Additional Position Details:

• Travel: Up to 5%

• Work Schedule: Full-Time 40 hours/week (Monday-Friday) with occasional nights and weekends

• Compensation Structure: Expected starting salary - $100,500-$107,000/year. Exempt paid Semi-Monthly. This position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus & benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability, 401(k), Paid Parental Leave, Unlimited PTO, Monthly Wellness Expense Reimbursement and additional voluntary benefits.

• Location: Remote

• Reports to: Director of Analytics

• Supervisory Responsibilities: None

Benefits & Perks:

• Stay Healthy: Enroll in comprehensive benefits & insurance plans with no waiting period

• Be Well: Expense up to $65 per month for health & wellness

• Maximize Savings: Contribute to your 401k retirement savings with company matching

• Be Comfortable: Enjoy a relaxed casual dress code

• Take Time: Enjoy a variety of time off benefits including Unlimited PTO and paid Parental Leave

• Stay Connected: Work equipment (laptop and monitor) provided by RCX Sports plus, expense up to $350 towards the purchase of a personal use laptop, tablet, or computer

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

RCX Sports is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and team members without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, citizenship, veteran status, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law. We will make reasonable accommodations when necessary for team members and applicants with disabilities or handicaps, provided the individual is otherwise qualified to perform the job's essential functions.  Likewise, RCX Sports will comply with all legal requirements relating to accommodating religious beliefs and practices.  If you believe that you require an accommodation, please contact Human Resources.

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
About Osano

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

About the Role

We’re hiring an experienced Sales Manager to nurture and inspire a high-performing team of 9 Account Executives. Our sales team is instrumental in driving Osano forward by bringing our suite of products to a new generation of customers. We’re an energetic, kind, and intentional team looking for our next leader to enthusiastically support Osano’s products, people, ideals, and values.

Responsibilities

Revenue Leadership

• Design and execute quarterly and annual sales plans.

• Support the sales team with prospect meetings, presentations, and negotiations.

• Conduct weekly forecast reviews and quarterly progress review sessions.

• Own your team's quarterly quota, designing and deploying strategies to achieve it.

• Manage productivity, opportunities, and quality to ensure teams meet/exceed established goals and provide a delightful customer experience.

• Make ongoing process improvements, recommendations, and implementation of systems that will make our team more efficient.

• Be a strong cross-functional partner to Sales Enablement, Product, Marketing, & Customer Success.

Team Development

• Embody inclusive, servant leadership and nurture coach individuals at all levels to success.

• Hire, mentor, and develop individuals to bring intellectual curiosity, resilience, and resourcefulness to their roles.

• Provide feedback + focus your team of account executives.

• Collaborate with the People team on hiring and development to ensure a diverse team that’s exceeding expectations.

• Coach team members on sales acumen, product positioning, forecasting, and deal-level execution.

About You

• You have 2-5 years of experience managing + leading a team of Account Executives, plus your own experience as an Account Executive (or a similar role), in an enterprise SaaS environment.

• Ideally, you have some experience in governance/risk/compliance technology, legaltech, cybersecurity, or similar technical sales environments. However, this is not a requirement.

• You’re a team player willing to get in the trenches with your team.

• You are familiar with MEDDPICC, Challenger, and/or Force Management methodologies.

• You possess excellent communication skills and have no problem managing expectations at various levels in a 100% remote office environment.

• You’ve successfully built, grown, and led a sales team, including hiring early-stage talent.

• You thrive in fast-paced, remote environments and have a way of nurturing early-career talent to do the same. This means being empathetic, proactively communicating, and bringing ingenuity and initiative to your every day.

• You’re customer-focused and bring examples of how you’ve identified + responded to internal and external customer needs.

• You recognize opportunities and initiate actions to capitalize on𑁋You’re always looking for new ways to make an impact.

• You’re an innovative thinker; you embrace and champion new ideas and encourage others to do the same.

• You build strong relationships and convey a deep concern for all employees.

• You ensure individual needs + those of Osano are met and thoughtfully communicate up and down.

Why Us

• A well-defined career path that’s not just “climbing the ladder” - learn different competencies, skills, and concepts as you progress and get recognized for it.

• Supportive leadership and peers - from sales engineering and product marketing to sales development and demand generation - you’re never in this alone.

• You’ll be stepping into a space that’s on fire – the privacy and regulatory landscape is only growing with a ton of opportunity in front of us.

• You’ll become a privacy expert, including the opportunity to receive your Certified Information Privacy credential.

• You’ll be representing a product that makes prospects say, “This is so awesome” when you demo it.

Benefits

• Competitive compensation + ownership interest for early stake in our success!

• Unlimited paid time off with a requirement to take at least two weeks off per year.

• We're continuously a Best Place for Working Parents and offer paid parental leave for all new parents + believe that family, however you define it, comes first.

• Osano sponsors individual premiums for base plans at 100% and dependent premiums at 50% for Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance via Aetna.

• A fully, permanently remote company so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.

• Receive a Macbook + $600 to craft your home workspace

• Annual company trip designed to foster connection, creativity, and having fun together!

• Mental health benefits with free memberships to mindfulness + talk therapy services

A Bit More About Osano

Osano is a leading data privacy platform that helps organizations quickly and confidently comply with laws like GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest.

We’re backed by top-tier investors including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans. We’ve also been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four years running, with 97% of employees saying Osano is a great place to work.

As we grow, we're looking for individuals who lean into modern technologies and smarter systems to drive efficiency, clarity, and speed; both in our product and in how we operate. If you're excited by the idea of helping build a high-growth, privacy-first company that embraces thoughtful automation, emerging tech, and intentional collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

Osano is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry - we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.



Your Role

Focused Energy is advancing laser-driven inertial fusion energy (IFE) toward commercial power generation, and the credibility and velocity of that mission depend on our ability to model how the full IFE system behaves, where the physics risks lie, and what each subsystem must achieve for the plant to be economically viable. This role exists to and lead and participate in that capability.

We are seeking a Principal Scientist to serve as the most senior technical authority on the Digital Twin team to bring together an integrated IFE system modeling environment which will be at the center of Focused Energy’s IFE plant design efforts. You will lead a team of scientists who develop and own the simulation codes for each major subsystem - laser, target, fusion chamber, target injection and tracking, and target manufacturing - and drive the synthesis of those subsystem models into a comprehensive, self-consistent plant-level simulation framework. That framework enables rigorous trade-off analysis across competing point design candidates and allocates quantitative performance budgets back to each subsystem, forming the physics foundation from which engineering requirements are derived.



What You'll Do

 - Integrate the physics modeling efforts across all IFE subsystems — laser, target, chamber, target injection/tracking, and manufacturing.

 - Validate that subsystem code accurately captures the physics, with model uncertainty rigorously quantified and reported.

 - Set the scientific direction, modeling standards, and validation philosophy for the Digital Twin team.

 - Lead development of a comprehensive, integrated IFE plant model.

 - Work directly with the Science team on trade-off analyses across design candidates, identifying which design choices and parameters most affect plant viability.

 - Work with experimental physics teams to validate simulation codes against real shot data (our own, plus NIF, OMEGA, ELI, etc.).

 - Partner with the Digital Twin team and external collaborators (national labs, the broader IFE community) to keep our modeling at the frontier.

 - Present the modeling team's work to executive leadership, program management, and investors.



Who You Are

Must-haves

 - Master’s degree in Physics (with a specialization in Plasma, Laser, Nuclear, or related field); a Ph.D. is strongly preferred.

 - Deep expertise in IFE/ICF physics - e.g. target implosion design, laser-plasma interaction, hydrodynamic instability, burn physics, or chamber/neutronics

 - Track record developing, validating, and publishing physics simulation codes (hydrodynamic, radiation-hydrodynamics, PIC, ray tracing, Monte Carlo neutronics, etc.)

 - Strong programming skills (Python, Fortran, C++, or equivalent) and experience with HPC/large-scale simulation workflows.

 - Experience with integrated, systems-level modeling - coupling physics domains, managing code interfaces, uncertainty propagation, sensitivity analysis.



Nice-to-haves

 - Strong scientific leadership - sets high standards and builds team confidence.

 - Clear communicator - can translate complex physics for execs, engineers, and external partners.

 - Systems-level thinker - sees how subsystem trade-offs affect the whole design.

 - Collaborative across physics, engineering, and software disciplines.

 - Comfortable making decisions under uncertainty and being transparent about confidence levels.

 - Familiarity with Digital Twin methods, reduced-order modeling, or physics-informed ML.

 - Published or patented work in IFE/ICF or related plasma/laser physics.

 - Experience with requirements flow-down, performance budgeting, or margin analysis.

 - Entrepreneurial, self-directed, energized by building things from scratch.

 - Comfortable engaging with execs, program managers, academics, and investors.

 - Genuinely mission-driven and energized by startup pace and ambiguity.



What We Offer

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 - Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

 - Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 - Medical, Dental, Vision: Multiple great plans to pick from that are active come the 1st Day of employment for you and any enrolled dependents.

 - Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you Unlimited PTO.

 - Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks.

 - Retirement Plan: If you decide to enroll in our 401k plan, we will match up to 4% on top of the employee contribution.

 - Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

 - Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

• Develop and execute product strategies that drive category growth and business performance.
• Own products throughout the full lifecycle—from consumer insights and concept development through commercialization and ongoing portfolio management.

We're interested in connecting with Product Managers who have experience leading physical products, including:

• Consumer products
• Durable goods
• Building products/Building Materials
• Manufacturing environments

Successful candidates typically bring:

• 5+ years of Product Management experience

• Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence without direct authority

If your experience aligns with an upcoming role, we'll reach out to discuss the opportunity and determine whether it's a great fit for your background and career goals.

If you're ready to help shape innovative products for some of the industry's most recognized brands, we'd love to connect.

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or related field

At Fortune Brands, we support the overall health and wellness of our associates by offering comprehensive, competitive benefits that prioritize all aspects of wellbeing and provide flexibility for our teammates’ unique needs. This includes robust health plans, a market-leading 401(k) program with a company contribution, product discounts, flexible time off benefits, adoption benefits, and more. We offer numerous ERGs (Employee Resource Groups) to foster a sense of belonging for all associates.

Fortune Brands is built on industry-leading brands and innovation within the high-growth categories of water, outdoors and security. The Company makes innovative products for residential and commercial environments, with a growing focus on digital solutions and products that add luxury, contribute to safety and enhance sustainability. To learn more, visit our website at fbin.com.

jobs.title: Welder (Pipefitter)
jobs.description:
Coho Technology Solutions is seeking an experienced Welder (Pipefitter) to perform journey-level welding, fabrication, repair, modification, rebuilding, and assembly of metal and alloy components, equipment, systems, and structures in support of industrial and Naval operations in Kittery, Maine.

The Welder (Pipefitter) will perform a variety of manual welding assignments using electric arc, inert gas-shielded, gas torch, and other approved welding processes. The position requires the ability to interpret blueprints, sketches, engineering drawings, specifications, and work orders; select appropriate welding materials and techniques; and produce welds that meet specified requirements for penetration, fusion, strength, dimensions, and finish.

Must pass a required physical examination prior to placement and periodic examinations thereafter, as applicable.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

• Perform journey-level welding using electric, gas, arc, inert gas-shielded, plasma, and other applicable welding processes.

• Weld, repair, modify, fabricate, rebuild, and assemble metal and alloy parts, equipment, components, systems, and structures.

• Interpret and work from blueprints, sketches, engineering drawings, specifications, and work orders.

• Determine work requirements, plan the sequence of operations, and select appropriate welding methods and materials.

• Select proper electrodes, rods, filler materials, and other welding consumables based on the material and welding application.

• Perform welding in flat, horizontal, vertical, and overhead positions, including work in difficult-to-access areas.

• Perform pre-heating, brazing, flame cutting, heat treating, bead welding, tack welding, and related fabrication activities as required.

• Use templates, jigs, fixtures, and other tools to achieve required dimensions, fit, alignment, and tolerances.

• Heat, bend, cut, and shape metal of various thicknesses and types to meet required dimensions and configurations.

• Weld pressure vessels and high-temperature steam and water lines as assigned.

• Weld dissimilar metals while achieving complete penetration and/or fusion and minimizing distortion, burning, and other defects.

• Inspect completed welds and ensure they meet applicable specifications, accepted trade practices, and quality requirements.

• Support destructive and non-destructive testing of welds, including radiographic, magnetic particle, dye penetrant, pressure, and other applicable testing.

• Identify and correct welding defects, including cracks, slag inclusions, inadequate penetration, improper fusion, and dimensional deficiencies.

• Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work area and comply with established safety procedures.

• Properly use required personal protective equipment and protective clothing.

• Work collaboratively with other tradespeople on preventive maintenance, emergency repairs, and related industrial assignments.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

• Clearance: Must obtain and maintain continuous eligibility for Secret clearance and access to Confidential/Secret information, when required

• Licensure and Certifications: Ability to successfully complete required welding proficiency testing. Valid state driver's license Ability to obtain and maintain required certifications for welding, including respirator certification when applicable Current CPR certification is required May be required to maintain current welding certifications and demonstrate welding proficiency through destructive and non-destructive testing May be required to operate mobile cranes or motor vehicles requiring licensing for vehicles up to 2 tons

• Experience: Demonstrated journeyman-level welding skills Experience with gas welding processes such as oxyacetylene, oxy-hydrogen, or other industrial gas welding processes Experience with applicable arc welding processes, including gas metal arc welding (GMAW), gas tungsten arc welding (GTAW), plasma arc, carbon arc, or comparable processes Demonstrated ability to weld materials ranging from very thin metal to heavy/thick materials requiring multiple welding passes Experience welding dissimilar metals and achieving complete penetration and/or fusion

• Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Ability to interpret blueprints, sketches, drawings, specifications, and work orders Ability to produce welds that meet required strength, shape, dimensional, penetration, and finish specifications Ability to work with limited in-process supervision and maintain quality standards independently

• Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of accepted welding trade practices and techniques Knowledge of metal fabrication, pipefitting, repair, modification, and assembly processes Ability to work with a wide range of metal types, sizes, shapes, and thicknesses Knowledge of welding inspection and quality-control requirements. Ability to work safely around heat, sparks, fumes, electrical equipment, pressurized systems, and other industrial hazards Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality workmanship Ability to work effectively with other trades and technical personnel

• Physical Requirements This position requires substantial physical activity, including: Standing and walking for extended periods Stooping, bending, kneeling, climbing, and crawling Working in awkward, confined, and difficult-to-access positions Working at heights of up to 100 feet, when required Handling objects weighing approximately 20–50 pounds and occasionally objects exceeding 50 pounds Performing welding and fabrication work in physically demanding environments Wearing required protective clothing, gloves, eye protection, face shields, respirators, and other PPE

• Work Environment Work may be performed indoors and outdoors and may include exposure to varying environmental conditions. Work areas may range from controlled or clean environments to noisy, dirty, smoky, and industrial areas The position may involve exposure to welding fumes, infrared and ultraviolet radiation, heat, flying sparks, torch glare, heated materials, electrical hazards, burns, cuts, and other industrial hazards. Appropriate PPE and established safety procedures must be followed at all times

• Other Requirements May be required to work overtime, including evenings, weekends, holidays, or emergency call-back assignments May be assigned to work at locations other than the employee's primary assigned location

Position Pay Range

$31—$36 USD

jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role

The Lifecycle Marketing Operations Manager is an experienced Braze campaign architect responsible for asset development, audience segmentation, and campaign quality assurance in multiple marketing communication channels, including: email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging. With a strong focus on both campaign execution and stakeholder collaboration, the ideal candidate has superior attention to detail and time management skills, as well as the ability to understand business needs & objectives in order to consistently deliver pristine, on-time work. The LCM Ops manager will work closely with LCM strategists to recommend features, design tests, and review strategy to achieve shared OKRs.

What you’ll do

• Under the direction of an LCM Operations Associate Group Manager, execute data-driven marketing initiatives utilizing a campaign management tool; perform activities such as audience selection, trigger qualification, suppressions, segmentation and arbitration

• Own the coding/building, approval process, and deployment of daily, monthly, and ad-hoc content-focused lifecycle marketing campaigns; contribute strategic thought leadership to the team’s campaign testing & optimization strategies

• Deliver on lifecycle campaign execution deadlines in various marketing channels (e.g. Email, Push, In-App Messaging, etc.)

• Develop, enforce, and perform quality control activities to ensure daily campaign deployment completes in a timely manner and the output is accurate and complete

• Produce campaign performance reports using analytically derived model outputs to share test outcomes, highlight campaign business impact, and inform future testing strategies

• Consolidate and confirm the accuracy of prospect and/or customer audience data when building campaign audience segmentation

• Work with others to understand and provide tactical feedback regarding campaign objectives, data specifications, technical requirements, etc

• Develop strong stakeholder relationships through consistent, proactive communication on your projects and strategic recommendations in your area of expertise

What you’ll need

• Bachelor’s Degree, ideally in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a technical field (or equivalent professional experience)

• 5+ years of HTML coding experience, with hands-on experience building and deploying emails. Being able to code from scratch is not a requirement, but comfort with manipulating templates is.

• 2-5 years experience with marketing automation tools and/or ESPs (e.g. Braze, Pardot, Marketo, Eloqua, etc.)

• Experience proactively managing own workload and output, including juggling multiple medium-to-large projects at a time

• Ability to adapt to shifting priorities and make judgement calls when projects change or are ambiguous in nature

• Strong interest to learn new tools with a natural curiosity

• Diligent adherence to best practices and QA procedures, with very strong attention to detail

• Proven ability to communicate strategies, insights, and recommendations effectively with a variety of stakeholders

• Comfortable working independently, and with ambiguity at times

• Strong project management skills

Nice to have

• Experience working directly with Data Analysts, Software Engineers, and Project Managers

• Previous experience with Braze and Pardot is a strong plus

• Understanding of A/B and multivariate testing standards

• Knowledge of relational databases, real-time event data, data structures and querying language (e.g. select, merge, join, group by, etc)

• Experience writing SQL statements for data extraction

• Experience working with real-time web and app event data

jobs.title: Contracts Manager, Services
jobs.description:
Clēnera is a tier-one developer and independent power producer located in Boise, Idaho, and is the U.S. subsidiary of Enlight Renewable Energy (Nasdaq: ENLT). We develop, finance, construct, own, and operate utility-scale solar and energy storage facilities throughout the United States. In its 2025 analysis of solar independent power producers, S&P Global ranked Clēnera as a top ten U.S. owner of planned installations in the next five years. Clēnera has over 1.9 GW of solar and 5.1 GWh of storage in operations or construction, and a development pipeline totaling 17.8 GW of solar and 51.1 GWh of storage across 23 states. Our company culture is at the core of everything we do, so you’ll regularly find Caring, Committed, and Courageous individuals who value respectful, cross-functional collaboration with partners internally and externally. With our tremendous portfolio growth, we are increasing our headcount to meet the demands of the business. Are you ready to change the world with us?

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Contracts Manager is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies for service contracts (e.g. EPC, O&M, engineering). You will lead supplier selection, competitive sourcing events, negotiations, contract development, and supplier relationship management to achieve cost, quality, risk, and performance objectives. The role serves as the strategic owner of assigned categories and partners closely with business leaders to align procurement strategies with organizational goals.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Develop and implement comprehensive category management strategies that align with organizational objectives, project pipelines, operational requirements, market conditions, and long-term business growth initiatives while balancing cost, quality, risk, and supplier capability considerations.

• Lead end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives, translating business requirements into commercial evaluation, contract negotiation, supplier selection, and implementation strategies that deliver value while advancing long-term business objectives.

• Build and maintain deep knowledge of assigned supplier markets, industry trends, supply chain constraints, pricing dynamics, geopolitical influences, and emerging technologies to proactively identify opportunities and risks impacting the organization.

• Structure, lead, and execute competitive sourcing events, including RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, and supplier negotiations, utilizing data-driven evaluation methodologies to optimize commercial outcomes and supplier performance.

• Negotiate commercial agreements, master service agreements, statements of work, purchase agreements, and associated contract terms to maximize business value while appropriately allocating commercial, operational, legal, and performance-related risks.

• Establish and maintain strategic supplier relationships, partnering with key suppliers to improve performance, enhance service delivery, increase innovation, and create mutually beneficial long-term partnerships.

• Collaborate closely with engineering, construction, operations, finance, legal, IT, and executive stakeholders to understand business priorities, develop sourcing strategies, and ensure procurement decisions support organizational goals, timelines, deliverables, and quality.

• Evaluate supplier performance by establishing metrics and key performance indicators. Drive continuous improvement to build robust processes that establish durable capability while driving accountability, internally and externally, to improve supplier effectiveness and reduce operational risk.

• Identify and execute cost optimization, process improvement, standardization, and value-creation initiatives that improve total cost of ownership and deliver measurable business impact across assigned categories.

• Lead, coach, and develop employees through effective hiring, training, and mentorship, fostering an environment where individuals can leverage their unique strengths to achieve their full potential and deliver meaningful value to the organization.

• Demonstrates the Clēnera Core Values of Caring, Committed, and Courageous.

• Other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, operations management, business, finance, engineering, or related field.

• Experience: Minimum of 7 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, supply chain, contract management, or related, including; Minimum of 5 years of experience in renewable energy.

• Technology: Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and an ability to learn company-specific software programs, tools, processes, and machines.

• Skills/Attributes: Ability to develop and execute sourcing strategies that align supplier capabilities with business objectives, operational requirements, and market conditions. Ability to lead supplier evaluations, competitive sourcing events, and contract negotiations that deliver value and support long-term business needs. Ability to analyze market trends, pricing dynamics, and supplier capabilities to support strategic sourcing decisions. Ability to build and manage strategic supplier relationships that improve performance, service delivery, and overall business outcomes. Ability to assess and mitigate commercial, operational, and supply chain risks while supporting organizational objectives. Demonstrated ability to lead highly effective teams, both internally and externally. Self-motivated to work through complex problems and competing priorities, including a high level of detail and organization. Effective verbal and written communication skills.

• Travel: 10%

BENEFITS

jobs.description:
Location: Open to NYC, SF Bay Area, or Seattle candidates (Hybrid - 3 days onsite)

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager to help grow Sia’s Legal AI & Technology practice and lead transformation programs for corporate legal departments and law firms. You will advise legal leaders, shape technology decisions, and lead multidisciplinary teams from opportunity assessment through implementation and adoption.

The role combines client delivery, business development, and practice leadership. You will work closely with Sia’s legal operations, AI, data, and engineering specialists to improve legal service delivery, reduce manual work, and build capabilities clients can sustain.

Key responsibilities

Advise legal leaders and shape transformation programs

• Partner with General Counsel, Heads of Legal Operations, and technology leaders to assess workflows, systems, data, and organizational readiness for AI.
• Develop business cases, prioritized use cases, technology roadmaps, and operating models, including Legal AI Centers of Excellence.
• Shape initiatives across contracting, legal intake and triage, knowledge management, matter and spend management, litigation support, and legal reporting.

Lead legal AI and technology delivery

• Lead client engagements across workstreams, owning scope, staffing, budgets, delivery quality, and executive communications.
• Guide build-versus-buy decisions, vendor assessments, pilots, and implementation of legal AI platforms, contract lifecycle management systems, and custom AI agents.
• Translate legal requirements into workflows, product backlogs, contract playbooks, and acceptance criteria. Coordinate configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, and deployment with technical teams.
• Establish evaluation methods with legal reviewers to assess accuracy, completeness, source reliability, and business usefulness. Address confidentiality, privilege, access controls, and human oversight in solution design.

Drive adoption and demonstrate value

• Lead practical workshops, training, and change programs that help lawyers and legal operations teams use AI effectively in their daily work.
• Track adoption, quality, turnaround times, capacity gains, and cost savings. Use feedback and performance data to improve solutions and establish ongoing ownership and support.

Grow the practice and develop client relationships

• Identify and qualify opportunities, expand existing accounts, and lead discovery sessions, proposals, statements of work, and pricing with Sia leadership.
• Develop offerings, demonstrations, reusable delivery methods, and client credentials that turn project experience into repeatable services.
• Build relationships with legal technology providers and collaborate across Sia’s international teams. Contribute to campaigns, thought leadership, and industry events.

Build and lead teams

• Coach consultants and managers, oversee work quality, support recruitment, and develop the team’s legal technology and applied AI capabilities.
• Coordinate internal initiatives across legal operations and technical specialists, with clear priorities, owners, and deliverables.

• 8+ years of relevant experience in consulting, legal operations, legal technology, or technology transformation, including substantial work with legal departments or law firms.
• 3+ years leading teams or complex client programs, with accountability for delivery, senior stakeholder relationships, and team development.
• A track record of implementing legal technology or AI solutions through rollout and adoption, with measurable operational improvements.
• Strong understanding of legal workflows, particularly contracting and legal service delivery, and the ability to translate legal requirements into practical technology solutions.
• Practical experience evaluating and using generative AI tools, designing workflows, and assessing outputs. Working knowledge of AI agents, retrieval from enterprise knowledge sources, and integration considerations.
• Experience developing proposals, scoping engagements, and contributing to account growth or new business.
• Strong workshop facilitation, executive communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect legal, business, and technical teams.
• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience. A law degree is welcome but not required.

Preferred experience

• Experience with platforms such as Harvey, Ivo, Legora, or enterprise CLM solutions, alongside general-purpose AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot.
• Experience developing contract playbooks, legal knowledge repositories, AI evaluation frameworks, or Legal AI governance and operating models.
• Ability to prototype workflows using low-code tools or code, and familiarity with APIs, data models, and enterprise systems.
• An established network in legal operations or legal technology, and experience building offerings or participating in communities such as CLOC or ACC.

Why join Sia

Help shape a growing Legal AI & Technology practice, work directly with legal leaders on implementation and adoption, and collaborate with consulting, data, and engineering teams to bring new solutions to market.

Compensation & Benefits

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

Compensation

• Base Salary: $180,000 - $210,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.

• Annual Performance Bonus
• Personal Sales Bonus (uncapped)

Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options

• College savings and student loan repayment programs

• Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday

• Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Workplace

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Commitment

At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.
