jobs.title: Accounting Operations Internship (part-time)
jobs.description:
JOIN CONTORO ROBOTICS – REVOLUTIONIZING WAREHOUSE AUTOMATION WITH CUTTING-EDGE ROBOTICS

At Contoro Robotics, we're on a mission to solve labor challenges through advanced robotic solutions. Headquartered in Austin, TX, our fast-growing startup is transforming the supply chain industry with our flagship warehouse automation technology. Our team is made up of top-tier experts in robotics, AI, and logistics, working together to push the boundaries of automation.

We’re looking for talented and ambitious individuals to join us on this journey—helping shape the future of robotics while growing alongside a world-class team. If you're passionate about innovation, problem-solving, and making a real-world impact, we want to hear from you!

Employment Type: Part-Time
Hours: Up to 30 hours per week

Location: on-site preferred in our Austin, TX office



About the Role

Contoro is seeking a detail-oriented Accounting Operations Intern (part-time) to support our day-to-day accounting and financial operations. This role will work closely with our operations, deployment, and leadership teams to maintain accurate financial records, manage expenses, and provide visibility into spending across the company and our deployment projects.

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, and comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment. In addition to supporting accounts payable and accounts receivable, this person will help us better understand where we are spending money, how individual deployment projects are performing against budget, and where opportunities exist to reduce costs.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

 - Support day-to-day accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) activities.

 - Track vendor invoices, customer invoices, payments, and outstanding balances.

 - Help ensure invoices and payments are properly documented, coded, and processed in a timely manner.

 - Assist with reconciliations and maintaining accurate accounting records.

Bookkeeping & Expense Management

 - Maintain and categorize company expenses in Ramp and QuickBooks.

 - Review transactions and ensure expenses are assigned to the appropriate account, department, vendor, or project.

 - Assist with reviewing and approving employee reimbursements and company expenses.

 - Identify missing receipts, documentation, or coding and follow up with employees as needed.

 - Help maintain clean and accurate financial records for month-end accounting.

Deployment Project Expense Tracking

 - Track expenses associated with individual customer deployment projects.

 - Ensure deployment-related purchases, travel, materials, contractors, freight, and other costs are properly allocated to the appropriate project.

 - Maintain visibility into actual deployment spending compared with project budgets.

 - Work with deployment and operations teams to identify unexpected or increasing project costs.

 - Help develop consistent processes for tracking deployment costs across multiple sites.

Cost Analysis & Savings

 - Analyze company and project expenses to identify cost-saving opportunities.

 - Review recurring expenses, vendors, subscriptions, purchasing patterns, and deployment costs.

 - Identify areas of unnecessary or excessive spending.

 - Compare vendor pricing and spending trends when appropriate.

 - Provide recommendations and supporting data to help management reduce costs and improve operational efficiency.

Reporting & Process Improvement

 - Prepare recurring expense, budget, AP/AR, and deployment cost reports for management.

 - Help improve accounting and expense-management workflows as the company grows.

 - Maintain organized supporting documentation for accounting, audits, investor due diligence, and financial reporting.

 - Work with our internal team and external accountants to ensure financial information is accurate and complete.

Qualifications

 - Experience with bookkeeping, accounting operations, finance, or a related function.

 - Working knowledge of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

 - Experience with QuickBooks; experience with Ramp is preferred.

 - Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

 - Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

 - Comfortable analyzing expenses and identifying trends or discrepancies.

 - Ability to work independently and follow up with different teams to obtain necessary information.

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment where responsibilities may evolve as the company grows.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means Contoro has accurate and up-to-date expense records, clear visibility into AP/AR and company spending, reliable cost tracking for each deployment project, and better insight into where we can control costs and operate more efficiently.

jobs.description:
Redwood Strategy Group (RSG) is a minority owned, Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) founded on over 17 years of thought-to-action leadership supporting military departments, Department of Defense, and agencies across the U.S. Federal Government with transformation, strategy, and operations. At RSG, we are committed to our company foundation - our employees. The minute you start working here, you become an integral part of our team, our future, and you will play a key role in the continued growth of our company.

Innovative Solutions. Cultivated Talent. Accelerative Success.


Redwood Strategy Group (RSG) is seeking Navy ERP financial systems and sustainment professionals at multiple experience levels to support a new Department of the Navy financial management initiative. Selected candidates will support Navy ERP sustainment, financial data reconciliation, audit readiness, organizational realignment, reporting, system improvements, and end-user support.
Positions will be aligned to candidates’ experience in financial management, business systems, data analytics, project management, change management, or emerging technology.
Primary Responsibilities
Depending on experience and assigned role, responsibilities may include:
Support Navy ERP ECC financial operations, sustainment, and audit readiness.
Research abnormal balances, transaction errors, interface issues, and financial data discrepancies.
Reconcile legacy financial data and reports with Navy ERP data.
Conduct root-cause analysis and develop corrective actions for data-quality and system issues.
Support financial statement validation, internal controls, audit response, and remediation.
Assist with Navy ERP organizational and master-data changes associated with command reorganizations.
Support updates to organization codes, fund centers, cost centers, UICs, business areas, plants, activity rates, WBS elements, networks, and related structures.
Coordinate personnel, payroll, labor, travel, procurement, asset, and financial-system dependencies.
Support Navy ERP testing, mock events, system changes, and validation of migrated or converted data.
Develop and maintain dashboards, data visualizations, reports, and analytical tools using Navy ERP data and platforms such as Advana/Jupiter.
Develop business rules, standard operating procedures, job aids, and localized training materials.
Prepare variance analyses, mitigation strategies, corrective action plans, recommendations, and leadership briefings.
Maintain project schedules, plans of action and milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and status reports.
Collaborate with Navy financial managers, system owners, functional organizations, auditors, and other contractor teams.
Support occasional onsite meetings, testing events, or mission requirements outside normal working hours.
Experience Levels
Candidates may be considered at one of the following levels:
Junior/Staff: Familiarity with Department of the Navy processes preferred. Experience supporting financial operations, data analysis, business systems, or Navy ERP is desirable.
Level II: At least three years of progressive, relevant experience.
Level III: At least six years of progressive, relevant experience, with the ability to work independently and provide direction to project teams.
Level IV: At least nine years of progressive, relevant experience, including approximately six years leading complex workstreams or related projects.
Subject Matter Expert: At least 15 years of relevant experience and recognized expertise in Navy ERP, financial management, accounting, business systems, organizational change, data analytics, or a related field.
Program Manager: At least nine years of relevant experience, including four years managing business consulting, financial management, process improvement, or comparable engagements.

jobs.title: Repair Operations Lead
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission.

Flexdrive builds the operational backbone for the future of mobility. As a leader in fleet management and a Lyft subsidiary, we're extending our expertise into autonomous vehicle (AV) infrastructure — managing the physical operations that keep AV fleets safe, available, and performing at scale. Our Nashville depot is the first proof point in a multi-market expansion, and we're building the team to sustain and scale it.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Deployment, Flexdrive is seeking an exceptional Repair Operations Lead to help run the day-to-day service operations supporting our AV fleet. You'll work alongside a second Repair Operations Lead as a partnered pair, sharing coverage and accountability for the floor. This is a people-first leadership role. You will lead and mentor our repair coordinators, hold both the coordinator team and our on-site technicians (a 3rd party partner) accountable to quality and turnaround expectations, and keep the partnership running smoothly so the fleet stays available.

We're looking for a strong people leader rather than a deep technical expert. Service advisor or service drive experience is helpful because you'll be fluent in the workflow, but what matters most is your ability to develop a team, set clear expectations, and hold the line on them without losing the room. You should be comfortable managing an external partner relationship day to day, balancing a collaborative working rapport with firm accountability. You bring a teamwork mentality, genuinely care about employee relations and the culture you're building, and will lean into Lyft's values as one of the early leaders shaping how this site operates. If you're energized by growing people, building strong partner relationships, and bringing order to a fast-moving operation, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:

• Shift Pattern This role supports 24/7 AV depot operations and requires availability to work day shifts, with hours scheduled between 5:00 PM - 1:30 AM, with alternating weekends with rotating weekdays off. Specific shift times and schedules will be determined based on operational needs and business requirements. Schedules will include weekends and holidays based on depot operational requirements.

• Technical Team Management Partnership Oversight & Accountability: Serve as the day-to-day point of accountability for our onsite repair partner, holding their technicians to agreed quality, turnaround, and certification standards across all shifts, and escalating gaps through the right channels before they affect fleet availability. Workflow Distribution: Manage and optimize repair workflows across technician teams, balancing workload, prioritizing critical repairs, and ensuring SLA compliance for all maintenance activities. Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with the internal teams that own our third-party relationships and offsite collision repairs, acting as the site-level point of contact so vehicles route correctly, status stays visible, and repair timelines hold. You'll surface issues from the floor to those teams and carry their requirements back to the site so both sides stay aligned. Performance Management: Conduct regular performance reviews, skills assessments, and development planning for technical staff, fostering a culture of safety, continuous improvement and technical excellence.

• Team Development & Coaching Onboarding & Job Task Training: Get new repair coordinators up to speed on their core responsibilities — work order management, vehicle intake and staging, documentation, and the systems they'll live in day to day — so they're contributing confidently and correctly. Depot Operations Fluency: Teach the team how the depot actually runs: how work flows from intake through repair and release, how their role connects to the technicians and the internal teams upstream and downstream, and what good looks like at each handoff. Ongoing Coaching & Mentorship: Provide regular, direct feedback through side-by-sides, one-on-ones, and in-the-moment coaching. Identify where each coordinator wants to grow, build a path for them, and address performance gaps early and honestly.

• Fleet Health & Maintenance Operations Fleet Performance Optimization: Monitor and improve key metrics including Mean Time to Recovery, Vehicle Turnaround Time, and Diagnosis Escalation Rate. Service Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain quality control processes ensuring all maintenance work meets partner specifications and safety standards. Maintenance Planning: Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules, manage maintenance change requests, and ensure compliance with partner fleet management system requirements. Technical Problem Resolution: Lead root cause analysis for technical issues working with our 3rd party partner, implementing corrective actions, and developing preventive measures to reduce repeat failures.

• Parts & Materials Oversight Service and Parts Coordinator Management: Directly supervise parts and service writing coordination, ensuring seamless integration between parts allocation, work order documentation, and inventory management while maintaining accuracy and compliance standards. Supply Chain Coordination: Oversee Material Coordinator activities, ensuring optimal parts inventory levels, secure storage of proprietary components, and compliance with chain of custody standards. Inventory Optimization: Analyze parts consumption patterns, forecast requirements, and coordinate with partner aftermarket teams to prevent stockouts while minimizing carrying costs. Vendor Parts Management: Manage relationships with parts suppliers, negotiate service agreements, and ensure timely delivery of critical components. Non-Conforming Parts Process: Oversee quarantine and disposition procedures for non-conforming parts, ensuring proper documentation and handling.

• Compliance & Documentation Training Compliance: Ensure all personnel maintain required qualifications through partner learning management systems, conducting monthly verification reviews per standards. Safety Program Integration: Collaborate with the safety team to ensure all maintenance activities comply with EHS requirements, including battery safety, hazardous materials handling, and hot work procedures. Documentation Management: Maintain comprehensive documentation hierarchy including job descriptions, safety protocols, training records, and maintenance logs per partner requirements. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all technical operations meet federal, state, and local regulations including EPA, OSHA, and AV-specific requirements.

• Strategic Planning & Continuous Improvement Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, analyzing performance data to identify optimization opportunities and implement best practices across technical operations. Capacity Planning: Forecast staffing needs, training requirements, and infrastructure upgrades to support fleet growth and operational scaling. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations Manager, Depot Operations Leads, and partner technical teams to ensure seamless integration of maintenance and depot operations. Knowledge Management: Establish and maintain technical knowledge base, documenting lessons learned, best practices, and troubleshooting guides for common issues. Culture of Safety: Champion a comprehensive culture of safety through proactive engagement. Leading by example in following all safety requirements; educating the team on safety protocols; proactively identifying risks; managing incidents, including reporting and investigation.

• Technical Competencies Advanced diagnostic skills for electric and autonomous vehicle systems Proficiency with fleet management systems (Carman experience preferred) SAP or similar ERP system expertise for parts and maintenance tracking Data analysis and reporting capabilities for performance metrics Understanding of ISO quality standards and automotive compliance requirements

Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Automotive Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.

• 4+ years of progressive experience in fleet maintenance management, automotive service operations, or technical training leadership.

• 3+ years of experience managing technical teams including hiring, training, performance management, and development of skilled technicians.

• 2+ years of experience developing and delivering technical training programs, preferably in automotive or fleet maintenance environments.

• Proven expertise in electric vehicle systems, diagnostic procedures, and advanced automotive technologies (AV experience highly preferred).

• Strong understanding of maintenance management systems, KPI tracking, and data-driven decision making for fleet operations.

• Experience with vendor management, contract negotiation, and third-party service provider oversight.

• Demonstrated success implementing quality management systems, safety management systems and continuous improvement methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean preferred).

• Exceptional communication skills with ability to interface effectively with technical teams, executive leadership, and external partners.

• Current ASE certifications preferred; ability to obtain required partner certifications within 90 days.

• Valid driver's license with clean driving record.

Benefits:

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Child care and pet benefits

• 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

• In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

• 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Note: For this role, candidates must reside in states registered for Flexdrive Services LLC.

This role is on-site at a Lyft Flexdrive hub or office location full time. #Onsite

The expected base pay range for this position in the Nashville area is $50,180 - $62,730, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

Flexdrive is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. Flexdrive also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Flexdrive will also consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: Principal AI Programmer, Unreal Assistant
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Principal Al Programmer who builds products that integrate Al into Unreal Engine. You'll design and ship the full stack of systems that let LLMs act inside the engine (from end to end, not just a single layer), bringing depth in game engine architecture, cloud services, and how LLMs actually work.

In this role, you will

• Design and build LLM-driven agents and tools that operate directly inside Unreal Engine, including engine-side C++/Python tooling and editor scripting

• Design and extend the cloud-hosted agent harness, services, and database that mediate between LLMs and the engine

• Work across the full stack (engine tooling, cloud backend, and the web UI used to drive and monitor agents) to ship end-to-end features

• Evaluate and integrate emerging LLM capabilities (tool use, multi-agent orchestration, context management) into Epic's engine and pipeline tooling

• Define technical direction for the reliability, safety, and evaluation of LLM-driven engine automation

• Partner closely with engine, tools, and backend programmers, and mentor others on both game engine internals and LLM system design

What we're looking for

• Strong software programming background with hands-on experience in a game engine (Unreal Engine strongly preferred), including engine architecture and tooling/editor scripting

• Practical experience building or shipping products powered by LLMs (agents, tool-calling, RAG, prompt/context programming), or a strong conceptual understanding of how LLMs work

• Experience with cloud-native services and infrastructure: web APIs, databases, and service architecture and deployment

• Excellent programming skills across C++ (engine-side) and Python and/or a web backend language

• Ability to work full-stack and reason about tradeoffs across engine code, backend services, and a web front end

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field

This role is open to multiple locations in North America (including CA, NYC, & WA).

Pay Transparency Information

The expected annual base pay range(s) for this position are detailed below. Each base pay range is relevant only for individuals who are residents of or will be expected to work within the specified locale. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors, which include (but aren’t limited to) things such as skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, and experience. In addition to base pay, most employees are eligible to participate in Epic’s generous benefit plans and discretionary incentive programs (subject to the terms of those plans or programs).

New York City Base Pay Range

$245,975—$360,763 USD

California Base Pay Range

$270,572—$396,838 USD

Washington Base Pay Range

$245,975—$360,763 USD

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here.

Perform entrance control: Enforce the District’s entry and identification system which includes operating security screening equipment to detect weapons, contraband, and prohibited items, checking items such as handbags, briefcases, computers, packages, baby carriages, wheelchairs, etc.

Perform roving patrol: Patrol court facilities and grounds of the facility in accordance with applicable post orders.

Perform stationary post assignments: Stand guard at stationary posts which include (but not limited to) monitoring closed-circuit television, duress alarm systems and other security equipment, courtrooms, judge chambers, and jury rooms.

Court attendance: Responsible for securing unattended courtrooms, an inspection of courtrooms prior to a proceeding, testing of security devices, and other duties concerning security of the court area.

Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Must possess the ability to understand, explain, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, directives, and procedures.

jobs.title: AI Security Engineer I
jobs.description:
THE POSITION:

The AI Security Engineer I supports the security, governance, and responsible use of AI, Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI technologies across EVERSANA. This role assists with securing AI-enabled applications, models, and data; conducting security assessments; monitoring emerging AI threats; and implementing security controls aligned with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.

Working closely with both IT and business stakeholders, the AI Security Engineer I helps ensure AI solutions are developed, deployed, and operated securely while enabling innovation and managing risk effectively.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams.  These results are achieved by:

• Assist in the implementation and maintenance of security controls for Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions.
• Support security assessments of AI-enabled applications, models, and services to identify vulnerabilities, threats, and misconfigurations.
• Participate in threat modeling exercises for AI systems and help identify appropriate security controls and mitigations.
• Monitor emerging AI security risks, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and industry trends, providing recommendations for risk reduction.
• Assist with testing and validation of AI security controls, including model protection, data security, and access management measures.
• Collaborate with security, data science, engineering, and compliance teams to ensure AI solutions align with organizational security standards, regulatory requirements, and responsible AI principles.
• Support governance initiatives related to AI usage, including model inventory management, risk assessments, and policy compliance activities.
• Help evaluate and implement security technologies and tools designed to protect AI systems, data pipelines, and cloud-native AI environments.
• Contribute to security investigations involving AI platforms and assist with incident response activities related to AI and emerging technologies.
• Participate in periodic testing of disaster recovery and business continuity plans for critical AI and business systems.
• Document findings, recommendations, and remediation activities in accordance with established security and compliance processes.
• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
• 1-3 years of experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, application security, AI engineering, machine learning operations (MLOps), or related technology disciplines.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI technologies, and associated security risks.
• Familiarity with AI security topics such as prompt injection, model abuse, data poisoning, model theft, adversarial attacks, and secure AI development practices.
• Basic understanding of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud) and cloud security principles.
• Knowledge of security technologies such as EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management tools, identity and access management (IAM), and security monitoring solutions.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience with cloud-native AI services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Anthropic Claude, AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI.

“This position requires passing a ServiceNow background screening, USFedPASS (US Federal Personnel Authorization Screening Standards). This includes a credit check, criminal/misdemeanor check and taking a drug test. Any employment is contingent upon passing the screening.  Due to Federal requirements, only US citizens, US naturalized citizens or US Permanent Residents, holding a green card, will be considered.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will independently lead the design, development, and delivery of complex, high-impact AI-native and cloud-native systems. The IC4 engineer takes ownership of critical components or features, sets technical direction within their domain, and serves as a technical resource to peers and junior engineers. They combine deep software engineering fundamentals with hands-on expertise in AI/ML integration, cloud architecture, and production systems. This role requires the ability to balance technical depth with organizational impact, working across teams to solve ambiguous problems and drive platform improvements.

What you get to do in this role:

Responsibility Area: Technical Leadership & Architecture

•    Lead the design and architecture of complex, production-critical AI-native systems, including LLM integrations, agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, and inference services

•    Own end-to-end delivery of medium-to-large features or systems, including specification, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring

•    Make informed architectural and technical trade-off decisions between latency, cost, scalability, reliability, and model quality

•    Establish evaluation frameworks, testing strategies, and production monitoring for AI-driven features; drive adoption of eval-driven development practices

•    Design and optimize high-performance data pipelines, embedding systems, and vector stores handling millions of rows and complex retrieval scenarios

•    Champion security best practices, including prompt-injection defense, data privacy, PII handling, responsible AI guardrails, and compliance with regulatory requirements

•    Participate in architectural reviews across teams and contribute to platform-level technical decisions

•    Stay current with emerging AI/ML frameworks, services, and techniques; evaluate and recommend adoption where applicable

Responsibility Area: Mentorship & Technical Influence

•    Mentor junior and mid-level engineers (IC2/IC3) through pair programming, design reviews, architecture discussions, and hands-on coaching

•    Conduct thorough code reviews, including evaluation of prompts, agent logic, retrieval strategies, and AI/model behavior validation

•    Identify technical debt and improvement opportunities; advocate for and lead initiatives to address them

•    Share knowledge through documentation, brown-bag sessions, and architectural guidance

•    Contribute to hiring and interview processes; provide technical assessment and feedback on engineering candidates

•    Model best practices in software craftsmanship, testing discipline, and debugging methodology

•    Support onboarding of new team members and ensure knowledge transfer across projects

Responsibility Area: Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

•    Work closely with product management, domain specialists, and other engineering teams to define requirements and technical specifications

•    Translate complex technical concepts and AI trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders (product, leadership, customers)

•    Lead root cause analysis for customer-reported issues, including those involving model behavior, hallucinations, retrieval quality, and distributed system complexity

•    Participate in design reviews, technical planning sessions, and retrospectives; contribute perspectives on technical feasibility and risk

•    Communicate clearly about design decisions, implementation challenges, AI limitations, and production incidents

•    Build and maintain relationships with adjacent teams and external partners where applicable

•    Proactively identify opportunities to improve development processes, tooling, and team efficiency

Responsibility Area: Software Development Excellence

•    Develop robust, maintainable, and well-tested AI-native software using Python, Java, and JavaScript as appropriate

•    Build comprehensive unit tests, integration tests, and AI evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, hallucination detection)

•    Troubleshoot complex issues in distributed systems, probabilistic models, and cloud infrastructure; isolate root causes efficiently

•    Implement secure coding practices and responsible AI guardrails throughout the development lifecycle

•    Manage deployment, monitoring, and iteration of features in production; respond to performance issues and model drift

•    Work with cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), managed AI services (Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI), Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines

•    Contribute to code and architecture standards; ensure adherence to established best practices

Responsibility Area: ServiceNow Platform Development

•    Design and develop custom applications, extensions, and integrations on the ServiceNow platform

•    Develop workflows, business rules, and automation using ServiceNow scripting (JavaScript, GlideScript, REST APIs)

•    Build data models, forms, and dashboards for ServiceNow applications; optimize database queries for performance

•    Integrate third-party AI/ML services and custom APIs with ServiceNow platform services

•    Contribute to and maintain ServiceNow plugin and app architecture; follow ServiceNow best practices and coding standards

•    Participate in ServiceNow upgrades and configuration management; ensure compatibility with platform updates

•    Mentor junior engineers on ServiceNow platform capabilities and development patterns

Responsibility Area: Customer Support & Product Excellence

Job Title: Sr. Pricing Analyst

Location: Atlanta, GA, New York, NY, or Remote, USA

Exemption Status: Full-time, exempt

Who We Are

Impiricus is the first and only AI-powered HCP Engagement Engine. In 2025, Deloitte named Impiricus the #1 fastest growing company in North America for their prestigious Fast 500 list. Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, Impiricus was created to transform how life sciences companies support physicians. We ethically connect HCPs to pharma resources, reduce go-to-market costs and accelerate patient access to the treatments they need.

With our unique access to the largest opted-in network of HCPs, their insights, and clinical expertise, we are the leading provider of AI technology and real-time channels that life science companies need to deliver clear, reliable, and evidence-based resources directly into the hands of HCPs. Guided by a council of 2000+ trusted HCP advisors, we ensure every interaction is clinically meaningful, ethically grounded and leads to better patient care.

Job Summary

The Senior Pricing Analyst owns the systems, data, and quantitative backbone of Impiricus's pricing function, and owns day-to-day pricing quote support for the Ascend business. This role is the final point of accountability for the pricing platform (DealHub) as new business models go live, and for the integrity of pricing data across our CRM and finance reporting.

This role combines hands-on ownership of day-to-day deal support including quote strategy, deal history, and pricing on individual deals  with systems and analytics ownership across the pricing function, translating pricing strategy into scalable systems, dynamic pricing logic, and the dashboards the commercial org runs on every day. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and is expected to set the standard for how pricing systems, data, and deal support are administered, not simply execute against someone else's specification.

Responsibilities

Deal Support

• Own day-to-day pricing support on individual deals, including dedicated research into the history and terms of prior deals to inform quoting

• Own quote strategy and quote requests, communicating clearly with sales, deal desk, and leadership stakeholders

• Support structuring and defending non-standard deal terms, and support review of strategic or large deals led by the Pricing Lead

Dynamic & Inventory-Based Pricing

• Own the analysis of supply and demand by therapeutic area and launch stage to set and continuously adjust pricing

• Build, own, and maintain inventory-based dynamic pricing models

DealHub & Pricing Systems Ownership

• Serve as the company's subject-matter expert for DealHub (Impiricus's CPQ platform); own platform administration and track usage across the sales organization

• Translate new business-model logic into DealHub configuration and push changes live as models evolve

• Train sellers on DealHub, track and resolve platform issues, and drive continuous improvement of the system as the single source of truth for pricing

Cross-Product Pricing Analysis & Reporting

• Execute cross-product pricing analyses and pricing optimization initiatives in support of the Pricing Lead and Pricing Strategy Manager

• Build, maintain, and enhance pricing KPI dashboards (average discount, price realization, margin by segment, approval cycle time, floor-price compliance)

• Run recurring analysis of existing product pricing performance across Ascend, Pulse, and Spark and surface findings that inform strategy

Pricing Operations & Data Integrity

• Own HubSpot/CRM data cleanliness and hygiene for all pricing-related fields and deal data

• Support finance reporting and other ad hoc operational requests as the pricing function's operational backbone

Pricing Governance Support

• Help enforce pricing adherence in proposals, SOWs, and contracts

• Support tactical governance, including approval workflows, discount rules, and deal review

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative, business, or related field; advanced degree a plus

• 5+ years of direct experience in pricing, monetization, or related roles, ideally supporting or structuring enterprise deal pricing and quoting in a deal desk or sales-facing pricing capacity; OR strong analytical experience with demonstrated ability to partner effectively with sales teams, even without direct pricing experience

• Demonstrated, hands-on ownership of a CPQ or pricing platform supporting a multi-million dollar book of business, configuring pricing logic, training end users, and driving adoption

• Strong quantitative background with direct experience building supply-and-demand or inventory-based dynamic pricing models

• Advanced Excel skills

• Experience owning CRM data hygiene

• Track record operating autonomously as the final point of accountability for pricing systems and data - setting standards, not just following them

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to train sales teams directly and translate technical pricing logic for non-technical, cross-functional stakeholders

The base salary range for this role is $80,000 - $110,000

Where you land within the range will reflect your skills, experience, and location, while keeping team parity in mind and leaving room for future growth.

Benefits:

Impiricus focuses on taking care of our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents + on-demand healthcare concierge
HSA, FSA & DCFSA: Pre-tax savings options for healthcare and dependent care, with monthly employer contributions to HSA (if enrolled in a high-deductible plan)

Your Work, Your Way: If you’re close to an office, we encourage spending some time in-person to collaborate and connect. If not, remote is always an option.

401(k): Save for your future with tax advantages (and company match!)

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
JOIN THE SLEEP FITNESS MOVEMENT

At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health-conscious consumers in over 30 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, and 2023, and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger.

 

Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up.

 


HIGH STANDARDS. NO APOLOGIES.

We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9-to-5. Our team is deeply committed, often putting in 60+ hours a week –not because we’re told to, but because we’re invested. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it.

 


THE ROLE

The Accounting Manager will be responsible for the management of all accounting operations including revenue recognition, accounts payable (AP), inventory and fixed asset

management, payroll, and cash management. This role is expected to bring expertise in

best in class processes, usage of AI and automation, and systems to enable efficient and scalable accounting operations.

Cross functional collaboration will be a key to success. This role will work closely with the

broader finance function (FP&A, Strategic Finance, Sales) to provide insights and analysis to business partners throughout the organization.

The ideal candidate will bring experience from a public accounting firm, preferably with an audit background, combined with industry experience in a corporate accounting environment. Reporting to the Controller, this role is a key hire in building a best-in-class accounting function capable of supporting the company through its next stage of growth.

 


HOW YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE

 -  Manage the full cycle accounting operations and month-end close including revenue recognition, accounts payable, fixed assets and capital expenditures, payroll, and cash management

 -  Build and utilize AI workflows and tools to create agents and process flows to eliminate manual work; leverage automation capabilities within the company’s ERP and adjacent tools (e.g., AP automation, close management software) to reduce completion time and increase accuracy

 - Drive process improvement in all aspects of accounting and across entities for

efficiency and scalability

 - Develop scalable internal controls within the accounting function and intersections

across the organization; design and maintain a SOX-ready control framework in anticipation of future compliance requirements

 - Manage and continuously improve financial reporting for the company including

understanding and analyzing financial data, and developing and presenting accounting

insights to leadership

 - Work closely with the finance team on monthly financial analysis and insights

as well as budget preparation and inputs

 - Become a trusted business partner to key stakeholders by providing BvA analysis and

insights along with suggested improvements or process changes

 - Support the annual audit and tax compliance; serve as primary liaison to external auditors, managing PBC requests, audit timelines, and resolution of technical accounting matters raised

 - Assist in development, tracking, and performance of accounting KPIs

 - Remain current on accounting pronouncements that are applicable to the company,

inform management of new requirements and changes to financial reporting, and

implement timely




WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

 - Active CPA license

 - Public accounting firm experience required (Big 4 or large regional firm); audit background strongly preferred

 - Industry (corporate/private company) accounting experience required in addition to public accounting firm background

 - At least 5-7 years of progressive accounting and managerial experience

 - Experience building and utilizing AI workflows and agents to automate every day tasks

 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Data mindset

 - Hard-working and high-intensity mindset

Please note that applications will not be reviewed if you do not meet this criteria

 


WHY JOIN EIGHT SLEEP?

Innovation in a culture of excellence

Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness.

 

Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth

From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast-paced environments aiming for high standards.

 

Collaboration with exceptional talent

Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 

Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment

We extend equity participation to every full-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company.

 

Your own Pod - and other great benefits

 - Every Eight Sleep employee receives the very product that defines our mission: a Pod of their own. If you join us you’ll get your own Pod https://www.eightsleep.com/, along with*:

 - Full access to health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents

 - Supplemental life insurance

 - Flexible PTO

 - Commuter benefits to ease your daily commute

 - Paid parental leave

*List of benefits may vary depending on your location

 

At Eight Sleep we continually celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our values by ensuring everyone feels they can flourish and grow. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Product (TS/SCI Required)

jobs.description:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About the role

Vannevar builds an agentic system that helps operators make sense of high-volume mission data and act with greater speed and confidence in sensitive government environments. The system analyzes millions of mission-relevant records to surface high-fidelity recommendations, near-real-time analysis, and decision-ready outputs while integrating into the systems and workflows customers already use.

Our software is designed to augment, not replace, human judgment. Operators remain in control of consequential decisions, with the system helping them understand evidence, investigate recommendations, and move faster with better information.

In this role, you will help expand the product to new missions, datasets, and operating environments. You will work directly with users and technical stakeholders to understand the mission, decide what should be built, and then build and deploy it. The team moves quickly — the first version of this system was deployed to in nine days — while holding a high bar for reliability, security, and usefulness to the people doing the mission.

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad ownership. You will write code, make architectural and product decisions, navigate complex government technical environments, and own outcomes from an initial mission need through production deployment and continued use.

What you’ll do

• Own mission problems end-to-end: understand the user and workflow, determine what good looks like, design the technical approach, build it, deploy it, and own the outcome

• Architect, build, and own the direction for a product deployed directly to customer environments in support of mission-critical use cases

• Work directly with users and senior technical stakeholders to understand mission needs, constraints, existing systems, and where software can have the greatest impact

• Own end-to-end technical delivery for new mission workstreams, from requirements gathering and system design through implementation, deployment, and sustainment

• Write substantial production code across the stack and improve the product's capabilities, performance, and scalability

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners — including engineers, product designers, and mission domain experts — to plan and deliver complex software features

• Support government-facing technical artifacts as needed, including input to RFIs, RFPs, Statements of Work, and white papers

• Navigate and integrate with government IT ecosystems, ensuring solutions meet security, compliance, and operational constraints

• This role is based in NYC, but traveling is required - travel up to 50% to engage directly with mission owners and deliver capabilities in the field

What you should have

• 5+ years as a Full Stack Developer including familiarity with relational databases (like Postgres), caching technologies (like Redis), object storage systems (like S3), and modern front-end frameworks (like React)

• Strong technical judgment and the ability to own ambiguous problems without waiting for a fully specified set of requirements

• Experience developing and deploying software compliant with DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF)

• Experience interfacing with government owned IT systems (for example, data platforms, IdAM providers, SIEM, CDSs, etc)

• Experience working with government IT and program offices to scope technical requirements, architecture, and integrations

• Experience working with end users to scope mission requirements, conduct user testing, and gain product feedback

• Excellent communication and teamwork skills

• Must hold an active U.S. TS Security clearance with SCI Eligibility

What we offer

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Remote friendly with WeWork access

• Unlimited PTO, shared downtime during the federal holiday calendar, and company-wide off time at the end of each year

• 401(k) match

• Lifestyle & wellbeing stipends

• Salary top-up during military reserve duty

• Fully paid parental leave

• Child and pet care reimbursement during travel

Vannevar is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't feel like you're a perfect fit. If you're passionate about contributing to our mission, we'd love to hear from you!

IMPORTANT NOTICE
We are committed to protecting the privacy of all applicants. Official emails from the company will come from an @vannevarlabs.com domain. Under no circumstances will a legitimate representative from our company contact you to request passwords, financial information, or other sensitive personal data. Please be vigilant of potential scams.

Job Description

CSCI Consulting is looking for a SAP Functional Consultant – Materials Management (MM) to support our Department of War client. In this role, the consultant will support the design, configuration, implementation, testing, and sustainment of SAP S/4HANA Materials Management solutions that modernize and optimize procurement, inventory, logistics, and supply chain operations while ensuring compliance with federal standards and SAP best practices.

Responsibilities

• Configure and support SAP S/4HANA MM functionality, including procurement, purchasing, inventory management, material master data, valuation, and vendor management processes

• Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional designs, system configurations, and technical specifications

• Support end-to-end business process integration across SAP modules including Sales & Distribution (SD), Finance (FI), Controlling (CO), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Transportation Management (TM), and Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)

• Participate in Fit-to-Standard workshops, business process design sessions, and solution demonstrations

• Develop Functional Design Documents (FDDs), configuration documentation, test scripts, user guides, and training materials

• Execute and support unit testing, system integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing activities

• Collaborate with developers to define requirements for enhancements, interfaces, reports, workflows, forms, and data conversions

• Support data migration activities, including material masters, vendor records, purchasing documents, inventory data, and pricing information

• Assist with release planning, deployments, and post-production support activities

• Troubleshoot functional issues and provide Tier II/Tier III production support

• Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives

• Support cybersecurity, audit, compliance, and Authority to Operate (ATO) activities as required

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be substituted

• 5+ years of SAP MM functional consulting experience

• Experience implementing or supporting SAP S/4HANA environments

• Strong understanding of procurement, purchasing, inventory management, material master data, vendor master data, source determination, valuation, and physical inventory processes

• Experience developing functional specifications for custom SAP enhancements and integrations

• Experience supporting testing, defect resolution, and production support activities

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance

• Creativity and adaptability in problem-solving

• Ability to work with clients to understand their needs

• Strong organizational and time-management skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Professional presence

• Active Secret clearance

jobs.description:
Motive is a dynamic agency and creative collective operating at the speed of culture. We’re a collective of deep thinkers, creative makers, cultural connoisseurs, and executional aces. If this sounds like a place you would thrive, let’s see if we can make something happen.

ASSOCIATE ACCOUNT DIRECTOR

At this time we are currently only interviewing candidates based in the Denver area.

On any given day you will write briefs, lead creative and partnership initiatives with authority, manage and lead internal and external communications, orchestrate an organized asset delivery plan, be responsible for budgets and timelines, collaborate with creative and other internal and external teams, while managing the delivery of a variety of projects. You’ll be responsible for championing best-in-class work across traditional, social, retail, promotional, partnerships, experiential and more for some of the biggest brands in the world.

Job Responsibilities:

• Independently manage the day-to-day efforts with key clients.

• Serve as key contact for projects and delivery, managing communication and asset distribution, and serving as the central touch point for questions, strategic guidance and support for client teams.

• Manage a variety of work streams which could include TVC, social, events, retail / shopper, POS / POP, digital, partnerships; including creation of timelines, workflows, and budgets.

• Strategically advise clients and develop ideas and solutions that achieve business, marketing and engagement objectives.

• Work with a cross-studio team of art directors, copywriters, experiential leads, digital and social innovators, as well as and other client services teams to ideate and develop concepts for projects and accounts.

• Multi-task and get the work done—on time, within project budgets and exceeding expectations.

• Acquire in-depth knowledge of, and be conversant in, client’s business, industry and competitive landscape.

• Foster client relationships that run deep. Step into the role of your client's "go to" lead, managing proactive communications in an inspiring and professional manner.

• Effectively present strategic and creative platforms to internal and external audiences.

Candidate Requirements:

• A minimum of 7 years of experience managing integrated (read: a combination of traditional, TVC and content, retail, shopper, digital / social partnerships and promotional) projects and accounts in a fast-paced advertising agency.

• Experience managing several clients and projects simultaneously.

• Exemplary organizational skills: you're known for having your finger on the pulse and every detail locked-in.

• Powerhouse communications: you're clear, direct, proactive and kind. You can communicate up, down, and sideways if you have to - building trust, rapport, and relationships in the process.

• Strong understanding of owned social, with experience helping shape strategies that connect brand objectives, audience behaviors and platform opportunities.

• Experience with bringing content to life - leading the development and production of still and video assets from brief through final delivery.

• Experience with partnerships, shared IP, and creative collaborations.

• Experience crafting big idea briefs, and guiding creative concept and design work forward.

• Experience creating and managing budgets and timelines for projects covering all of the above.

• Experience managing team members.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a knack for delivering excellent presentations and building relationships.

• A strong ‘self-starter’ mentality and sense of responsibility.

• A positive, upbeat attitude!

Motive recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We offer an inspiring working environment and great benefits, including low-cost health, dental, and vision plans; unlimited flexible paid time off, 401k with annual match, an employee stock ownership program and more.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Community & Social Media
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Senior Manager, Community & Social Media who will define strategy and lead execution across Geotab's global social media presence and community ecosystem. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Senior Manager, Community & Social Media your key area of responsibility will be defining strategy and leading execution across Geotab's global social media presence and community ecosystem. Operating with a commitment to operational excellence, this leader champions brand authority, trust, and continuous engagement across fleet operators, technology partners, and key industry stakeholders. Key accountabilities include: spearheading a high-impact, results-oriented global social media strategy across a variety of channels to accelerate sustainable community growth across customer, partner, and developer channels. The leader of this team will be responsible for setting and maintaining the content and editorial standards of highest quality to solidify Geotab's market leadership in connected transportation. You will need to work closely with key cross-functional teams in Product, Engineering, Marketing, Corporate Comms, Regional Marketing, Sales and Support.

To be successful in this role you will be a collaborative leader with strong written and verbal communication skills, exceptional editorial judgment, and a coaching, results-oriented leadership style. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong analytical capabilities, deep expertise in B2B social media strategy, and proven experience building and scaling online communities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

How you'll make an impact:

• Develop and own Geotab's global organic social media strategy across platforms like LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram, defining platform-specific content for fleet managers, logistics professionals, and reseller partners.

• Manage editorial calendars, publishing cadences, and real-time community engagement across all organic social channels.

• Build, grow, and moderate Geotab's owned community platforms to drive adoption, active participation, and member retention among customers, partners, and developers.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of social media managers and community specialists while establishing clear goals, performance standards, workflows, and governance frameworks.

• Design and execute strategic community initiatives, including customer advocate programs, reseller/partner forums, industry advisory groups, and live programming (livestreams, webinars, podcasts).

• Develop onboarding, recognition, and engagement programs to convert passive members into active community contributors.

• Establish a social-first content framework, brand voice guidelines, and editorial standards to translate product milestones and thought leadership into engaging, platform-native assets.

• Define and own the KPI framework for community and social channels, delivering regular performance dashboards to leadership and leveraging data to continuously test and iterate strategy.

• Partner with paid media, brand, demand generation, and product marketing teams to align organic and paid strategies, embed social in launches, and champion employee advocacy.

• Serve as a strategic partner to corporate communications and PR, managing social crisis response protocols and escalation playbooks to protect brand reputation.

What you'll bring to the role:

• 7–10+ years of progressive experience in social media management, community building, digital marketing, or a related communications discipline.

• Minimum 3–5 years of direct team leadership or people management experience.

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field (an advanced degree like an MBA or Master's in Marketing/Communications is an asset).

• Deep expertise in B2B social media strategy, organic growth, and building/scaling online communities across customer, partner, and developer segments.

• Proficiency with social management and community platforms (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Gainsight Communities, Khoros, Discourse) alongside analytical and listening tools.

• Familiarity with fleet management, telematics, commercial IoT, or B2B SaaS industries, with familiarity in SEO and AEO principles.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong editorial judgment, collaborative stakeholder management, and crisis response experience.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.

Why job seekers choose Geotab:

Flex working arrangements
Home office reimbursement program
Baby bonus & parental leave top up program
Online learning and networking opportunities
Electric vehicle purchase incentive program
Competitive medical and dental benefits
Retirement savings program

*The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only

How we work:

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!

Geotab verifies candidates' eligibility to work in the United States through E-Verify, an internet-based system operated by U.S. Citizen and Immigration Services.

Other employment statements:

Geotab will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. Additionally, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the Company's legal duty to furnish information.

We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. Geotab provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Geotab complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Geotab expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Geotab's employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge. If you would like more information about our EEO program or wish to file a complaint, please contact our EEO officer, Klaus Boeckers at HRCompliance@geotab.com. For more details, view a copy of the EEOC's Know Your Rights poster. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. jobs.title: Capstone Clinical Faculty (part-time)- Wichita, KS
jobs.description:
Teaching is onsite (in clinical setting) with one of our clinical partners.

Schedule: most commonly 12-hour rotations (7a-7p) for three to four consecutive days.

Capstone Final Clinical Overview:

The course facilitates the student’s transition into professional nursing through an exploration of trends and issues in professional nursing and participation in experiential-based nursing experiences. This culminating clinical practicum focuses on refining skills in the delivery and management of nursing care within the context of legal, ethical and evidence-based practice.

If you are passionate about nursing and advancing your career through the power of education, we invite you to apply today.

In this role, the clinical instructor:

• Implements the College's philosophy, curriculum, program outcomes, and course objectives through clinical teaching and service to the College, community, health system and profession.
• Assumes responsibility for all autonomous aspects of individual teaching assignments.
• Plans clinical experiences for and provides direct supervision and evaluation of nursing students delivering nursing care to an individual or group of individuals.
• Evaluates and provides documented feedback to student on level of performance based on course objectives.
• Is available for remediation of students as required or needed.
• Orients and maintains current knowledge related to agency/clinical policies, procedures, and expectations with the assistance of the agency/clinical personnel.
• Develops and posts written clinical assignments consistent with student's knowledge base, skill competency and individual learning needs.
• Grades homework, quizzes, tests, lab assignments, clinical paperwork and other written work in a timely manner
• May teach didactic course content under supervision of course coordinator.
• Keeps course coordinator informed of all student and agency issues and concerns.
• Reports to the dean or assistant dean: a course coordinator will also provide direct oversight.

You are encouraged to explore this opportunity if you have:

• A master's or doctoral degree in Nursing from a regionally accredited college or university
• An unencumbered professional nursing license in the state of Kansas.
• An IL nursing license will be required before accepting any clinical contract for a given session.
• At least two years professional experience within last five years in the area of instruction as a registered nurse
• Teaching or precepting experience is preferred but not required
• Have genuine passion for nursing, education, and lifelong learning
• Have exceptional subject matter expertise with excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Are eager to serve students and colleagues with passion, respect and care
• Operate with a sense of responsibility and purpose with the desire to enrich colleagues, students and the broader community

Thank you for applying for this outstanding opportunity today!

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is between $1,120 per assignment to $7,245 per assignment, depending on the credit hour assigned to the course.
