jobs.title: Senior / Staff AI Model Engineer
jobs.description:
Clear Street is modernizing the brokerage ecosystem. Founded in 2018, Clear Street is a diversified financial services firm replacing the legacy infrastructure used across capital markets.

We started from scratch by building a completely cloud-native clearing and custody system designed for today's complex, global market. Our platform is fully integrated with central clearing houses and exchanges to support billions in trading volume per day. We've agonized about our data model abstractions, created horizontal scalability, and crafted thoughtful APIs. All so we can provide a best-in-class experience for our clients.

By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we're building the essentials to compete in today's fast-paced markets.

The Team:
The mission of the Clear Street Active team is to provide best execution for every asset class in every market. Active is currently building a new, state-of-the-art, cloud-based trading platform providing high-performance traders access to liquidity venues across multiple asset classes, cutting-edge charting capabilities, and sophisticated order handling with the flexibility to service both the active trader and institutional workflows.

The Role:

• You will own the reliability and quality bar for an AI copilot embedded in an trading platform used by sophisticated investors

• You will design and build evaluation systems that measure correctness, safety, latency, and regression risk across market analysis, portfolio/risk reasoning, and trading workflows (including order placement)

• You will develop and maintain benchmarks: curated “golden sets,” scenario suites, stress/adversarial cases, and continuously refreshed market/regime-based test corpora

• You will build automated quality gates and regression workflows that block releases when key metrics degrade

• You will partner with engineering and product to define safe tool/action contracts (deterministic previews, confirmations, auditability) and ensure predictable assistant behavior

• You will own model improvement loops tied to evals: data collection/labeling strategies, error taxonomy, prompt/tooling changes, and when appropriate, fine-tuning or preference optimization to measurably improve benchmark performance

• You will design and operate monitoring + incident response for AI: telemetry, alerting, RCA, and “fix-forward” processes

• You will develop a deep understanding of trading concepts (margin, shorting, portfolio margin, risk, execution) and how to express them accurately and understandably to users Tech Stack: Rust, TypeScript, Postgres, React (Web), React Native (Mobile), observability/telemetry tooling, LLM APIs + model serving, eval/training pipelines

Requirements:

• At least Eight (8) years of experience shipping production software; strong proficiency with any programming language

• Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals, testing methodology, and systems design

• Experience building evaluation frameworks, test harnesses, and benchmark suites for complex systems (LLMs/agents/search/retrieval/ranking/recommenders)

• Experience running model improvement cycles: dataset curation, labeling/QA, offline experimentation, and deploying changes with measurable impact on benchmarks

• Ability to define metrics, build measurement pipelines, and drive engineering/product decisions from data

• Comfort working across the stack: debugging model/tooling failures, instrumenting services, and partnering with frontend/product on UX patterns that improve safety and trust

• High degree of self-motivation and willingness to jump into unfamiliar areas to solve problems

Bonus:

• Experience with fine-tuning, preference optimization, distillation, or prompt/compiler-style techniques for improving tool-use reliability

• Experience creating domain-specific benchmarks and adversarial suites (e.g., “known-bad” scenarios) for high-stakes applications

• Deep experience with trading across asset classes, margin types, etc.

• Experience with Rust and performance-sensitive services

• Experience designing incident response and SLOs for ML/AI systems

At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, 401k matching, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical, dental and vision insurance. In-office benefits include lunch stipends, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, a great location, and amazing views.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Leadership

• Contribute to driving the overall QA strategy for Kubernetes and cloud-native environments, aligning quality goals with business objectives and release deadlines.
• Evaluate and champion best-in-class testing best practices and frameworks for distributed systems.
• Lead risk analysis and test planning for large-scale, multi-cloud infrastructure and container orchestration.

Architecting Test Systems

• Architect test frameworks and infrastructure for validating microservices and infrastructure components in multi-cluster and hybrid-cloud environments.
• Oversee the design of complex test scenarios simulating production-like workloads, resource scaling, failure injection, and recovery across distributed clusters.

Automation & Scalability

• Spearhead the development of scalable and maintainable test automation integrated with CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.).
• Leverage Kubernetes APIs, Helm, and service mesh tools to build comprehensive automation coverage, including system health, failover behavior, and network resilience.
• Promote test infrastructure-as-code and drive IaC forward on the team making sure the infrastructure code is repeatable, extensible and reliable.

Mentorship & Technical Influence

• Mentor QA engineers and developers in advanced testing techniques such as: risk-based testing, chaos engineering, performance and load testing etc.
• Serve as the QA authority in design reviews, production readiness assessments, and incident retrospectives(escaped defects).

Collaborate with and devops engineers to refine monitoring, alerting, and debugging strategies for testing automation being run in CI/CD.

Quality Advocacy & Continuous Improvement

• Establish quality gates, release readiness metrics, and data driven feedback loops to ensure released software is production quality.
• Drive initiatives to integrate performance, security, and chaos testing into the development lifecycle.
• Advocate for a culture of quality across teams and influence architecture decisions with testing in mind.

Qualifications and Skills

Education

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

• 10+ years in software testing or quality engineering roles, with 4+ years focused on Kubernetes, cloud-native applications, and distributed systems.
• Proven leadership experience in building and scaling test strategies in enterprise-grade environments.

Technical Proficiency

• Deep understanding of Kubernetes internals, cluster lifecycle management, Helm, service meshes (e.g., Istio or Linkerd), and network policies.
• Strong scripting and automation capabilities (Python, Pytest, Bash, etc.).
• Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger), Kubernetes security (RBAC, secrets management), and performance benchmarking tools (e.g., K6).
• Solid grounding in cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), infrastructure provisioning, and containerized CI/CD.
• Moderate to advanced linux knowledge and proficiency is required: Bash scripting and debugging, systemd/logs, networking/firewalling/routing, certificate/PKI management, containers (Docker/containerd), and Kubernetes tooling (kubectl/Helm with OCI registries, GitOps/Flux) to install, test, and troubleshoot multi-cluster environments.

Leadership & Collaboration

• Exceptional problem-solving and architectural thinking.
• Experience influencing cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills for technical and executive-level audiences.
• Mentorship and coaching of 1 or more junior members on the team especially around testing fundamentals, troubleshooting and automation.

Preferred Extras

• Contributions to open-source Kubernetes or QA tooling projects.
• Experience implementing chaos engineering in Kubernetes environments.
• Certifications such as CKA, CKAD, or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer.

What does Mirantis offer you?

• Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
• Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
• Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
• Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
• Professional development and training;
• Attend conferences and working groups;
• Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;

We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking.

Woolpert is an award-winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting-edge technology to deliver exceptional client value. Our team is passionate about their work and committed to building the next generation of industry leaders, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, Woolpert embraces progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth.

Position Overview:

Woolpert is hiring a Sr. Manager, Procurement to join our dynamic Finance team. This position will be responsible for managing strategic procurement transformation and category management activities to help build a scalable, data-driven, and world-class procurement organization. Leading the development and implementation of the future-state procurement operating model, including current-state assessment and maturity, future-state organization design,
processes, technology, policies and procedures, governance, and KPIs. Owning strategic sourcing, category strategy, supplier performance and risk management, vendor contract management, spend analytics, and procurement reporting, while partnering with Finance, Legal, Operations, IT, BI and Analytics, and business leaders to deliver measurable value, improve supplier outcomes, increase spend visibility, and strengthen procurement decision-making. Developing and maintaining a comprehensive spend analysis capability and holistic procurement dashboards, ensuring ongoing insight into savings, supplier performance, contract coverage, risk, and strategic sourcing opportunities. Providing leadership and influence across the organization while distinguishing strategic procurement responsibilities from tactical requisition, purchase order, and invoice review activities managed through operational procurement processes.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.  Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do:

• Manage procurement managers and/or supervisors across multiple spend areas, sites, or business units, including hiring terminating, performance appraisals, and pay reviews.

• Directs the development and implementation of procurement strategies aligned with organizational goals for cost optimization and supply chain reliability.

• Supports the development and implementation of the future-state procurement operating model, including current-state procurement assessment and maturity, future-state organization design, processes, enabling technology, policies and procedures, governance model, and procurement KPIs.

• Develops category strategies and multi-year sourcing roadmaps across major spend areas, using spend, risk, complexity, supplier market dynamics, and business impact to prioritize strategic sourcing activity.

• Standardizes the procure-to-pay process, approval workflow, and application of procurement policy and delegation-of-authority thresholds across teams.

• Establishes and owns procurement KPIs — purchase order cycle time, contract compliance rate, cost savings and avoidance, supplier on-time-in-full, and purchase price variance — and holds managers accountable to them.

• Develops and maintains a comprehensive and ongoing procurement spend analysis cube, including visibility by vendor, category, business unit, geography, project, contract coverage, savings pipeline, tail spend, and supplier concentration.

• Develops a holistic procurement set of Power BI reports and dashboards, with support from the BI and Analytics team, and ensures ongoing maintenance, adoption, and business relevance of procurement reporting.

• Approves higher-value awards and resolves escalated procurement issues, including budget impact, investigation of supply sources, proposals, and bids.

• Directs supplier selection and evaluation based on cost, quality, reliability, and risk, and oversees supplier performance reviews, assessments, and corrective action plans.

• Establishes a supplier performance and risk management structure, including supplier segmentation, scorecards, business reviews, issue escalation, corrective action plans, and risk monitoring for critical or high-impact suppliers.

• Owns the procurement risk register, including supply disruption, quality, geopolitical, and single-source exposure, and directs mitigation plans.

• Evaluates, selects, and leads the rollout of procurement technologies and tools that improve efficiency, spend visibility, and automation.

• Establishes and oversees a vendor contract management process and enabling technology, including contract repository governance, renewal tracking, obligation management, commercial term visibility, SLA monitoring, and coordination with Legal, Finance, IT, and business owners.

• Manages the consolidated procurement budget for assigned spend areas, tracks expenditures, and implements cost control measures and savings initiatives.

• Builds, prioritizes, and reports a procurement savings and value creation pipeline, partnering with Finance to validate realized savings, cost avoidance, risk reduction, and operational value delivered through strategic sourcing initiatives.

• Allocates buying capacity, staffing, and resources across teams based on demand, spend, and risk within objectives defined by upper management.

• Partners with Finance, Legal, Operations, and project leadership to align procurement plans with business needs and reporting requirements.

• Reports procurement performance, savings, and risk position to senior leadership and ensures compliance with internal controls and ethical purchasing standards.

• Builds the management bench by developing supervisors and managers and by establishing succession and capability plans for the procurement organization.

What You Will Bring:

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required.

• Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered on a 1:1 basis.

• 12 years of progressive procurement, purchasing, or sourcing experience.

• Experience managing first-level managers and/or supervisors, including hiring, performance management, and pay decisions.

• Experience owning a procurement budget and delivering cost savings, contract compliance, and supplier performance targets.

• Experience negotiating and awarding supply agreements and resolving escalated supplier and commercial issues.

• Experience developing category strategies, strategic sourcing pipelines, spend analytics capabilities, supplier performance programs, and contract management processes in support of procurement transformation.

• Broad knowledge of strategic procurement, category management, strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract lifecycle management, spend analytics, procurement governance, and the procure-to-pay cycle.

• Proven leadership skills, with the ability to set direction for managers and supervisors and to make decisions based on business objectives and allocated resources.

• Ability to develop and standardize procurement policy, controls, and process across multiple teams or business units. • Skilled in supplier negotiation, evaluation, and performance management, including scorecards, reviews, and corrective action.

• Ability to analyze spend, cost structures, and budget impact and to translate findings into savings and risk mitigation actions.

• Ability to define business requirements for procurement reporting, dashboards, and data models, including spend analysis cubes, Power BI dashboards, supplier scorecards, savings tracking, and contract compliance reporting.

• Working proficiency with ERP and procure-to-pay systems, spend analytics, and supplier management tools.

• Experience establishing procurement operating models, policies, procedures, governance forums, stakeholder engagement models, and change management approaches that support adoption of procurement processes and tools.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present procurement performance and risk to senior leadership.

• Ability to resolve cross-business-unit conflicts involving cost, quality, schedule, and risk.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master's degree or higher in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 15 years of procurement or sourcing experience, including multi-site or multi business-unit responsibility.

• Experience leading procurement technology or automation implementations, such as P2P, spend analytics, or supplier portals.

• Experience implementing or maturing procurement analytics, contract lifecycle management, supplier performance management, eSourcing, spend cube, ERP, or Power BI-enabled procurement reporting capabilities.

• Experience with procurement in a professional services, engineering, or government-contracting environment, including flow-down and compliance requirements.

• Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM), Certified Purchasing Manager (C.P.M.), or Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP).

• Knowledge of supply market trends, category management, and total cost of ownership analysis.

• Knowledge of ethical and sustainable purchasing standards and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Ability to coach and develop managers toward the next level of responsibility.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS:

• Work is performed primarily in an office or remote office environment with prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.

• Must be able to communicate clearly, in person, by telephone, and in virtual meetings.

• May require occasional work outside of standard business hours to meet business or supplier deadlines.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

Benefits You Will Love

Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. jobs.title: Head of Associate AE
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Serval http://serval.com is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations.

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. 




HEAD OF ASSOCIATE AE PROGRAM


As the Head of the Associate AE Program, you'll build and lead Serval's founding early-career sales program. It's a highly selective, cohort-based apprenticeship that turns exceptional early-career talent into Serval's next generation of Account Executives and GTM leaders. You'll own the program end to end: recruiting, curriculum delivery, coaching, and graduation. Meanwhile, your Associate AEs will generate real pipeline needed to drive growth across every segment of our business. You'll report to our VP of Mid-Market and work closely with our founders, sales leadership, marketing, RevOps and enablement. Together, you'll make this the fastest and most respected path into an AE seat in AI.



This role is ideal for a builder who has hired and developed high-performing SDR or early-career sales teams, loves building from 0 to 1 and operating with ambiguity and within a hyper-growth company, loves teaching as much as driving pipeline, and wants to create a program rather than simply inherit an org.


This role is based in either San Francisco or New York and will have an office requirement.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and launch the Associate AE Program from the ground up, defining cohort structure, hiring profiles, curriculum and graduation criteria, starting with a founding cohort of 4-6 Associates.

 - Recruit and hire each cohort with an uncompromising bar: early-career talent with exceptional intellectual horsepower, grit, coachability and a track record of excellence.

 - Run a 6-9 month, three-phase program to simultaneously build pipeline for the company while also developing Associates into top AE talent

 - Coach Associates through call reviews, mock discovery, objection handling, demo certification and deal strategy, and drive results towards qualified pipeline targets.

 - Own pipeline results across segments: intent coverage, speed-to-lead, outbound into unassigned accounts, and follow-through on field and ABM programs. Success is measured by qualified pipeline and stage conversion, not inefficient activity.

 - Build the apprenticeship model by pairing Associates with top AEs and sales managers. Move Associates step by step toward running discovery, delivering demos and eventually owning smaller deals end to end.

 - Get the whole company teaching: recruit AEs, marketers, product leaders and executives to own and deliver curriculum modules, and build a reusable training library that grows with each cohort.

 - Partner with sales leadership on graduation. Define the bar, run readiness reviews and test-outs; place graduates into AE roles where receiving managers are excited to hire them.

 - Implement the program's operating rhythm and economics: ROI model, pipeline per Associate, and hiring forecasts tied to future AE demand.

 - Build a world-class, destination program. Work with marketing and leadership on employer brand, university and alumni partnerships, and recruiting events that attract top-tier talent.



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including at least 2 years leading and developing SDR, BDR or early-career sales orgs.

 - Prior experience as a quota-carrying AE, ideally having come up through the SDR path yourself, so you can teach full-cycle selling and not just prospecting.

 - A proven track record of developing reps who were promoted into closing roles and went on to succeed.

 - An obsession with pipeline and metrics, with strong command of conversion data, forecasting and CRM discipline.

 - Exceptional coaching and teaching ability, with experience building curriculum, certifications or enablement programs.

 - A high hiring bar and strong instincts for spotting raw talent, whether that's a proven SDR or an exceptional recent graduate.

 - Credibility with senior AEs, sales leaders and executives, and the ability to work cross-functionally to build a high impact program.

 - Experience selling to, or coaching reps who sell to, technical buyers in IT, Security or Engineering.

 - Based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco or New York and work from our office five days a week.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building or running an Associate AE, rotational or leadership development program.

 - Leadership experience at fellow AI-native companies.

 - Experience launching a program from 0 → 1 and scaling it cohort over cohort.

 - Familiarity with sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, etc.) and modern sales tech (Salesforce, Gong, Amplemarket, Claude, Nooks, Clay, etc.).

 - Experience partnering with universities, alumni networks or campus recruiting teams.

 - Ambition to grow into a broader sales leadership role.



WHAT WE OFFER

 - Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company, and build the talent engine behind Serval's future GTM team.

 - Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

 - Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

Chamberlain College of Nursing needs qualified Adult Health/Medical-Surgical Clinical Faculty (Part-Time) in our Bachelor's of Science in Nursing program in Jacksonville, Florida.

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

.

VML

Freelance Senior Copywriter / Content Designer – Experience Design

Role Summary

VML seeking a Freelance Senior Copywriter / Content Designer to lead language strategy and execution across campaigns, CRM programs, digital products, and multi-channel experiences. This role sits at the intersection of copywriting, UX/UI, brand, and experience design, translating business and brand objectives into clear, compelling, and strategically connected content.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on writer who can develop messaging frameworks, voice and tone systems, naming, campaign concepts, UX content, and modular content for scalable digital experiences. They are comfortable working directly in design environments such as Figma, collaborating closely with UX/UI designers, strategists, creative directors, technology teams, and clients.

This role also embraces AI-enabled content development, testing, synthesis, and optimization, using emerging tools to accelerate exploration while maintaining high standards for originality, accessibility, accuracy, brand equity, and user trust.

Experience in CRM, healthcare/pharmaceutical marketing, regulated environments, and advertising or marketing communications is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead strategic copywriting and content strategy across digital ecosystems, campaigns, CRM programs, products, and customer journeys.

• Develop compelling, audience-centered messaging that translates brand and business objectives into meaningful experiences.

• Define and evolve voice, tone, editorial standards, messaging frameworks, naming systems, and content principles.

• Write and refine campaign concepts, headlines, body copy, UX/UI content, CRM communications, calls to action, and other customer-facing experiences.

• Prototype and iterate language directly within design environments, collaborating with UX/UI designers throughout the creative process.

• Partner with UX, UI, CX, CRM, strategy, data, technology, creative, and project management teams to create cohesive end-to-end experiences.

• Contribute copy and content thinking across both UX and UI workflows, bringing a strong understanding of user-centered design and the consumer journey.

• Create scalable, modular content systems that support consistency and efficient production across platforms and channels.

• Ensure content meets accessibility standards and is optimized for usability, engagement, and relevant search practices.

• Use AI tools to generate, test, synthesize, compare, and refine content concepts while applying strong editorial judgment and maintaining brand integrity.

• Apply iterative testing, optimization, and data-informed learning to improve content performance.

• Present, articulate, and defend strategic and creative work with senior clients and stakeholders.

• Mentor junior writers and contribute to team rituals, feedback, creative development, and professional growth.

• Help establish and advocate for strong content craft and consistent language standards across teams and client engagements.

• Navigate complex stakeholder environments, including regulated healthcare and pharmaceutical communications where applicable.

Qualifications & Experience

• 5–7+ years of professional copywriting, content design, content strategy, or closely related experience.

• Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, English, advertising, or a related discipline; master’s degree preferred.

• Demonstrated experience in an advertising agency, marketing communications, or experience-design environment; agency experience strongly preferred.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional copywriting, content strategy, UX/content design, campaign, and digital experience work.

• Experience developing content across campaigns, digital products, CRM, and multi-channel customer journeys.

• Proven ability to develop and manage voice, tone, editorial, messaging, and naming systems.

• Working knowledge of UX/UI design principles, user-centered design, responsive digital experiences, accessibility, and modern content practices.

• Experience working directly with designers and prototyping content within Figma or comparable design tools.

• CRM experience and an understanding of campaign management, customer journeys, optimization, and personalization.

• Healthcare and/or pharmaceutical client experience is highly desirable, including familiarity with regulated environments and complex stakeholder requirements.

• Experience using AI tools to enhance creative exploration, content development, testing, synthesis, and production.

• Understanding of content strategy frameworks, iterative testing, data-informed optimization, and emerging digital standards.

• Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and client-management skills.

• Ability to work independently, manage priorities and deadlines, and operate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

• High EQ, mature judgment, and an ego-free approach to collaboration and creative problem-solving.

• T-shaped experience: deep expertise in Copywriting and content creation with strong working knowledge of UX, UI, strategy, CRM, and experience design.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will elevate the quality and effectiveness of digital experiences through exceptional writing and content strategy. They will create language systems that are clear, scalable, accessible, and distinctive; strengthen the connection between brand and user experience; and bring strategic copywriting thinking into every stage of the design process.

Success means becoming a trusted creative partner to clients and multidisciplinary teams—someone who can move fluidly from big-picture messaging strategy to a single headline, UX interaction, CRM communication, or design-system content pattern, while using AI and emerging tools thoughtfully to improve speed, exploration, and quality.

The compensation for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package. Click WPP Benefits for more details.

_

$65—$80 USD

The U.S. Army CPE ST3 sustains a portfolio of more than 370 simulation, training, testing, and threat products fielded at over 400 locations worldwide, supporting U.S. and Allied warfighters’ combat readiness, interoperability, and multi-domain operational effectiveness — with growth into areas such as artificial intelligence, cyber and information warfare, robotics and autonomous systems, directed energy, and hypersonics. As the Jira Reporting & Analytics Lead, you will own the metrics, dashboards, and data storytelling that make CPE ST3’s Agile transformation visible and defensible — first in Barbaricum’s Phase II live Jira technical demonstration (anticipated late October 2026), then in the operational environment after award. This is not a traditional Jira administrator role. You will build the role-based, multi-tier dashboards that give executive (CPE), program (PM/PL, PdM/PdL), and project-level leaders instant visibility into sprint velocity, cycle time, capacity utilization, and flow — eliminating manual data calls — and you will analyze the Government-provided baseline data to recommend concrete, data-driven improvements to how APS work is managed.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Design and build advanced Jira reports and role-based dashboards for executive, portfolio, and team tiers, tailored to CPE, PM/PL, and PdM/PdL audiences

• Author and optimize JQL to surface the right data for each dashboard and audience

• Develop and track flow and delivery analytics: capacity utilization, velocity, cycle time, throughput, and blockers

• Analyze the Government-provided baseline data set and develop data-driven approaches and recommendations that improve APS delivery outcomes (supporting the three recommended approaches evaluated in the Jira demonstration)

• Design clear data visualizations that communicate actionable status at a glance

• Stand up and maintain the live Agile Dashboard (CDRL A003) within 30 days of contract award, providing the Government real-time, unfettered access to the tool, dashboard, and data, and incorporating Government feedback each sprint

• Integrate Jira reporting with Power BI and Confluence to extend and publish metrics

• Present metrics and findings to senior Government leadership and translate them into process improvements

• Support the live demonstration by producing and driving the dashboards used to respond to scenario injects

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Active Secret clearance

• Bachelor’s degree in a related or quantitative field, or equivalent experience

• 6+ years building advanced Jira reporting and dashboards in an enterprise environment

• Expert-level JQL

• Demonstrated experience developing executive-, portfolio-, and team-level Agile metrics

• Hands-on experience with capacity-utilization, velocity, cycle-time, and flow analytics

• Dashboard and data-visualization design skills, including role-based dashboards for executives and program managers

• Experience delivering and operating live, always-on operational dashboards with direct stakeholder access to the underlying tool and data — not static or periodic reports

• Ability to analyze delivery data and recommend actionable process improvements

• Available to support the anticipated Phase II Jira technical demonstration (~late October 2026) and post-award operations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Principal Agent Strategist
jobs.description:
Building Healthcare That Remembers 

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to. 

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 270 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways. 

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C https://www.assorthealth.com/blog/assort-health-raises-120-million-series-c-to-scale-largest-deployment-of-ai-agents-for-the-patient-journey at a $1.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.




THE ROLE

Assort Health is changing how healthcare organizations connect patients with care through AI. We’re hiring a Principal Agent Strategist to lead our largest and most important customer partnerships.

You’ll work directly with C-suite and operating leaders, own complex relationships from launch through expansion, and help customers turn ambitious goals into measurable results. You’ll coordinate teams across Assort, navigate high-stakes decisions, and ensure each partnership delivers lasting value.

This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful influence across the company. You’ll help shape our product, mentor other Agent Strategists, and define how the function scales.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Define outcomes, success measures, risks, growth opportunities, and plans for delivering ROI.

 - Build trust with C-suite stakeholders and guide decisions about AI, operations, and growth.

 - Coordinate governance, decisions, timelines, and workstreams across Assort and the customer.

 - Protect retention, lead renewals, and identify meaningful expansion opportunities.

 - Bring customer insights into product, implementation, and business decisions.

 - Mentor other Agent Strategists and improve the playbooks used across the function.

 - Travel up to 25% for executive meetings, presentations, and customer work.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience owning large, high-value accounts across adoption, retention, renewal, and expansion.

 - Strong executive communication, commercial judgment, and the ability to navigate complex organizations.

 - Experience leading programs across multiple teams, workstreams, and senior stakeholders.

 - Strong product aptitude, analytical thinking, and the ability to learn technical concepts quickly.

 - The ability to influence without authority, mentor others, and improve how a team operates.

 - Sound judgment, clear prioritization, and comfort making decisions with limited information.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience working in healthcare, health tech, or another highly regulated industry.

 - Experience helping enterprise customers adopt AI, automation, or other technical products.

 - Experience building customer programs, processes, or playbooks from the ground up.

 - Experience at an early-stage startup or rapidly growing SaaS company.




BENEFITS & PERKS FOR ASSORTIES

 - 💸 Competitive Compensation – Including salary and employee stock options so you share in our success.

 - 📚 Lifelong Learning – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.

 - 💻 Office Setup Stipend – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.

 - 🩺 Top-Tier Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.

 - 🏖 Flexible PTO – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.

 - 🥗 Meals & Snacks – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.

 - 💪 Fitness Stipend – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.

 - 🚆 Commuter Benefits – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.

 - 👵 401(k) – Build your retirement savings.
   
   


HOW WE WORK & WHAT WE VALUE

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide how we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a Day One Drive, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a 5-Star Focus, as our customers are our lifeblood, always Answer the Call, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with One Pulse, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: All Source Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are (video)

At JRC, we tackle some of the toughest challenges faced by the Department of Defense (DoD) and other government agencies. Our expertise in engineering innovation and semiconductor technologies allows us to deliver mission-critical microelectronics solutions, aerospace systems engineering, and cutting-edge research and development. By joining JRC, you’ll be part of a team that supports strategic deterrence and defense missions, playing a crucial role in ensuring the safety and security of the United States and its allies.

Join JRC's Missiles and Space Team!

We are actively searching for an experienced mid-level All Source Analyst to work collaboratively with our our US Navy customer and Science and Technology Intelligence Liaison Office (STILO) to develop and manage the intelligence briefs that affect our customers programs.

As an All Source Analyst  with JRC, you will...

• Conducting comprehensive all-source intelligence analysis to identify, evaluate, and report on terrorism and counterterrorism threats to the United States and its global interests.

• Producing daily intelligence outputs such as situational updates, threat assessments, and analytical summaries to support ongoing mission objectives.

• Researching and synthesizing information from multiple intelligence streams to deliver timely, accurate assessments of emerging threats, trends, and terrorist activities.

• Responding to analytical taskings and customer requirements by creating concise, well-supported intelligence products and providing prompt answers to information requests.

• Developing intelligence reports using databases, mapping systems, visualization tools, and graphics to clearly present complex analytical insights.

• Collaborating closely with Intelligence Community partners, Department of State teams, and other government agencies to coordinate reporting, validate information, and build comprehensive assessments.

• Applying Intelligence Community analytic standards, including ICD 203 and ICD 206, to ensure products are objective, accurate, thoroughly sourced, and analytically sound.

• Presenting intelligence briefings and oral updates to leadership, stakeholders, and customers on current and emerging terrorism-related threats.

• Identifying intelligence gaps, conducting targeted research, and recommending additional collection or analysis to address evolving mission needs.

• Tracking global terrorism developments and maintaining situational awareness of relevant threats, entities, regions, and events critical to U.S. national security.

• Supporting continuous operational demands, including shift-based work and rapidly shifting priorities, while maintaining high-quality intelligence reporting.

• Building effective working relationships with mission partners and customers to understand their needs and provide actionable, mission-focused analysis.

• Using critical thinking, advanced research, and analytical skills to evaluate complex and sometimes conflicting information and produce reliable intelligence judgments.

• Analyzing historical and current reporting, operational data, and other relevant sources to identify emerging threats and long-term patterns.

What you bring to the table:

• Clearance: An active DoD TOP SECRET Security with SCI Eligibility Clearance

• Education: Bachelor's degree

• Prior experience working with an intelligence community department or agency.

• Ability to convey complex information clearly, concisely, and accurately in both technical and non-technical contexts

• Experience:

• 2+ years of experience with the intelligence community

• Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where requirements can change mid-process and rework is required under a compressed timeframe

Bonus Points for...

• Experience and application of Intelligence Community Directives (ICD) 203 and 206.

• Experience supporting continuous mission operations with the ability to support shift differentials

• Experience with Department of the Navy

At JRC we offer...

• A competitive compensation package

• An exceptional employee benefits program, providing support for our team members' well-being and success

• The chance to contribute to a high-profile Department of Defense programs and make a positive impact

Build the Future with Us — Forge & Build is Hiring a Store Manager

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

Forge & Build is hiring a Store Manager at our facility in Elwood, KS, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. The Store Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day operations, including driving store sales and profitability, managing inventory and expenses, and ensuring optimal stocking and merchandising. This role requires leading the store staff, delivering superior customer service, coordinating receiving and dispatch, and upholding all company safety standards.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Includes working weekends)

Primary Responsibilities

• Leadership & Development: Provide leadership, mentorship, and development for all store associates and direct reports.

• Financial Management: Deliver on sales and profitability goals, and maintain P&L accountability by effectively managing expense, receivables, sales, and payroll budgets.

• Compliance & Safety: Ensure adherence to all company practices, operational policies, procedures, and regulated safety compliance, fostering a positive employee safety environment.

• Operations & Standards: Oversee all aspects of store operations, including inventory management, merchandising, and maintaining store and yard standards.

• Customer Experience: Proactively assist customers, manage complaints, and cultivate a positive store culture that provides a superior customer experience and positive brand representation.

• Inventory Control: Implement and maintain processes to mitigate inventory shrink.

• Store Maintenance: Identify, communicate, and address all necessary store maintenance issues.

• Change Management: Implement, execute, and maintain all company operational changes throughout the store.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent)

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

About Forge & Build

Forge & Build is a place contractors and customers can access all the materials and hardware they need to get the job done, as well as tech-powered equipment rentals.

At its foundation, Forge & Build was started by contractors for contractors. Its leadership team is different from our competitors because they know what it feels like to be a builder. They remember walking into a hardware store hoping to find everything in one place, but many times having to head to another store.

As a partner of EquipmentShare, Forge & Build is backed by one of the largest construction equipment buyers in the country, a nationwide support team and T3 technology that helps builders of America increase overall productivity, efficiency, and visibility. EquipmentShare is building connectivity for all verticals in construction including materials – which means having accurate and up-to-date information around inventory and location of materials to ensure our customers always have what they need.

Skills & Qualifications

Required Skills/Abilities:

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong understanding of P&L metrics and the ability to execute on KPIs for driving profit.

• Strong ability to build and maintain internal and external business relationships.

• Proficiency with electronic technology and Google applications, with the ability to learn and implement new technology advancements.

• Ability to calculate and understand board foot and market pricing within the industry.

• Operational expertise in inventory control and the ability to train associates on proper techniques and guidelines.

• Comprehensive knowledge of store and yard layout, and the ability to learn and suggest improvements for store products and operations.

• Ability to work 45+ hours per week.

Education and Experience:

• Previous retail management experience is required (2+ years preferred), preferably in a lumber or home center environment.

• Proven experience leading and supervising team members.

• Experience managing store inventory.

• Preferred knowledge of building processes and estimating.

• Preferred experience buying and selling lumber and building materials.

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to perform prolonged periods of computer work, standing, walking, and sitting.

• Ability to move and change store layouts, including the capacity to lift up to 50 lbs at a time.

• Tolerate exposure to external temperatures when assisting customers outdoors.

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

jobs.description:
You would own incident communications during live events, the quarterly operational review with TCH, and the evidence package for supervisory examination. You would also lead the team that onboards and certifies institutions onto the network, including those joining through Quant's Tokenized Deposits-as-a-Service solution.

The network is expected to launch in the first half of 2027. The technology will probably be new to you. The discipline will not be, and the discipline is the job.

You will need

• Service delivery or service management leadership for a financial institution, through service levels that mattered.
• Major incident management. You have been the communications point during a live event.
• To have prepared evidence for a regulator or an examiner.
• To write clearly under pressure. This matters more here than almost anywhere else on the team.

Useful, not essential

• Onboarding or certifying institutional clients onto a platform.
• Payments or transaction banking.
• ITIL Foundation or higher.

There is more to this than we can put in an advertisement. If it sounds like your kind of problem, apply and we will tell you the rest on a call.

About Quant

Almost all the money in the economy is commercial bank money, and almost none of it moves on chain. Quant is a leading provider of programmable money infrastructure, and our technology changes that: it lets banks issue, move and settle tokenized deposits around the clock, automatically and securely, while staying connected to the systems they already run on. It is already deployed in regulated environments with central and commercial banks in the UK and around the world, including work on the digital pound and the digital euro.

The Clearing House, whose networks clear and settle more than $2 trillion a day, has now selected Quant to power its On-Chain Money Initiative: a new interoperable payments network that will let financial institutions of all sizes clear and settle tokenized deposits, with connectivity to the RTP® and CHIPS® networks. Our technology provides the network's interoperability, orchestration and transaction-management layer, enabling payments that settle immediately and transactions that trigger automatically once agreed conditions are met.

Through our Tokenized Deposits-as-a-Service solution, banks of any size can join without building new infrastructure themselves. The network is expected to become available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027, with use cases across corporate treasury, liquidity management, cross-border payments and digital asset settlement. We are building the New York team that will run it.

Our Water Technology Business has an exciting opportunity available for a Field Service Engineer. The Field Service Engineer will be responsible for managing all aspects of water treatment plant commissioning, installation, and optimization, serving as a key interface between design engineering, construction teams, control systems, and customers.

In this role, you will work with engineering, operations, corporate, security, and business teams to define project strategy and requirements, manage project metrics, and ensure consistency across the program.

jobs.description:
That covers a 24/7 SOC working inside TCH's security tooling, the PKI lifecycle under TCH's governance, threat intelligence, on-chain analytics through providers such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs and Elliptic, and incident response end to end, alongside Platform Reliability, since most serious incidents here are both security and availability events.

Ahead of an expected launch in the first half of 2027, much of the security model is being established rather than inherited. You would establish it, then prove it to people whose job is to find the gap.

You will need

• To have led security operations in financial services or another regulated industry.
• To have built or run a function with continuous coverage, and to know the difference between an alert and a signal.
• PKI and certificate lifecycle ownership at scale.
• To have produced evidence for a regulator. A great deal of this job is being able to prove what you did and why you took the action that you did.
• A recognized security certification such as CISSP or GIAC, or one in progress.

Useful, not essential

• Blockchain analytics and on-chain transaction monitoring.
• Operating inside a client's security tooling rather than your own.
• Digital asset custody or exchange security.

There is more to this than we can put in an advertisement. If it sounds like your kind of problem, apply and we will tell you the rest on a call.

About Quant

Almost all the money in the economy is commercial bank money, and almost none of it moves on chain. Quant is a leading provider of programmable money infrastructure, and our technology changes that: it lets banks issue, move and settle tokenized deposits around the clock, automatically and securely, while staying connected to the systems they already run on. It is already deployed in regulated environments with central and commercial banks in the UK and around the world, including work on the digital pound and the digital euro.

The Clearing House, whose networks clear and settle more than $2 trillion a day, has now selected Quant to power its On-Chain Money Initiative: a new interoperable payments network that will let financial institutions of all sizes clear and settle tokenized deposits, with connectivity to the RTP® and CHIPS® networks. Our technology provides the network's interoperability, orchestration and transaction-management layer, enabling payments that settle immediately and transactions that trigger automatically once agreed conditions are met.

Through our Tokenized Deposits-as-a-Service solution, banks of any size can join without building new infrastructure themselves. The network is expected to become available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027, with use cases across corporate treasury, liquidity management, cross-border payments and digital asset settlement. We are building the New York team that will run it.

jobs.description:
You would be TCH's single accountable point of contact on contract, commercials and relationship, and the one who stands behind the outcome. Reporting to our US COO, you own the service levels, the operational roadmap and the regional P&L, and lead the Heads of Platform Reliability and Security.

The network is expected to launch in the first half of 2027. How the operation runs and how it's judged are still to be settled, and you'll be the one settling them.

You will need

• To have run a delivery operation for a financial institution under a contract with stringent KPIs and SLAs.
• To have been accountable for a P&L, a headcount plan and an operating budget, ideally including 24x7 operations.
• Credibility in a room with bank executives and in a room with engineers. Most people have one, not both.

Useful, not essential

• Payments, market infrastructure or transaction banking, particularly real-time payments or high-value clearing.

There is more to this than we can put in an advertisement. If it sounds like your kind of problem, apply and we will tell you the rest on a call.

About Quant

Almost all the money in the economy is commercial bank money, and almost none of it moves on chain. Quant is a leading provider of programmable money infrastructure, and our technology changes that: it lets banks issue, move and settle tokenized deposits around the clock, automatically and securely, while staying connected to the systems they already run on. It is already deployed in regulated environments with central and commercial banks in the UK and around the world, including work on the digital pound and the digital euro.

The Clearing House, whose networks clear and settle more than $2 trillion a day, has now selected Quant to power its On-Chain Money Initiative: a new interoperable payments network that will let financial institutions of all sizes clear and settle tokenized deposits, with connectivity to the RTP® and CHIPS® networks. Our technology provides the network's interoperability, orchestration and transaction-management layer, enabling payments that settle immediately and transactions that trigger automatically once agreed conditions are met.

Through our Tokenized Deposits-as-a-Service solution, banks of any size can join without building new infrastructure themselves. The network is expected to become available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027, with use cases across corporate treasury, liquidity management, cross-border payments and digital asset settlement. We are building the New York team that will run it.

jobs.title: Senior Serverless Spark Migration Engineer
jobs.location: Austin, North America / Austin, Latin America
jobs.description:
Senior Platform Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure

Type: Remote (Brazil, Mexico)
Coverage: Pacific Hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST)

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global cloud and technology services company helping organizations modernize, optimize, and build at scale. We work with enterprise customers on complex cloud, data, infrastructure, and AI initiatives, bringing together deep technical expertise and hands-on delivery.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Serverless Spark Migration Engineer to help modernize a large-scale enterprise data platform.

You’ll lead the migration of production Apache Spark workloads from on-premise Hadoop/Spark environments to cloud-native and serverless architectures across AWS and GCP. This is a hands-on engineering role spanning workload assessment, architecture, application refactoring, migration execution, performance optimization, automation, and production readiness.

The goal is not simply to lift and shift existing workloads. You’ll determine the right target architecture for each workload and establish repeatable patterns that can eventually support migration at significant enterprise scale.

What You’ll Do

• Lead migrations of enterprise Spark workloads from on-premise environments to AWS and GCP.
• Assess Spark applications, clusters, configurations, dependencies, data flows, and resource utilization.
• Determine the right migration approach across rehost, replatform, refactor, modernize, or retire.
• Modernize traditional cluster-based workloads for serverless Spark where appropriate.
• Design and implement architectures using technologies such as AWS EMR Serverless, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, GCP Dataproc Serverless, GCS, and BigQuery.
• Refactor legacy PySpark/Scala/Spark SQL applications for cloud portability, scalability, and reliability.
• Migrate workloads from environments using Hadoop, HDFS, YARN, Hive, and on-prem Spark clusters.
• Troubleshoot and optimize Spark workloads across partitioning, shuffle behavior, joins, data skew, execution plans, executor configuration, serialization, and SQL execution.
• Benchmark performance and optimize serverless workloads for performance, reliability, and cloud cost.
• Build reusable migration tooling, automation, templates, and frameworks.
• Implement CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform.
• Define testing, validation, cutover, rollback, observability, and production-readiness patterns.
• Partner with Data Engineering, ML, Cloud Architecture, Platform Engineering, DevOps/SRE, Security, Governance, and FinOps teams.

What We’re Looking For

• 8+ years of experience across data engineering, distributed systems, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.
• 5+ years of hands-on Apache Spark experience in enterprise environments.
• Strong PySpark and/or Scala development experience.
• Proven experience migrating large-scale Spark workloads between infrastructure platforms.
• Hands-on experience with both AWS and GCP.
• Experience with on-premise Hadoop/Spark ecosystems, including technologies such as HDFS, YARN, and Hive.
• Deep understanding of Spark internals and distributed processing.
• Strong SQL and data engineering fundamentals.
• Experience with cloud data lakes and object storage.
• Strong production troubleshooting and performance-tuning experience.
• Experience with CI/CD, Git, and Infrastructure as Code.
• Ability to own migration work end-to-end, from discovery and architecture through production cutover and optimization.

Nice to Have

Experience with EMR/EMR Serverless, Dataproc/Dataproc Serverless, Glue, Lake Formation, BigQuery, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Kafka, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, or Kubernetes is valuable.

What Success Looks Like

You can take ownership of the complete migration lifecycle:

Discover → Assess → Design → Refactor → Migrate → Validate → Optimize → Operate

You understand both the legacy Hadoop/Spark world and modern cloud-native data platforms, and can make pragmatic architecture decisions based on workload characteristics rather than simply reproducing an existing environment in the cloud.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager - SD-WAN & Asset Security
jobs.description:
Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

The Role

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager with expertise in SD-WAN/Networking to join our amazing SASE Product Marketing Team. This is an exciting opportunity to work with the company who started the revolution of SASE and now leads the evolution of SASE. You will play a critical role in driving communication and awareness of our product innovations, capabilities, and business benefits across diverse channels.

• Own product marketing for Cato’s Next-Gen Networking, translating technical capabilities in SD-WAN, Backbone, DEM into clear business value, customer outcomes, and differentiated market stories.

jobs.description:

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Requisitos

• Perfil Hunter: Necessário ter forte ímpeto de Hunter, pois o comissionamento é dividido entre vendas (Recovery) e o controle de churn.

• Autogestão e Organização: Ter excelente gestão do tempo e controle das próprias demandas.

Responsabilidades

O Analista de Carteira de Relacionamento é essencialmente um profissional híbrido, equilibrando gestão de carteira (Farmer) com foco em vendas (Hunter):

Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica.
