Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Global Partner Engineering and Operations (PE&O) team is a critical component of Stripe’s broader Global Partnerships organization and a cornerstone of our success. We are responsible for managing the technical and operational aspects of new and existing strategic product partnerships and programs. Positioned at the intersection of product, engineering, and partnerships, we serve as a vital link that fosters seamless collaboration, which is essential for Stripe’s rapid growth trajectory.

The PE&O team comprises a hybrid mix of business and technical professionals focused on operational execution with financial ecosystem partners. We ensure smooth technical onboarding and implementation with partners while managing recurring KTLO (Keep-The-Lights-On) operations and monitoring stringent quality and performance targets. Our team drives global, partner-agnostic programs and initiatives to address broad ecosystem challenges and builds technical solutions and tools that enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

As domain experts aligned with specific Stripe products (such as Stripe Payments, Stripe Tax, and Stripe Billing), Partner Engineers play a key role in scoping new partner opportunities and recruiting new partners to adopt the latest Stripe platforms. Our dynamic and versatile team takes on a variety of responsibilities daily, including driving alignment and coordination among cross-functional teams and partners, analyzing insights and trends from our data to inform decision-making, and developing innovative tools and processes to scale our impact. The partnerships we cultivate are instrumental—they significantly influence Stripe’s ecosystem, and the products born from these collaborations touch millions of users worldwide.

What you’ll do

As an Operational Excellence Partner Engineer within the Global Partner Engineering and Operations (PE&O) team, you will be a key driver in optimizing the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of our technical partnerships and programs. This role is focused on identifying operational bottlenecks and areas for improvement across our partner lifecycle and internal workflows. You will achieve this by leveraging data and analytics to gain deep visibility into operational performance, health, and trends. Furthermore, you will be responsible for designing and building the essential tooling and automation solutions needed to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and proactively address operational challenges. Your contributions will directly enhance the PE&O team's ability to operate effectively at scale, ensuring a seamless experience for our partners and accelerating Stripe's mission to increase the GDP of the internet through robust and efficient technical operations.

Responsibilities

• Data Analysis for Operational Insights:

• Leverage data analysis to monitor the health and performance of partner integrations and operational workflows, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement.

• Translate data-driven insights into concrete operational recommendations and requirements.

• Perform root cause analysis on operational issues using data, providing clear explanations and data-backed solutions.

• Operational Tooling & Automation Development:

• Design, build, and maintain tools and automation scripts to streamline manual operational processes within the Partner Engineering and Operations team.

• Develop solutions that enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and increase the scalability of our partner operations.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks across data collection, processing, and operational workflows.

• Data Infrastructure & Reporting:

• Design, build, and maintain robust and scalable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) to integrate data from various operational and technical sources.

• Develop and optimize data models to support both analytical needs and operational monitoring.

• Create and maintain dashboards and reports that provide real-time visibility into key operational metrics and system health.

• Operational Excellence & Process Improvement:

• Work closely with the Partner Engineering and Operations team to understand their workflows, challenges, and tooling needs.

• Proactively identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in existing processes using data and observations.

• Champion best practices in operational monitoring, alerting, and incident response from a data and tooling perspective.

• Collaboration & Support:

• Serve as a key technical resource for the team, providing expertise in data, automation, and operational tooling.

• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to advocate for operational needs and integrate tooling solutions where necessary.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related technical field.6+ years of experience in a role focused on data analysis, business intelligence, data engineering, or operational support with a strong technical component, preferably supporting technical or business operations teams.

• Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis from complex datasets.

• Proven ability to develop tools or automate processes using scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Ruby).

• Experience working with data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) and understanding of data modeling concepts.

• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar) to create insightful dashboards and operational reports.

• Experience in identifying and troubleshooting technical or operational issues using data and technical investigation.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to translate operational challenges into technical solutions and data requirements.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts and data insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Passion for learning about current and emerging technologies in data, automation, and operational efficiency.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience supporting a Partner Engineering, Technical Operations, or similar function.Experience with cloud-based data and automation services (e.g., AWS Glue, EMR, S3; Google Cloud Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Functions; Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions).

• Experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt).

• Familiarity with API integrations and building small-to-medium sized applications or services.

• Experience with monitoring and alerting systems.

• Familiarity with data governance principles and practices.Knowledge of the payments industry or financial technology.

• Experience with statistical analysis.Background in systems thinking and optimizing technical workflows.

jobs.description:
Opatovice nad Labem | krátký/dlouhý týden | 12hodinové směny



🚀 Rohlík otevírá úplně nový sklad v Opatovicích nad Labem. A hledáme nové kolegy, kteří budou u jeho rozjezdu od prvního dne.

Nejde o nástup do skladu, kde už je všechno roky zajeté. Budeš u toho, když nový provoz rozjíždíme, nastavujeme jeho každodenní fungování a postupně vychytáváme procesy tak, aby všechno šlapalo, jak má.

Hledáme nové kolegy, kteří se nebojí provozu, umí si udržet přehled a dokážou zorganizovat práci i lidi kolem sebe.

Pokud tě baví prostředí, kde se pořád něco děje, a nechceš trávit celý den za stolem, čti dál.


📦 CO BUDEŠ MÍT NA STAROSTI?

Budeš přímo v centru dění skladu. Podle aktuální situace budeš hlídat, kde je potřeba přidat, přesunout lidi nebo změnit priority tak, aby celý provoz běžel plynule.

Konkrétně tě čeká:

 - řízení toku skladu a rozložení práce během směny,

 - operativní organizace lidí a jejich přesouvání tam, kde jsou právě potřeba,

 - dohled nad klíčovými místy provozu a rychlé řešení vzniklých situací,

 - spolupráce s kolegy z příjmu, expedice a dalších částí skladu,

 - práce s provozními čísly a jejich převádění do konkrétních kroků,

 - hledání možností, jak nové procesy zjednodušovat a zlepšovat.

Poznáš přitom celý proces – od příjezdu zboží do skladu až po okamžik, kdy hotovou objednávku přebírá kurýr.


👀 KOHO HLEDÁME?

Nemusíš mít za sebou deset let v logistice. Důležitější pro nás je, jak přemýšlíš a jak funguješ mezi lidmi.

Sedneme si, pokud:

 - se dokážeš rychle rozhodnout a nezalekneš se dynamického provozu,

 - umíš si udržet klid a přehled, i když se kolem tebe děje několik věcí najednou,

 - dokážeš přirozeně zorganizovat lidi a jasně jim vysvětlit, co je potřeba udělat,

 - máš férový přístup a zároveň se nebojíš převzít odpovědnost,

 - čísla pro tebe nejsou strašák a umíš je spojit s tím, co se skutečně děje v provozu,

 - přemýšlíš nad tím, jak věci dělat jednodušeji a lépe.

Zkušenost ze skladu, logistiky, výroby, retailu, gastronomie nebo jiného rychlého provozu je určitě výhodou. Pokud jsi ale šikovný/á a máš zkušenost s koordinací lidí odjinud, rádi se s tebou potkáme také.


⏰ JAK BUDEŠ PRACOVAT?

Čeká tě režim krátký/dlouhý týden a 12hodinové směny.

A počítej s tím, že tohle není kancelářská pozice. Většinu směny budeš tam, kde se něco děje – přímo v provozu mezi lidmi.


🥐 CO ZA TO DOSTANEŠ?

Kromě možnosti být u rozjezdu úplně nového skladu Rohlíku nabízíme:

 - Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma včetně 10% cashbacku v kreditech na další nákupy,

 - možnost placeného volna pro odpočinek a regeneraci,

 - dotované obědy,

 - kávu, čerstvé ovoce a další občerstvení na pracovišti zdarma,

 - 86 Kč na ošatné za každou odpracovanou směnu,

 - odměny za pochvaly od kolegů, které můžeš proměnit například za vouchery do Alzy nebo Notina,

 - příspěvek na Multisport kartu,

 - firemní akce a společné oslavy úspěchů.


💚 PROČ NASTOUPIT PRÁVĚ TEĎ?

Protože nový sklad se otevírá jen jednou.

Můžeš přijít ve chvíli, kdy se tým teprve tvoří, procesy se nastavují a tvůj názor i tvoje práce mohou ovlivnit, jak bude celý sklad v budoucnu fungovat.

A než se nový provoz naplno rozjede, rádi ti ukážeme i naše už fungující robotické sklady v Praze.

Chceš být u toho od začátku? Ozvi se nám. Nemusíš psát dlouhý motivační dopis – stačí nám dát vědět, kdo jsi, a rádi se s Tebou spojíme.

jobs.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
About our Company:

Universal DX, Inc. is an international Company with a highly experienced team focused on cracking cancer’s code. Through our multi-omics and bioinformatics models, we have figured out how to read the disease’s signals in blood with high accuracy to detect cancer in its earliest stages. Starting with a colorectal cancer screening liquid biopsy test, we are building a multi-cancer platform that can identify the unique DNA regions associated with different types of cancers.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Staff Manufacturing Engineer to provide cross-functional leadership for Manufacturing readiness, program execution, systems, risk management, and continuous improvement across our diagnostic manufacturing operations. This role will connect Manufacturing with internal customers, R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, external partners, and digital-system stakeholders to ensure new and ongoing manufacturing campaigns are execution-ready, visible, scalable, and well controlled. The ideal candidate combines strong manufacturing engineering judgment with program leadership, systems thinking, and experience operating in regulated diagnostic or life-science environments.

You will be part of a team that is passionate about developing novel diagnostic tests for the early detection of cancers. As part of the team, you will be in a Company that aims more than to become one of the leaders in the industry. We want to have a huge positive impact on society by achieving the ambitious purpose of “making cancer a curable disease by detecting it earlier”.

How you’ll contribute:

• Represent Manufacturing in technical and operational discussions with internal customers and external partners regarding manufacturing capability, readiness, timelines, process implementation, and operational requirements.

• Define Manufacturing business requirements for Smartsheet, Jira, LIMS/MES, dashboards, and other digital tools. Develop scalable workflows that improve traceability, operational visibility, and execution.

• Lead post-sprint reviews, identify systemic issues and improvement opportunities, and convert lessons learned into sustainable improvements for future manufacturing campaigns.

• Maintain an integrated view of manufacturing milestones, dependencies, risks, and critical-path activities. Lead readiness reviews and escalate risks that could affect quality, schedule, or delivery.

• Coordinate Manufacturing readiness for new products and processes transitioning from R&D, other sites, or external partners. Lead gap assessments, implementation planning, and execution readiness across equipment, materials, training, documentation, and operational requirements.

• Maintain Manufacturing audit readiness through periodic assessments, evidence reviews, gap closure, and coordination with Quality. Ensure manufacturing records, training evidence, equipment status, material traceability, and supporting information are readily retrievable.

• Develop and maintain meaningful Manufacturing metrics, including sprint readiness, schedule adherence, overdue actions, supplier readiness, documentation readiness, deviations, and recurring operational risks.

• Ensure required manufacturing procedures, batch records, forms, specifications, and supporting documents are identified and ready before execution. Coordinate with document owners, Quality, and Document Control without serving as the primary document-control owner.

• Facilitate structured readiness and decision-making forums, drive follow-through on action items, and provide clear status, risk, and escalation summaries to Manufacturing leadership.

What you’ll bring:

• PhD in Biotechnology, Engineering, Life Sciences or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.

• Typically 7+ years of industry experience in study design, documentation, manufacturing, diagnostic or biopharma, reagent manufacturing environments.

• Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional manufacturing readiness, technology transfer, new product introduction, or complex operational programs.

• Strong working knowledge of GMP/GDP principles, ISO 13485, change control, deviations/CAPA, training, equipment/material readiness, and manufacturing documentation.

• Experience translating operational needs into scalable digital workflows, dashboards, trackers, or LIMS/MES business requirements.

• Strong risk-management, problem-solving, facilitation, and executive communication skills with the ability to manage multiple interdependent priorities.

• Experience supporting audits or inspections and maintaining evidence-based manufacturing readiness.

• Ability to work effectively in a remote environment while maintaining strong engagement with Dallas-based Manufacturing operations and cross-functional partners.

What we’ll offer:

• 22 days of PTO with the possibility to carry over 10 days to the following year.

• Company Holidays, plus your Birthday off!

• Company-sponsored benefit plans, including medical, dental, and vision insurance plus life, STD, and LTD coverage, and 401(k).

• Flexible work schedule.

• And more to come!

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Universal DX. We are growing rapidly and starting our US operations by building up our team, starting our lab and business operations, and establishing strategic partnerships.

We are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey in this expansive time for us.

You will be the connective tissue across Professional Services and our delivery partners, and the person the team trusts to keep delivery operations humming.

• Streamline partner program intake: Manage partner program submissions and operational requests with clear SLAs, clean handoffs, and consistent follow-through so onboarding and engagement readiness move without friction.

• Build operational reporting and delivery insights: Develop recurring dashboards, scorecards, and exception reports that give Services leadership actionable visibility into delivery health, utilization, forecast accuracy, partner performance, and process bottlenecks.

• Improve scalable operating rhythms: Partner with Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Partner teams to standardize workflows, close operational gaps, and enable a repeatable delivery model as the business grows.

To be successful in this role you have:

• Experience applying AI-enabled tools or automation to improve operating workflows, decision support, reporting, or productivity within a services, operations, or customer-facing function.

About the Role

The Community Impact Coordinator builds and strengthens relationships between the Care Campus and the diverse community it serves. The position develops partnerships with Skid Row residents, individuals with lived experience, community-based and social justice organizations, service providers, neighborhood stakeholders, faith communities, advocacy groups, law enforcement and public safety partners, local government and elected officials’ offices, and other community partners to promote collaboration, trust, community engagement, and shared impact.

What You'll Do

Community Engagement and Relationship Building

• Develop and maintain authentic, collaborative relationships with Skid Row residents, individuals with lived experience, community leaders, grassroots organizations, social justice and advocacy groups, neighborhood stakeholders, faith communities, law enforcement and public safety partners, local government and elected officials’ offices, and other community partners.
• Maintain a regular presence in the Skid Row community and participate in relevant neighborhood meetings, coalitions, events, forums, and community activities.
• Serve as an accessible point of contact for community members, organizations, public agencies, and other stakeholders seeking to engage with the Care Campus.
• Proactively engage stakeholders to better understand community priorities, concerns, strengths, resources, and opportunities for collaboration.
• Build relationships across diverse perspectives and organizations while promoting respectful dialogue and constructive partnership.
• Identify opportunities to strengthen trust, communication, and collaboration between the Care Campus and the surrounding community.

Government and Public Safety Partnerships

• Develop and maintain productive working relationships with relevant law enforcement and public safety partners, including the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD), to support communication and coordination regarding issues affecting the Care Campus and surrounding community.
• Build relationships with local elected officials’ offices, government agencies, and other public-sector stakeholders connected to Skid Row and the Care Campus.
• Serve as a liaison for routine communication with government and public safety partners, coordinating with Care Campus and organizational leadership as appropriate.
• Facilitate meetings, site visits, introductions, and other engagement opportunities between Care Campus leadership and public-sector partners.
• Help communicate community and campus concerns to appropriate public-sector partners and support collaborative problem-solving when appropriate.
• Track requests, commitments, concerns, and follow-up items resulting from meetings or engagement with government and public safety partners.
• Coordinate with organizational External Affairs, Communications, Government Relations, or other designated leadership on matters involving elected officials, government agencies, media-sensitive issues, or broader public policy considerations.

Safety, Crisis, and Overdose Response

• Maintain awareness of participant, community, and environmental safety while working on the Care Campus and in the surrounding Skid Row neighborhood.
• Recognize and appropriately respond to behavioral health crises, medical emergencies, suspected overdoses, escalating situations, and other safety concerns within the scope of the position.
• Use trauma-informed engagement and trained de-escalation techniques when appropriate and seek assistance from Safety, clinical staff, emergency responders, or other appropriate resources when additional intervention is needed.
• Complete all required organizational and program-specific training, including harm reduction, overdose recognition and response, opioid overdose reversal using naloxone (Narcan), de-escalation, emergency response, CPR, and other health and safety training as assigned.
• Respond within the scope of training to suspected overdoses and other medical emergencies, including administering naloxone (Narcan) when indicated and activating appropriate emergency response resources in accordance with established protocols.
• Promptly report significant safety concerns, incidents, or community conditions to appropriate Care Campus leadership.
• Maintain professional boundaries and follow established procedures when responding to challenging or potentially unsafe situations.

What You'll Bring

• Minimum of five years of experience in community engagement, community outreach, community relations, organizing, public affairs, human services, homeless services, or another community-facing role.
• Demonstrated experience building and maintaining relationships with diverse community members, organizations, and stakeholders.
• Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, communities with complex social-service needs, or within the Skid Row/Downtown Los Angeles community strongly preferred.
• Experience engaging with public agencies, government representatives, advocacy organizations, public safety partners, or other external stakeholders preferred.
• Bachelor’s degree in human services, social work, sociology, public administration, public health, communications, community development, or a related field preferred, but not required.

• Strong communication and listening skills
• Demonstrated ability to build trust across differing perspectives
• Sound judgment and professional boundaries
• Ability to facilitate meetings and follow through on commitments
• Comfort working independently in a highly visible community-facing role

Our Values

Dignity  |  Community  |  Integrity  |  Partnership  |  Social Justice  |  Radical Care

About the Role

The Senior Director provides overall leadership and accountability for the Care Campus, bringing together programmatic and operational functions to deliver safe, effective, integrated, and participant-centered services.

This is the senior site leadership role, with accountability for Campus performance, contractual compliance, service quality, participant experience and safety, staff effectiveness, operational performance, partnerships, and alignment across multidisciplinary teams. jobs.title: Campaign & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Core skills: Integrated Campaigns, Field & Event Marketing, Sales Alignment, Proactive, Ownership, Get things done, Focus and measure outcomes, not tasks, B2B SaaS

Bitmovin is a global Series-C SaaS scale-up that provides award-winning video streaming technology to world-renowned brands including Warner Bros. Discovery, BBC, Red Bull Media House, Hulu, and The New York Times, among many others.

We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and foster an inclusive, flexible work environment where every team member can thrive. We move fast, try new things, and care deeply about the impact our work creates.

Why us?

Ready to roll up your sleeves and redefine what field marketing can do? We’re looking for a proactive Campaign & Field Marketing Manager to join our dynamic team and report directly to the VP Marketing. In this high-impact role, you’ll step up with full ownership - turning high-level strategy into standout campaigns, high-energy field activations, and truly unforgettable customer experiences that deliver real, measurable outcomes.

This role offers:

• Strategic Impact: Own campaigns and field activations from concept to execution, directly influencing sales pipeline generation, customer engagement, and strategic account growth.

• Global Event Ownership: Drive the marketing strategy and activation for up to five Tier 1 strategic global events per year across key hubs like the US, the Middle East, and Amsterdam - focusing on meaningful commercial outcomes and strategic impact without getting bogged down in logistical micro-management.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Marketing Operations to drive key initiatives and bring projects to life through authentic influence and project ownership.

• Autonomy & Travel: Enjoy flexible working, a collaborative culture, and international travel opportunities to connect with teams, clients, and partners worldwide.

Your Impact

Forget traditional event management - this role is about rolling up your sleeves and making big things happen. You will raise the bar for our global campaigns and field marketing, taking end-to-end ownership of regional activations, Tier 1 events, and cross-functional execution.

You will make an impact that matters by:

• Setting Objectives & Strategy: Partnering directly with the VP Marketing to lock in clear goals, lean execution strategies, and commercial outcomes for every event.

• Developing Activation Plans: Building end-to-end event activation plans that seamlessly align with broader marketing campaigns and core business goals.

• End-to-End Activity Execution: Drive comprehensive pre-event, on-site, and post-event marketing initiatives to maximize impact and engagement.

• Partnering with Sales: Working closely with Sales teams to identify target accounts, key customers, and high-value prospects, crafting targeted engagement plans for every activation.

• Orchestrating Experiences & Content: Align top-tier event speakers, high-impact content streams, executive meetings, unique customer experiences, and multi-channel supporting campaigns.

• Managing External Partners: Briefing and directing external agencies, event organizers, and suppliers to deliver seamless activations on time and within budget.

• Asset & Messaging Readiness: Ensuring high-quality content, targeted messaging, and necessary marketing assets are fully prepared and accessible before and during each event.

• On-Site Execution: Overseeing on-site activations directly and serving as the primary marketing point of contact during live events.

• Driving ROI & Reporting: Leading post-event follow-up strategies, tracking results, measuring campaign performance, and reporting key pipeline metrics.

• Continuous Improvement: Capturing key learnings and insights from each activation to refine and elevate our strategy for flagship Tier 1 events.

What can you bring

• Experience in the Media & Entertainment space.

• Demonstrable experience in event management, field marketing, campaign management, or experiential/event marketing within a B2B environment (ideally SaaS or technology).

• Demonstrated success in delivering end-to-end integrated campaigns from initial brief through to execution and measurement.

• Proactive mindset with strong project management capabilities, a focus to measure outcomes (not tasks), and a proven record of driving projects across teams and external partners.

• Commercial awareness and analytical capability, with a focus on aligning marketing initiatives with sales pipeline and ROI metrics.

• Experience planning and activating regional and international events.

• Technical familiarity with marketing and collaboration tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, and Canva (or similar platforms).

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to drive progress independently while building strong cross-functional relationships.

• Willingness to travel internationally for up to five Tier 1 events per year.

You don't have experience with all the points above? Don't worry, we foster an environment of continuous learning and will support you with onboarding, coaching, and growth on the job. If you are driven, collaborative, and excited about shaping the future of video technology, we encourage you to apply!

Life at Bitmovin

See what fellow Bitmovers are saying on LinkedIn
Check employee reviews on Glassdoor

jobs.title: Hardware Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Bengaluru

About the department

Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployed across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet.

About the Role

We need to make thoughtful infrastructure choices affecting a significant portion of the Internet. Hardware we work with includes servers and components, as well as PDUs and network hardware. . As a Hardware Systems Engineer, you will work with colleagues on the Hardware Engineering, Product teams, and Hardware Sourcing teams to troubleshoot and maintain Cloudflare’s worldwide fleet of storage and compute servers.

What you'll do

Exp: 3-5yrs

• Work with software teams to validate bug fixes and assess performance of new firmware revisions

• Validate and deploy firmware updates to the fleet, monitoring the progress of the rollout for compliance and reliability

• Work with server and component vendors to obtain, debug, and maintain the latest updates

• Work with our Site Reliability Engineering teams to triage hardware problem reports

• Support our Data Centre Engineering teams in resolving hardware issues

• Develop and maintain automation tools to update firmware on servers and components in Cloudflare’s fleet

• Communicate your results and updates through blog posts, internal talks, and tickets

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science

• Desire to learn about the Cloudflare hardware used by 20% of all web sites

• Desire to learn how a diverse server fleet is managed at scale

• Desire to learn the tools Cloudflare uses to maintain and monitor our hardware

• Knowledge of bash and python and basic Linux task automation

• Knowledge of x86 server hardware including motherboards, CPUs, memory, storage and firmware updates. Knowledge of other platforms such as arm is a bonus.

• Knowledge of configuration management principals, in particular we use salt to manage our fleet

• Knowledge of Redfish, IPMI and server remote management protocols

• Knowledge of running production mission critical systems

Bonus Points

• Familiarity with server hardware architecture

• Knowledge of debugging server hardware faults and the ability to engage with our sourcing team and vendors to improve quality

• Experience of managing large fleets comprising of thousands of servers

• Experience of observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, and the ability to observe trends over time

• Experience with software development tools and processes such as git, Bitbucket and TeamCity and Jira

Fraud Alert: Do not fall victim to recruitment fraud. Cloudflare never charges application fees or requires candidates to purchase third-party certifications or training as a condition of employment. All official communication comes strictly from @cloudflare.com email addresses.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager, Engineering Technology & Software
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is looking for a Strategic Sourcing Manager to join the Finance team and own sourcing for our engineering technology and software categories. You will report directly to the Head of Procurement, based in the San Francisco HQ office.

This role owns the commercial relationship with the vendors that support Harvey's product and engineering organization: cloud infrastructure, data platforms, security and observability tooling, developer platforms, and enterprise SaaS. You will run competitive sourcing events, negotiate pricing and terms that improve as Harvey scales, manage the renewal pipeline, and partner with Engineering, Security, Legal, and FP&A to get deals done without unnecessary friction. Harvey's spend is scaling fast, and our sourcing motion has to scale with it.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

Category Strategy & Sourcing

 - Own category strategy and the sourcing pipeline for cloud infrastructure, data platforms, security and observability tooling, developer tools, and enterprise SaaS

 - Lead end-to-end sourcing events (RFI/RFP, supplier evaluation, selection) for new technology purchases; maintain a competitive supplier landscape for each category

 - Analyze vendor pricing, usage patterns, and market benchmarks to identify opportunities to improve economics and reduce commercial risk

Commercial Negotiation & Contract Structure

 - Lead commercial negotiations with software and infrastructure vendors, including committed-spend, tiered, usage-based, and enterprise license agreements

 - Structure agreements that balance commitment, flexibility, and unit economics as Harvey's usage grows; right-size license counts and tiers to actual utilization

 - Drive redlines on MSAs, order forms, and DPAs in partnership with Legal, Security, and Privacy; own the deal from first proposal through signature in Zip

 - Support the Head of Procurement and Partnerships on strategic AI provider agreements with usage analysis, benchmark data, and contract administration

Stakeholder Partnership

 - Partner with Engineering and Finance to forecast demand, translate technical requirements into sourcing strategy, and turn Harvey's growth into negotiating leverage

 - Serve as the commercial point of contact for engineering leadership; engage early in build-vs-buy decisions and vendor evaluations

 - Coordinate Security, Legal, and Privacy review so that technology purchases move through intake at the speed the business needs

Renewals, Supplier Management & Reporting

 - Own the renewal calendar for technology and software vendors; prepare negotiation briefs, utilization analysis, and benchmark data ahead of each renewal

 - Manage supplier relationships through execution, utilization monitoring, escalations, and renewal; consolidate overlapping tools and eliminate shelfware; track savings and cost avoidance against target

 - Build AI-powered sourcing playbooks and tooling for redlining, negotiation prep, and benchmarking that raise throughput and deal quality across the team







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4–7 years of strategic sourcing or procurement experience with a focus on technology and software categories

 - Track record of negotiating enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or security tooling agreements with vendors such as AWS, Google Cloud, Snowflake, Datadog, GitHub, Okta, or comparable

 - Understanding of software commercial models: per-seat and usage-based pricing, committed spend, tiers, discounts, and true-ups

 - Strong analytical skills: unit-cost analysis, TCO modeling, and benchmarking; able to find the real economics underneath a vendor proposal

 - Working knowledge of commercial and legal contract terms (MSAs, order forms, SOWs, DPAs); comfortable driving redlines in partnership with Legal

 - Clear, direct communicator with executives and across the negotiating table

 - Hands-on experience running sourcing in a procure-to-pay platform (Zip preferred)

 - AI fluency: you actively use AI tools for redlining, negotiation prep, benchmarking, and vendor analysis

 - Comfortable operating at pace: high deal volume, ambiguity, imperfect information, and a bias toward execution







COMPENSATION

$117,500 - $161,600 USD

jobs.title: Sponsorship Sales Development Representative (US Remote)
jobs.description:
The Company:

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance https://allianceled.io/ is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.

We connect industry leaders and innovators through unparalleled networking opportunities. We bring together leading minds to share the latest trends, challenges and opportunities facing companies, the tactics and tools needed to drive results, and a forum to make meaningful connections.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) based in the US to support our Sponsorship Sales team, focusing on generating and qualifying leads across our events and digital sponsorship portfolio.

This is a remote freelance/contract role, designed to expand our reach across US time zones and drive new business opportunities within North America.

You’ll play a key role in building pipeline, identifying target accounts, engaging decision-makers, and booking high-quality meetings for our senior sponsorship sales team.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in high-volume outreach, fast-paced sales environments, and early-stage conversations that open doors.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Lead Generation: Research and identify high-potential companies and decision-makers using LinkedIn, CRM data, and sales intelligence tools.

 - Outbound Prospecting: Conduct high-volume outreach (email, calls, LinkedIn) to book qualified meetings for the sponsorship sales team.

 - Qualification: Engage prospects through discovery calls to assess fit, needs, and timelines, qualifying opportunities for senior sales reps.

 - CRM Management: Maintain accurate records and notes in HubSpot, ensuring all leads and interactions are properly tracked and followed up.

 - Collaboration: Partner closely with senior sponsorship executives and marketing to refine outreach messaging and target lists.

 - Performance Goals: Consistently meet weekly and monthly KPIs for qualified meetings booked, outreach volume, and lead conversion.

 - Market Awareness: Stay informed on key industry trends in SaaS, martech, and B2B events to better tailor outreach and identify new opportunities.

___________________________

Requirements:

If the below sounds like you - we’d love to hear from you:

 - Previous experience in sales development, lead generation, or outbound prospecting (B2B experience preferred).

 - Comfortable working in a high-volume outreach environment with clear activity and performance targets.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging US-based stakeholders.

 - Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Smartlead, Aircall, or similar.

 - Self-motivated and disciplined, able to perform in a remote, freelance setup with autonomy.

 - Strong time management and ability to prioritize outreach, follow-ups, and pipeline effectively.

 - A collaborative attitude, success at The Alliance is a team sport.



Contract Setup

 - Remote (US-based), must work within US business hours

 - Freelance / Contract role

 - Clear KPIs and performance expectations

 - Base hourly/monthly rate & on-target earnings commission on all sales generated from meetings booked

___________________________

Community and Inclusion

We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. We acknowledge that our work here is never done - and we promise to continue striving for inclusivity every day.

If you’re worried you don’t quite hit all the requirements we’ve listed, don’t let that hold you back from submitting your application! Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential for our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you’d be a great fit then we’d love to hear from you.

We are The Alliance - in more ways than one.

jobs.title: Manager, Experiential Marketing & Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity

The B2B Event Marketing team is looking for a strategic and results-driven Marketing Manager to own and scale this channel. Events are strategic levers for growth, activation, and relationship building.

This is not a logistics-led role. While operational execution is a critical component, this position sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: shaping how events drive measurable business impact at scale through strategic planning, stakeholder orchestration, and scalable frameworks that elevate events into a measurable business growth engine.

We are looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds clarity through frameworks, leads complex cross-functional initiatives with discipline and influence, and earns strong stakeholder trust and executive confidence.

Experience in events marketing is a plus and something we'd love to see, but it is not a requirement. Traditional event production experience is not a prerequisite either. Backgrounds in consulting, strategy, or PMO are equally valued, and we strongly encourage those candidates to apply. What matters most is how you think, structure problems, and drive commercial outcomes.

As a key player in the marketing and sales ecosystem, you will work closely with regional sales and business development teams to ensure events align with business priorities, support business objectives, and contribute directly to revenue goals. You'll be responsible for end-to-end event management.

Key Responsibilities

Event Strategy & Business Integration

• Translate commercial priorities into event strategies with clear business cases

• Develop annual roadmaps aligned to growth objectives

• Define success metrics beyond attendance (pipeline impact, activation, ROI, incrementality)

• Create scalable playbooks and operating models

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with Business Development, Sales, Supply, PR, Content, Branding, and Senior Leadership

• Align diverse stakeholders with competing priorities

• Drive structured working sessions and executive updates

• Influence without direct authority in a matrix organization

Program & Project Governance

• Lead large, multi-workstream initiatives end-to-end

• Build detailed project plans with risk mitigation and milestone tracking

• Establish governance cadence and reporting mechanisms

• Ensure disciplined execution across markets and teams

Performance Measurement & Optimization

• Build measurement frameworks and post-event impact analysis

• Identify key performance levers and iterate based on data

• Develop dashboards to track ROI and business outcomes

• Introduce test-and-learn approaches to improve effectiveness

Requirements

We are intentionally looking beyond traditional event planners. Experience in events or field marketing is welcome and will be viewed positively, but it is not essential. You may come from:

• Events, field, or B2B marketing (a plus, not a must)

• Management consulting

• Strategy or business transformation teams

• PMO or complex program leadership roles

• Business operations in high-growth environments

You likely demonstrate 8-12 years of experience:

Structured Problem-Solving

• Ability to turn ambiguity into clear frameworks and action plans

• Strong analytical thinking and commercial acumen

Stakeholder Mastery

• Experience working with senior leadership

• Comfortable navigating high-visibility, high-complexity environments

• Strong influence skills without relying on hierarchy

Execution Excellence

• Exceptional project management discipline

• Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives

• Strong attention to detail without losing strategic altitude

Business Orientation

• Understands P&L drivers and growth mechanics

• Makes data-informed decisions

• Focused on impact, not activity

jobs.title: Senior SecOps Security Architect
jobs.description:
As a Senior SecOps Security Architect, you will play a key role in protecting SGS's global technology

landscape by combining security architecture, engineering, operational excellence and technical

leadership.

You will work across multiple security domains, partnering with infrastructure, cloud, networking and

application teams to design, implement and optimize security controls while ensuring our security

platforms operate effectively at scale.

A key part of the role will be strengthening our Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)

capabilities, helping improve security monitoring, log management, detection engineering, alerting and

incident investigation across our global environment.

This position offers a rare opportunity to combine architecture, project work, technical ownership,

automation and operational security in a truly global environment.

What You'll Do

Security Architecture & Engineering

• Design and improve enterprise security controls, technical standards and security baselines.
• Define security requirements for new infrastructure, cloud and application initiatives.
• Contribute to security architecture decisions, risk mitigation and security-by-design across projects.

Security Platform & SIEM Ownership

• Own and continuously improve key security platforms, including CrowdStrike Falcon / NG SIEM, Netskope, Cisco Umbrella and F5 WAF.
• Strengthen SIEM capabilities across log ingestion, correlation, alerting, dashboards and security monitoring use cases.
• Develop and optimize detection rules and integrate security data from endpoint, cloud, identity, network and application environments.
• Work with SOC teams to improve detection coverage, reduce false positives and enhance overall monitoring effectiveness.

Security Operations

• Support incident response, threat detection, threat hunting and security investigations.
• Troubleshoot security alerts and contribute to remediation, forensic analysis and root cause investigations.
• Identify gaps in controls, monitoring or detection capabilities and drive technical improvements.

Innovation, Automation & Governance

• Automate security processes and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
• Evaluate new cybersecurity technologies and contribute to PoCs and solution assessments.
• Maintain security documentation, runbooks and operational procedures.
• Support audit and compliance activities where required.

• 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, SecOps or a related field.
• Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, security monitoring and incident response.
• Experience with security architecture, engineering and enterprise security platforms.
• Solid knowledge of endpoint, network, cloud and identity security.
• Experience working in large, complex or international IT environments.
• Experience with technologies such as CrowdStrike Falcon / NG SIEM, Netskope, Cisco Umbrella, F5 WAF, Palo Alto, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Azure Security or Microsoft 365 Security would be highly valuable.
• You are hands-on, pragmatic and comfortable working independently while collaborating with global technical teams.
• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft Security, CrowdStrike or Palo Alto are beneficial but not essential.

Why SGS?

• Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
• Enjoy a flexible schedule and hybrid work model
• Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
• Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.
• Benefit from a comprehensive benefits platform.

Apply Now:

At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!

¿Buscas algo más que un trabajo de oficina? ¿Te interesa la electricidad, las energías renovables y la tecnología aplicada a instalaciones reales? Si quieres aprender de profesionales expertos, trabajar sobre el terreno y convertirte en un especialista técnico altamente demandado, esta oportunidad es para ti.

¿Qué harás?

Te incorporarás a un equipo especializado donde desarrollarás una carrera técnica combinando ensayos eléctricos avanzados e inspección reglamentaria en instalaciones industriales y energéticas.

A través de un plan de formación progresivo, aprenderás a:

- Realizar ensayos y verificaciones eléctricas en instalaciones industriales y plantas renovables.

- Utilizar equipos de medida profesionales para diagnosticar el estado de instalaciones eléctricas.

- Participar en inspecciones reglamentarias aplicando normativa técnica de seguridad.

- Analizar resultados, detectar incidencias y elaborar informes técnicos.

- Trabajar directamente en campo visitando clientes y proyectos reales.

- Especializarte en áreas de alta demanda como instalaciones eléctricas de BT/AT, protecciones eléctricas, calidad de suministro y energías renovables.

Desde el primer día contarás con:

- Formación técnica especializada.

- Acompañamiento de inspectores y técnicos senior.

- Plan de desarrollo para obtener nuevas habilitaciones y competencias.

- Participación en proyectos reales del sector industrial y energético.

- Posibilidad de construir una carrera profesional como Inspector/a especializado/a o Experto/a en Ensayos Eléctricos.

Tu carrera puede empezar aquí:

Si buscas una oportunidad para transformarte en un profesional de referencia en ensayos eléctricos e inspección reglamentaria, esta posición está diseñada para ti. No buscamos experiencia extensa; buscamos talento, actitud y ganas de construir futuro

- Grado en Ingeniería Eléctrica, Ingeniería Industrial (especialidad eléctrica) o titulación similar.

- Interés por el mundo de la electricidad, la energía y las instalaciones industriales.

- Nivel de inglés técnico y conocimientos básicos de instalaciones eléctricas, energías renovables o normativa eléctrica

- Disponibilidad para viajar por la provincia de Aragón y realizar trabajos de campo.

- Carnet de conducir B.

- Competencias clave:

• Curiosidad técnica y capacidad de aprendizaje.
• Rigor técnico, responsabilidad y atención al detalle.
• Capacidad de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.

En SGS creemos en las personas como motor del cambio. Trabajarás en un entorno donde la seguridad, la integridad y la innovación forman parte del día a día. Apostamos por el desarrollo profesional y el aprendizaje continuo, ofreciéndote la oportunidad de crecer en un equipo altamente cualificado.

Lo más valorado por las personas trabajadoras de SGS es nuestro buen ambiente de trabajo

Desde SGS, como parte de nuestro firme compromiso con la promoción de la igualdad de oportunidades y el respeto a la diversidad, aseguramos que todos nuestros procesos de selección se realizan de forma objetiva, imparcial y justa, así como libres de cualquier tipo de sesgo o discriminación

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - EHR
jobs.description:
ABOUT NABLA

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.



Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.



We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.



Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!



Product development at Nabla is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads. As Senior Product Manager for EHR Integrations, you will own how Nabla lives inside the systems clinicians actually work in.

The EHR is where a clinician’s day already lives, and a large part of the Nabla experience happens inside it. Providers launch Nabla from the chart, and everything Nabla produces (notes, orders, visit diagnoses, codes) has to land in the right place, in the right format, at the right moment. When that fits naturally into how a clinician already works, Nabla becomes something they reach for dozens of times a day. When it doesn’t, even the best AI goes unused. This role owns that part of the workflow, and with it a decisive share of the experience our providers have with Nabla.

It is a rare mix of UX craft and technical depth. You will design workflows that feel effortless to a clinician mid-encounter, while reasoning about SMART on FHIR launches, embedded contexts, API surfaces and rate limits, data mapping, versioning, and the very different constraints each EHR imposes. You need to understand the technicality of each integration well enough to know what is genuinely possible, what is expensive, and what is a dead end.

It is also a deeply human role. You will go onsite with our clients, in clinics, EDs, and on inpatient floors, to see how providers really navigate their EHR and where Nabla fits into their day. Deep user understanding, empathy, and genuine curiosity about clinical workflows are the foundation of everything else.

You will work in a cross-functional squad of backend, and full-stack engineers, and partner constantly beyond it: with the other product squads whose features reach clinicians through your integrations, with Customer Success to deepen our understanding of clients and users, with the Technical Implementation team, and directly with Enterprise clients as you guide them through demanding change management.

If you thrive where regulatory, technical, and UX complexity meet, and you would rather solve the unglamorous problem that unlocks everything downstream, this role is for you.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Nabla’s EHR integrations across existing and new platforms as we expand.

 - Design the end-to-end clinical workflow from launching Nabla inside the EHR to exporting notes, orders, and visit diagnoses back into the chart, so it feels seamless to a clinician working under time pressure.

 - Go onsite with clients to observe how providers navigate their EHR and use Nabla in real encounters, and turn what you see into product decisions and strategic insight.

 - Build deep technical fluency in each EHR’s capabilities and constraints: APIs, FHIR resources, launch contexts, data models, release and validation cycles, so you can make sound trade-offs alongside your engineers.

 - Partner with Design to turn hard integration constraints into simple, trustworthy interfaces that clinicians adopt without training.

 - Collaborate across squads whose capabilities reach clinicians through your integrations, anticipating dependencies and sequencing work accordingly.

 - Bring Enterprise clients live, working with Customer Success and Technical Implementation to guide health systems through demanding change management, rollout, and adoption.

 - Define and track the metrics that matter: adoption across encounters, successful export rates, time spent in the chart, integration reliability, and support burden. Let them drive prioritization.

 - Prioritize ruthlessly across a roadmap that spans new EHR platforms, deepening existing integrations, and the reliability, testability, and documentation work that keeps all of them running.

 - Create alignment across Product, Engineering, Clinical, Go-to-Market, and leadership on priorities, progress, risks, and product decisions.


QUALIFICATIONS

Requirements:

 - 6–10 years of product management experience, including time spent in healthtech or another regulated, safety-critical industry.

 - A track record shipping products built on complex integrations (APIs, developer platforms, or third-party systems), including ownership of versioning, documentation, and partner-facing workflows.

 - Strong systems thinking: you can hold a complex architecture in your head, anticipate dependencies, and make sound technical trade-offs with engineers.

 - Excellent UX judgment, with a demonstrated ability to turn technical constraints into simple, intuitive workflows for non-technical users.

 - Deep user empathy and genuine interest in clinician workflows, and the willingness to travel and spend real time onsite with clients.

 - Exceptional collaboration and communication skills: you are equally comfortable debating a data model with an engineer and walking a health system executive through a rollout plan, and you create alignment across squads and functions.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information, competing priorities, and high ownership.

 - Location: based in our Brooklyn, NY office. This is an in-office-first role (not fully remote), with regular travel to client sites across the US. Full professional fluency in English is required.

Nice to have:

 - Hands-on experience with Epic or the Epic ecosystem (Vendor Services, Hyperspace, Haiku/Canto), or with Oracle Health (Cerner), athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, or MEDITECH.

 - Experience with clinical documentation, orders, coding, or revenue cycle workflows.

 - Prior software engineering experience, or the ability to write scripts and reason about system logs, API schemas, and data models.

 - Experience guiding Enterprise health systems through change management, go-lives, and multi-site rollouts.

 - Experience building products powered by ML/AI.

 - Working proficiency in French is a plus, but not a requirement. Much of our Engineering and Product organization is based in Paris, all work communication happens in English.




LIFE AT NABLA

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.



We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.



We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!



If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!




OUR VALUES AT NABLA

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.



Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.



Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.



Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.



Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.






DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.



As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.







AVOID RECRUITMENT SCAMS: STAY SAFE AND INFORMED

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com http://nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.
