• Background in radar, RF systems, sensors, electronics, telecommunications, aerospace, defense, robotics, industrial equipment, or another complex technical field.

• Experience designing hardware labs, software simulations, troubleshooting scenarios, or technical certification programs.

jobs.description:
Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. At New Era, you'll join a team-oriented culture that prioritizes your personal and professional development. Guided by our core attributes — putting people first, embracing continuous learning, and thriving through collaboration and inclusion — we nurture our people to deliver exceptional customer service.

ITMS Support Specialist, Tier 2 position with New Era Technology offers you the following:

• Full Benefits

• Medical

• Dental

• Vision

• 401K match

• 7 company holidays + generous PTO

*** At this time, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

The ITMS Support Specialist, Tier 2 is responsible for providing high-quality IT technical support services to our clientele. These services may include remote troubleshooting, support for clients with various network technologies, installation and integration, and migration services. The ITMS Support Services, Tier 2 must demonstrate proficiency in the performance of these services. Dedication to quality and customer satisfaction are critical success factors for this position.

PRIMARY DUTIES include but are not limited to:

• Customer Satisfaction through the delivery of world-class Support Services.

• Optimizing productivity while assigned to customer tickets or projects.

• Ability to prioritize work through ticket and project status.

• Problem-solving and resolution of network issues and escalating where appropriate.

• Ticket Quality Control and Ticket Management.

• Customer Service including phone, video, and email communication.

• Documenting process and customer environments.

• Occasional on-call responsibility/rotation.

• Participation in process improvement initiatives.

• Documentation skills for customer environments.

EXPERIENCE:

• 3-5 years’ experience as a Systems Engineer or similar role.

• Ability to troubleshoot, analyze, and configure VMware, O365, backups, desktops, Windows, client/server in a variety of Operating Systems.

• Proven track record and experience with Microsoft, Mac, and Virtual services.

• Participate in planning and execution of new and existing equipment hardware and firmware upgrades, including patching.

• Working technical knowledge of current network hardware, protocols, and internet standards.

• Strong background with ticketing systems and tracking work.

• 1+ years in a customer-facing role, MSP preferred.

• 1+ years working with SaaS products.

• Outstanding capabilities to troubleshoot and correct Server, PC, Desktop, VM, Client/Server issues.

• Strong broad-based knowledge of VM, hardware, operating systems, patching, backup, security protocols, basic understanding of Network protocols, and Remote Management tools.

• Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with all customer contacts.

• Ability to provide clear written communication for ticket/project updates.

• Clear written communication to maintain organization and control over all information related to customer tickets and assignments.

• Excellent verbal skills for customer interaction.

• Excellent documentation skills.

• Dedicated to always providing exceptional customer service.

• Proficiency in all aspects of the core technical requirements.

• Strong team collaboration skills.

REQUIRED EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS:

• High School diploma or equivalent is required.

• Microsoft Certifications preferred.

• Bonus points for Intune, Connectwise, Automate, or N-Able experience.

• Virtualization technology certified a plus (Azure, VMware, and AWS).

• Experience with MSP tools like ITGlue is a bonus.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Regular use of hands and fingers to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment, including repetitive motions such as typing, scrolling, and mouse use. Ability to communicate effectively and understand verbal communication in person, by telephone, and through video conferencing or other remote communication tools. Ability to view and read information on computer screens and printed materials, including the ability to adjust focus. The position requires prolonged periods of computer use and viewing a computer screen.

EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK: This position generally operates during normal business hours; however, specific start and end times may vary based on business needs, workload, and job responsibilities. Occasional work outside of normal business hours may be required.  This role does have an On-Call rotation.  The rotation is typically, 1 week out of 6 weeks.

TRAVEL:    Minimal travel may be required on an as-needed basis.

jobs.title: Apartment Leasing Sales Consultant - Capri North & South
jobs.description:
AIR Communities is hiring an Apartment Leasing Sales Consultant for Capri North & South in Las Vegas, Nevada.

Learn more about the community here: Capri Apartments

This is more than a leasing role. It is an opportunity to build relationships, guide prospective residents through an important decision, and turn interest into signed leases. If you're energized by achieving goals, earning commission, and turning prospects into residents, you'll have the opportunity to directly impact your success and earnings.

What We Offer

AIR rewards strong performance with competitive pay and additional earning opportunities:

• Base Pay of $20 per hour plus uncapped commission opportunities with multiple ways to maximize earnings.
• Multiple opportunities to increase commission per lease including:Higher-rent apartment homes: Updated finishes, larger floorplans, better views, etc.Exceeding monthly goal: Several tiers to increase percentage of total lease value earned per leaseLonger lease term: 18-month or longer vs. the standard 12-month length
• 25% Rent Discount at any AIR community.Option to live onsite with zero commute or at a nearby AIR community.
• Possible Extended Time Off (depending on business need) to enjoy a Winter Break after peak season has ended.
• During this unpaid break, you'll retain your benefits, including your 25% rent discount, while enjoying time to recharge before returning for peak leasing season.

What You Will Do

• Turn qualified prospects into residents through prompt follow-up, engaging tours, and personalized recommendations based on their needs.
• Confidently present apartment homes, amenities, and lease options, address questions, overcome objections, and guide prospects toward choosing their next home.
• Build and manage an active sales pipeline to consistently meet or exceed monthly leasing, conversion, and occupancy goals.
• Maintain accurate prospect activity, appointments, and next steps in AIR’s leasing systems.
• Create an exceptional experience for prospects and residents while supporting community marketing and leasing initiatives.
• Adhere to Fair Housing Laws and Regulations.

Who You Are

• Goal-driven and motivated by achieving and exceeding sales goals.
• Confident building relationships, overcoming objections, and asking for the sale.
• Competitive and energized by conversions, performance metrics, and commission opportunities.
• Organized, responsive, and consistent with follow-up.
• Adaptable to a fast-paced environment and changing priorities.
• Collaborative, accountable, and committed to delivering an exceptional customer experience.

What You Have

• At least 1 year of sales, leasing, hospitality, retail, or customer service experience in a goal-oriented environment.
• Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales, leasing, conversion, or revenue goals.
• Experience engaging customers, understanding their needs, and guiding them toward a decision.
• Strong communication, relationship-building, organization, and objection-handling skills.
• Comfort learning and using leasing, CRM, and communication technology.
• Availability to work Monday and Wednesday through Saturday, 10:00 a.m.–6:30 p.m. Hours may vary based on community and season.
• Reliable transportation.
• Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

Benefits

• Paid time off including vacation, sick time, and 14 holidays.
• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options, HSA/FSA plans, short and long-term disability paid by the company.
• 25% Rent Discount at any AIR community (a rental application is required, and certain exclusions apply).
• 401(k) plan with employer contribution.

jobs.description:
About NORY:
At NORY, we design learning journeys where every child in NYC and Boston becomes a risk-taking entrepreneur, an inquisitive problem solver, and an empathetic leader. We are the largest STEM camp provider in NYC, serving 4,000+ campers annually. We hold every project, every lesson, and every teacher interaction to the highest bar in maker education. Dive into our world at www.nory.co/summer http://www.nory.co/summer, and watch this video: https://youtu.be/G8vgorW3y7U.

The Role:
We are looking for an educator who can imagine a STEM project, build it with their own hands, write the lesson plan, train the teachers, and then show up at the campsite to coach those teachers through delivering it. The work spans the design studio and the classroom. If you are a maker, a curriculum builder, and a teacher coach in equal measure, and you want to shape how Generation Alpha experiences STEM, this role is for you.

The curriculum you build here will not sit in a binder. It will be taught to thousands of children every year, and soon to tens of thousands. The impact compounds. The bar is the highest in maker education.

Your Canvas:
• Curriculum Development: You will turn hands-on STEM projects into lesson plans for children ages 3 to 12, covering learning objectives, pacing, scaffolding, and differentiation across age bands.
• Storytelling and Experience Design: You will wrap each project in an immersive theme. Animal worlds. Musical theater. Inventions for people with disabilities. A week of camp should feel like a Disney World ride and connect dots across disciplines. You bring the “why” that captivates a 7-year-old.
• Hands-On Project Development: You will build and prototype. Alongside our Fabricator team and fellow curriculum developers, you will design and make the STEM projects that campers create: woodworking, basic electronics, Arduino, Microbits, Scratch, and more. You bring your own maker experience to the table, and you hold it to the highest standard of quality.
• Teacher Coaching, at HQ and at Campsites: You will build the training materials and run training at HQ. During summer, you will be at the campsites, observing classrooms in real time, giving teachers immediate feedback, and jumping in when a lesson needs a save.
• The Operations Translator: Your work connects to the team that packs materials, hires teachers, and runs venues. A single missing material on a pack list or a single unclear instruction will show up in a room of 12 kids on a Monday morning. Meticulous documentation is part of the job.
• Quality Control: You will pilot lessons, gather teacher feedback after every camp week, and iterate. Every project must be fail-proof before it ships to a campsite.

Who You Are 
• Teaching and Curriculum Background: You have designed curriculum and taught it.
• Hands-On STEM Maker: You can build. You have made things with woodworking, basic electronics (circuits, motors), Arduino, computing platforms like Raspberry Pi or Microbits, and coding tools like Scratch. You do not need to be a master fabricator, but a portfolio of your own projects is expected. Coding knowledge is a strong plus.
• On the Ground in Summer: You will be at campsites across NYC during the summer season, not behind a screen. The best lesson plans become great curriculum when you are there to coach the teachers delivering them.
• Communication-First: You can write a 10-page teacher guide, record a 60-second video walkthrough, and give live in-classroom feedback to a teacher mid-lesson with equal skill.
• Child Development Insight: You understand how a 4-year-old’s project differs from a 10-year-old’s, and you design and coach accordingly.

Application Requirements:
1. Curriculum portfolio: lesson plans of hands-on STEM projects you developed, demonstrating your strength as a curriculum developer. Optionally, include a portfolio of STEM projects you have built yourself: woodworking, 3D printing, laser cutting, basic electronics, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Microbits, Scratch.
2. Describe your dream 1-week summer camp for ages 5 to 7. What is the exciting activity, the “Big Build,” and which tools (woodworking, coding, or robotics) will the kids learn by Friday?

We are searching for educators who are not just skilled but also aligned with our core values. At NORY, our ‘Ways of Being’ (www.nory.co/value http://www.nory.co/value) guide everything we do:

The Manager - Exploratory Analysis provides statistical expertise to support the research and development organizations for drug discovery, target identification/verification, non-clinical and clinical biomarker exploration to characterize subgroups of patients or markers of disease progression and treatment response for precision medicine. The manager works independently with discovery researchers, translational scientists and clinicians in the design, collection, analysis and reporting of multi-dimensional biomarker data from Discovery to late stage clinical development to enable objective decision-making for each drug development program.

Major Job Responsibilities:

• If assigned, working independently as a point of contact for DIVES to collaborate with translational biomarker scientists and clinicians in the design, analysis and reporting of biomarker and assay studies in association with early and late phase clinical trials. The typical analysis includes pharmacodynamic biomarker analysis, safety biomarker analysis, prognostic and predictive biomarker identification and development, bioassay and companion diagnostic test development, patient subgroup identification based on biomarkers and clinical variables.
• Accountable for data integrity of the responsible statistical analysis and deliverables.
• Providing expertise to design, analysis and reporting of biomarker-based clinical trials or other scientific research studies. Independently developing biomarker section of clinical trial protocols or biomarker analysis plans. Implementing sound statistical methodology in scientific investigations.
• Working independently as a point of contact for DIVES to collaborate with scientists in discovery and translational science units in the design, analysis and reporting of in vitro, in vivo pharmacology studies, and human clinical trials. Identify markers and signatures from internal/external omics/imaging and other biomarker data for target identification, mechanism of action, resistant mechanism, disease progression, patient selection and stratification for precision medicine.
• Independently perform statistical analyses as per the biomarker analysis plan. Independently identifying issues arising in the study design; conducting and proposing scientifically sound approaches. Evaluating appropriateness of available software for planned analyses and assessing needs for potential development of novel statistical methodology.
• Fully accountable for statistics/data presentation and inference. Collaborating in publication of scientific research. Ensuring that study results and conclusions are scientifically sound, clearly presented, and consistent with statistical analyses provided. Clearly explaining statistical concepts, enabling non-statisticians and biomarker collaborators to use existing tools and interpret results better.

Minimum Qualifications:

• MS (with 6+ years of experience) or PhD (with 2+ years of experience) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a highly related field, with some applied consulting or research experience on topics related to pharmaceutical research, bioinformatics, target identification, biomarkers (highly preferred), and subgroup identification.
• Experience with pharmaceutical, clinical trial and/or healthcare statistics

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working on discovery/pre-clinical studies
• Experience in Clinical biomarker modeling and analysis
• Experience with Machine Learning, AI and/or predictive modeling

Other Required Skills:

• High degree of technical competence and effective communication skills, both oral and written
• Able to identify data or analytical issues, and assist with providing solutions by either applying own skills and knowledge or seeking help from others
• Able to build strong relationship with peers and cross-functional partners to achieve higher performance. Highly motivated to drive innovation by raising the bar and challenging the status quo
• Able to integrate high dimensional data from different sources. Familiar with overfitting and multiple testing control methods, such as cross-validation and random resampling techniques. Familiar with machine learning and predictive modeling methods.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 - Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 - Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 - Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 - Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 - Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 - Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 - Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 - Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 - Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 - Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 - Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Engineering or highly technical product background.

 - Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
   
    


OUTCOME

 - Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 - Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 - Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 - AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 - Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 - Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
   
    


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Hiring and Recruitment Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT NORY

NORY is a fast-growing STEM education organization on a mission to nurture Resilient, Inquisitive, and Empathetic Changemakers. We run hands-on camps for kids ages 3 to 12 across New York City and Boston, serving thousands of families each year, and we are now expanding nationally through franchising. Our work is high-stakes and high-care: every project a child builds, every educator we hire, every family we serve shapes whether we live up to our mission.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

Hiring is the biggest unlock for NORY's next phase of growth, and we need a Recruitment Specialist to own it with us. The best candidates for NORY are not browsing job boards. They are already employed, already loved by their teams, and only move when the right person reaches out with the right pitch. Your job is to find those people, get them interested, and shepherd them through a clean, fast, respectful process.

This is a part-time, fully remote contractor role. You will partner with hiring managers across NORY (Operations, Customer Happiness, Curriculum, Marketing, and Camp Delivery) to fill priority openings.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Source passive candidates: identify people who are not actively looking, write tailored outreach, and convert them into applicants.

 - Manage inbound applications across LinkedIn, Indeed, and our ATS (Ashby), keeping every candidate moving forward or out within 48 hours.

 - Run first-round screens (phone or video) using NORY's structured interview rubric.

 - Track recruiting metrics weekly: applicants by source, time-to-screen, screen-to-offer, and pass-through rates by stage.

 - Coordinate scheduling between candidates and hiring managers.

 - Maintain a "warm bench" of strong candidates for future openings.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - 3+ years of recruiting experience, in-house or agency, with a track record of sourcing passive candidates (not just processing inbound).

 - You can write outreach that gets replies, and you can show us real examples.

 - Familiar with at least one modern ATS (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever) and confident on LinkedIn Recruiter.

 - Organized to the point that nothing falls through the cracks. You run on systems, not memory.

 - Honest about candidate quality. You would rather tell us "no one this week" than push a weak candidate forward.

 


HOW WE OPERATE

NORY operates by a set of Ways of Being that guide how we hire, teach, and treat each other. We move with urgency and care, we tell the truth quickly, and we hold a high bar for both rigor and warmth. You can read the full set at www.nory.co/value http://www.nory.co/value. If those values resonate, you will thrive here.

 


COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE

 - $27 to $37 per hour, based on experience and demonstrated sourcing track record.

 - 10 to 20 hours per week, fully remote.

 - Flexible schedule with two non-negotiable weekly touchpoints: a Monday planning sync and a Friday metrics review.

 - Contractor (1099) engagement, with a clear path to expanded scope as NORY grows.

 


HOW TO APPLY

Apply through this posting and complete the application questions on Ashby. We read every response carefully, so make them count.

If you have a specific reason you want to work with NORY (a passive candidate you would source for us on day one, a recruiting playbook you have run that fits our stage, or a personal connection to our mission), email Sofia directly at sofia@nory.co. Tell us what you would do, not just who you are.

 


EEO STATEMENT

NORY is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Director, Customer Support
jobs.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

This role will lead a team to deliver world-class support to Heartflow’s customers, including physicians and hospital staff using our revolutionary SaaS technology to manage their patients. This person will lead overall customer support processes, including resolution of customer issues and all investigations of customer complaints regarding HeartFlow’s product quality and accuracy.

This role will be central to coordinating cross-functional efforts needed to support Heartflow’s customers, including investigating issues, summarizing customer feedback and data, and representing customer needs and priorities to other departments in the company. This person has a primary responsibility to ensure an outstanding end-to-end customer experience with Heartflow.

Job Responsibilities:

• Lead a team of customer support specialists to ensure Heartflow’s customers have excellent experience with our SaaS non-invasive medical technology.

• Grow talent within the support team. Identify needed skills, upskill team members, coach and mentor individuals for success.

• Define strategies to scale customer support efficiently with commercial growth.

• Develop and maintain training, tools, and processes to improve customer satisfaction and first contact resolution or efficient escalation.

• Collaborate with other team members to ensure our technology, tools, and business systems are optimized for servicing our customer.

• Take a data-driven approach to monitoring and improving customer satisfaction. Identify signals that Heartflow’s commercial team can proactively take action upon to improve customer experience and adoption.

• Define, track, and deliver on KPIs and metrics.

• Provide input to customer-facing product update plans and ensure adequate preparation to support and train customers and field team members for new product features.

• Identify and report on trends across all customer feedback/complaints to provide voice-of-customer to Product and Engineering teams to help prioritize improvements and defect corrections.

• Lead and define cross-functional requirements to meet service levels, processes, escalation, and resources to support our customers’ needs.

• Ensure all support and activities comply with medical regulatory standards.

Skills Needed:

• Effective project and personnel management with ability to help employees develop technical and professional skills

• Positive personality and comfortable in front of customers and collaborating with other Heartflow teams

• Ability to organize and analyze data and trends, including tracking of quality records and summarizing data for quality reviews

• Responsible, accountable, and able to organize multiple projects, including cross-functional efforts

• Practical problem-solving approach with ability to lead by example

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Familiar with CRM, ticketing systems, SaaS tools, and Excel or other data analysis tools

• Understanding of regulations for compliance (e.g. 21 CFR 820.198, 21 CFR 803, 21 CFR 806, ISO13485, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.)

• Preferred Skills: Healthcare IT - Working knowledge of PACS, DICOM, HIPAA requirements and PHI protections Knowledge of imaging and CT scanner technology Understanding of coronary physiology

Educational Requirements & Work Experience:

• BS or BA degree or equivalent in related experience. Medical or technical training preferred.

• 8+ years of management experience.

jobs.title: R&D Insights and Operations - Growth
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We're looking for a builder to help construct a world class Growth organization. This is an opinionated leader that is motivated by creating big picture vision and digging into where the biggest opportunities are, sizing them, and building the systems, rigor, and connective tissue that let Growth and GTM operate cohesively. This is a member of Gusto's Insights & Operations (I&O) team — our internal Strategy/BizOps function — embedded against Growth, partnering closely with our Head of Growth and our CRO-side GTM leadership.

This role is intentionally IC-first. You'll start by going deep on the highest-leverage problems in Growth, build a point of view grounded in data, and drive it to outcome. As trust and scope grow, this role is expected to expand — most likely into owning the operating bridge between Growth and our broader go-to-market organization, and potentially into building and leading a small team.

About the Team:

Gusto's Growth organization is on an ambitious trajectory: we're building toward a much more self-serve-led motion, and the opportunity ahead is significant. As Growth scales, we have a chance to be much more intentional about how it connects to Product and to our go-to-market teams (sales, demand gen, expansion sales, pricing, etc) — building a shared, prioritized roadmap and clear visibility into dependencies from the ground up, rather than retrofitting it later.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Identify and size the highest-leverage opportunities for Growth: go from a fuzzy problem to a clear-eyed analysis of the opportunity, a recommendation on whether to pursue it, and a plan if the answer is yes.

• Anchor on problems, not headcount: dig into what's actually slowing the Growth organization down, define how to build a best in class engine, size the opportunity, and decide what's worth solving before proposing who or what is needed — not the reverse.

• Build the operating rhythm for Growth and drive execution against it: planning cycles, prioritization, and a shared, prioritized roadmap that makes trade-offs and dependencies visible across Growth R&D, Product R&D, and GTM.

• Bring real analytical rigor to how Growth invests — attribution, LTV, and testing/experimentation discipline — so decisions about where to deploy resources are tied clearly to business impact.

• Close the gap between Growth R&D and go-to-market: build the mechanisms (shared roadmap, dependency tracking, decision forums) that let both orgs operate as one team working toward the same number, rather than two orgs trading requests.

• Design an operating system anchored in technology vs. humans: build the muscle and mechanisms the Growth org can through automation, and hand off ownership once a system is running

• Act as a trusted advisor to Growth leadership: pressure-test strategy, surface risks and blind spots early, and bring an opinionated point of view, not just facilitation.

• Use AI as a default, not an add-on: build reusable, AI-powered workflows for planning, synthesis, and reporting so manual coordination is the exception, not the norm.

• Spot when a team is optimizing for the wrong thing: recognize when more effort against the current approach won't get us where we need to go, and push teams toward a fundamentally different path rather than a marginal improvement.

• Raise the bar for how I&O operates, not just how Growth operates: share what's working, question what isn't, and help the broader I&O team build a stronger, more consistent craft.

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 15+ years in operations, business operations, or strategy & ops at a high-growth technology company. This must include time spent building a growth function from an earlier, less mature stage.

• Direct experience with the discipline behind growth decision-making: attribution and LTV modeling, testing and experimentation, and translating marketing/growth spend into demonstrable business impact.

• Own and evolve the practice’s AI security offerings, and author the reference architectures, standards, and design patterns that allow the Security Solutions practices to deliver one coherent AI security answer to a client rather than several overlapping ones.

• Subject matter expertise of AI security and Trustworthy AI Principles, Frameworks and Standards including, but not limited to NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001:2023, ISO 5338:2024, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and Agentic Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and CSA AI controls.

• Working knowledge of AI governance and regulatory requirements (including the EU AI Act and emerging U.S. state and sector requirements) sufficient to partner effectively with Governance, Risk & Compliance on AI risk programs.

• Working knowledge and hands-on experience with at least one (preferably multiple) major cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), their AI platforms and services, and their native AI security capabilities.

• Knowledge and hands-on experience with technologies that operationalize AI security, including but not limited to AI security posture management, LLM gateways and guardrails, AI runtime protection, agent identity and authorization, model registries and AI supply chain controls, and AI-aware data security.

• Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with software engineers, data scientists, platform teams, and security personnel to assess security risks and requirements throughout the AI development and deployment lifecycle.

• Certifications including CISSP, CCSP, AIGP, AAISM, or cloud AI/security certifications from at least one major CSP are highly preferred.

• Prior experience packaging offerings, authoring reference architectures, or running technical enablement or certification programs is highly preferred.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills are required.

• Motivated self-starter who loves to solve challenging problems and feels comfortable working directly with customers.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, excellent time management skills and able to effectively prioritize tasks in a fast-paced, high-volume, and evolving work environment.

jobs.title: Founding Growth Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for banks. We work with some of America's largest financial institutions, helping them scale their contact center and compliance operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $2 billion in transactions and have raised a $24M Series A led by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you are interested in building AI that is applied in the real world where precision, reliability, and performance matter and redefine access to credit across the world, apply below.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Founding Growth Lead to build the systems and campaigns that bring Kastle into new accounts and markets.

You’ll figure out who we should reach, what matters to them, and how to get in front of them. You’ll write the message, launch the campaign, build the tools behind it, measure the response, and use what you learn to improve the next one. You’ll also own the product story across our website, sales materials, newsletter, and events.

This is a hands-on role with wide ownership. The right person is an excellent writer and a fast operator who can build with data, automation, and AI tools. They have the taste to make Kastle memorable and the discipline to see whether their work creates real sales opportunities.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build a live map of our market. Identify target accounts, buyers, relationships, and opportunities across our current segments and new verticals. Keep account maps current as we meet prospects, win customers, and learn where Kastle can expand.
   

 - Create paths into important accounts. Work with our investors and broader VC network to identify relevant connections, prepare thoughtful outreach, and turn warm introductions into conversations.
   

 - Own outbound and marketing experiments. Build lists, develop a hypothesis for each audience, write the copy, and launch campaigns. Test different messages and channels by segment; track replies, meetings, and pipeline; and keep improving the targeting and positioning.
   

 - Build the growth tooling. Create agents, automations, dashboards, and workflows that help us maintain the market map, run campaigns, track leads and ads, and give sales a reliable view of what is working.
   

 - Own Kastle’s product messaging. Turn customer conversations and product capabilities into clear positioning, website copy, slides, sales materials, and a product newsletter built from scratch.
   

 - Own Kastle presence at Events. Plan and execute conferences, smaller events, and campaigns across the industries we serve. Own the audience, invitations, experience, sales preparation, and follow-up.
   

 - Find creative ways to reach buyers. Test ideas such as thoughtful gifting, podcasts, customer programs, and Kastle-hosted events. Choose ideas for the audience they reach and the conversations they can create, then execute them with care.
   


A PROJECT YOU MIGHT OWN

Build a market map that is living and auto-updates daily. Start with the accounts and buyers we want to reach. Connect them to our existing relationships, outreach, meetings, customers, and events. Create a way for the map to stay current as the team books new calls and launches new products then use it to decide which accounts to pursue and what to say to them.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Creative with good taste: You can develop a sharp message or an unusual campaign that feels right for a senior buyer.

 - Resourceful: You find a way forward one way or another. You never stop at a no. 

 - Fast and thorough: You move quickly without losing details, deadlines, or follow-up.

 - Technical and curious: You’re comfortable building with data, AI tools, automations, and integrations. You can learn a new tool quickly and know when a simple system beats a complicated one.

 - Analytical: You care whether a campaign produces the right conversations, and you change your approach when it doesn’t.

 - Highly independent: You can take an ambitious goal, decide what to do first, and own the work through execution.

 - High energy: You enjoy talking to people, testing ideas, and making things happen in the real world.

You may have worked in growth, product marketing, GTM engineering, founder’s office, or built something yourself. We care most about what you’ve personally created and the results it produced.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume or LinkedIn profile and one example of a campaign, event, or internal tool you built that you are proud of. Tell us what you owned, how you made decisions, and what happened as a result.

jobs.description:

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Solutions Architect, Security Operations will be responsible for providing architect-level thought leadership and expertise across modern security operations including endpoint detection and response, SIEM/SOAR, agentic SOC, and AI-assisted detection engineering, and AI-ready threat, exposure, and vulnerability management, including continuous threat exposure management (CTEM), threat-informed prioritization, attack surface and attack path analysis, and closed-loop remediation validation. Under the direction of Security Operations leadership, the Senior Solutions Architect will lead Trace3’s most complex client architecture engagements across these domains and translate that work into the reference architectures, offerings, and enablement that allow Trace3’s regional technical teams to sell and deliver Security Operations solutions consistently and at scale. This is a client-facing, presales role in a practice built to lead where AI is rebuilding both how organizations detect and respond to threats and how they find, prioritize, and eliminate exposure.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

• Lead client engagements as the senior architect for target-state SOC architecture, SIEM/SOAR modernization and consolidation, agentic SOC and AI-assisted detection design, and CTEM and vulnerability operations redesign, from discovery through executive readout.

• Assess client current state and deliver strategic, tactical, and operational recommendations that translate detection, response, and exposure capabilities into business risk, investment, and operating-model terms for CISO- and board-level audiences.

• Design target-state threat and exposure management architectures that unify vulnerability management, attack surface management (EASM/CAASM), cloud and container posture, identity exposure, and attack path analysis into a single prioritized view of risk.

• Define defensible risk scoring, remediation SLAs, and accountability models, combining threat intelligence, exploitability evidence (EPSS, KEV), asset criticality, and compensating controls, that client IT, cloud, and application owners will accept and execute.

• Architect the AI layer of security operations and exposure management, including agentic enrichment and deduplication of findings, automated remediation routing, natural-language executive reporting, and closed-loop validation through breach and attack simulation, penetration testing, and purple-team findings.

• Converge detection and exposure operations so exposure context informs detection and response prioritization, and detection, incident, and threat-hunting findings feed back into exposure prioritization, one threat-informed loop, not two disconnected programs.

• Govern the data foundation that agentic SOC and exposure workflows depend on: asset inventory and ownership fidelity, findings normalization across scanners and platforms, and security data pipeline and platform decisions.

• Author and maintain the practice's reference architectures, assessment frameworks, and packaged offerings, including SOC maturity and AI-readiness assessment, SIEM/SOAR migration, agentic SOC readiness, and exposure management program design, each with defined scope and a delivery playbook.

• Collaborate with Security Solutions practices, Regional teams, Managed Services, and Service Delivery to scope, design, and hand off engagements that can be delivered repeatably without the architect's continued involvement.

• Develop and deliver enablement and certification content for regional architects and sellers, including delivery playbooks for standardized work (EDR migration, SIEM onboarding, detection content standards) and opportunity qualification guidance.

• Serve as the practice’s senior technical counterpart to priority Security Operations partners (such as Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, Microsoft, and Google), influencing roadmaps, shaping joint offerings, and securing co-funded enablement and lab capacity.

• Support account teams on qualified opportunities with solution design, competitive positioning, proposal and SOW creation, and technical validation.

• Provide subject matter expertise on AI in security operations, AI-assisted triage, LLM-based detection engineering, agentic workflows, and agent governance, and stay current on the threat landscape, standards, and frameworks.

• Advocate for Trace3 through speaking engagements, publications, field briefings, and industry events.

• Mentor solutions architects, early-career practitioners, and interns across regions, transferring judgment as well as knowledge.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity or equivalent information security, engineering, or like discipline from an accredited college or university, or measurable knowledge / experience from proven industry, military, defense, or government operations.

• 8+ years’ experience in security operations, exposure management, or both, including hands-on ownership of detection engineering, SIEM/SOAR content and automation, SOC operations, or enterprise vulnerability and exposure operations, beyond product implementation alone.

• Experience in a customer-facing presales, solutions architecture, or technology consulting role within a VAR, systems integrator, consultancy, or technology vendor.

• Deep expertise in at least two of the following: SIEM/SOAR platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Splunk); endpoint/EDR/XDR (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne); threat, exposure, and vulnerability management, including CTEM and attack surface management (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, Axonius, XM Cyber, Cymulate); identity and cloud telemetry integration.

• Demonstrated ability to design target-state security operations architectures, including platform consolidation and migration strategy, detection-as-code, exposure-as-code, and SOC and exposure operating models.

• Demonstrated experience designing or operating a risk-based vulnerability management or CTEM program at enterprise scale, including asset inventory and ownership, findings normalization across multiple scanners and platforms, threat-informed prioritization, remediation SLAs, and executive-level exposure reporting.

• Working knowledge of exposure prioritization inputs and standards, including CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, and SSVC, and of threat intelligence enrichment, with a defensible point of view on where each is useful and where each misleads.

• Familiarity with attack path analysis, breach and attack simulation, and adversarial validation, and how each should inform remediation priority and measure program effectiveness.

• Practical experience building, evaluating, or operating AI-assisted security operations and exposure management capabilities, with an informed point of view on what works, what does not yet, and how such capabilities should be governed.

• Working knowledge of Cybersecurity Principles, Frameworks and Standards including NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE D3FEND, ISO 27001, and CTEM-aligned exposure frameworks; familiarity with OWASP AI, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework is a plus.

• Working knowledge and experience with at least one (preferably multiple) major cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their native security telemetry.

• Certifications such as GIAC (GCIA, GCDA, GCFA, GDAT), CISSP, or vendor architecture certifications on the platforms above are highly preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Artist Success
jobs.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Artist Success team. You will take technical ownership of the tools that help artists understand their audiences, grow their careers, and help the music industry discover its next stars. You will work within a high-performing, multi-disciplinary squad across our frontend (React, iOS, and Android) and backend (GraphQL, TypeScript) services, focused on strategic Artist Success products including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and artist-facing growth and insights experiences. This is an IC-heavy role for a technical expert who wants to drive architecture and execution while maintaining a hands-on presence in the code.

The ideal candidate has a track record of building and evolving complex, high-quality products across frontend, API, backend, and data systems. You are a generalist who can navigate user-facing application logic, service architecture, data-intensive systems, or infrastructure bottlenecks with equal ease.

Key Responsibilities:

• Work closely with engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and other partners to shape the technical direction and roadmap across Artist Success products, including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and related artist-facing experiences. You'll help the team make thoughtful architectural decisions and build scalable, secure systems that support large datasets and high-performance user experiences

• Act as a senior technical contributor for a small, expert squad. You will contribute through architectural clarity, rigorous peer reviews, and a focus on maintaining high execution momentum

• Work as a peer to Product Managers and Designers to define requirements across Artist Success. You'll turn vague business "wants" into concrete technical "hows," ensuring the team builds the right things in the most efficient way

• Ensure high technical standards across frontend and backend disciplines. While the team is highly capable, you are responsible for contributing to the overall technical health, consistency, and long-term sustainability of the codebase

• Own the infrastructure and health of your domain. You'll manage deployment patterns, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and ensure we adhere to modern security standards

• Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier while keeping the needs, judgment, and experience of the people using and building our products at the center of the work

Experience and Background:

• 4-6+ years of experience with React and modern frontend development, with the ability to influence architectural decisions and drive best practices; experience with native iOS or Android applications is a plus

• Strong proficiency in GraphQL and TypeScript for building reliable APIs and services, with familiarity in Golang or Scala, and a strong understanding of storage, querying, and data-intensive systems such as BigQuery and SQL

• Strong capability in Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform, and container orchestration

• Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, design, and data

• Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI and agentic tools to improve quality and velocity, while applying sound judgment around when human expertise is essential and maintaining code quality, product standards, maintainability, and user experience

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $190,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below!

About us:

• We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)

• We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home

• We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard

• We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

• Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources

• Robust 401k program

• Employee Equity Plan

• Generous professional development allowance

• Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!

• Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually

• 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children

• Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

As a Design Engineer at Superpower, you will shape and build the interfaces through which members understand and manage their health. You will collaborate closely with designers and product engineers to turn complex health information into clear, intuitive experiences, taking ideas from early prototypes through production. This is a hands-on opportunity to combine design judgment with engineering depth and influence how our product looks, feels, and works.

You will work primarily in React and TypeScript, with ownership of the details that make an experience feel considered: typography, layout, motion, interaction, and performance.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and build intuitive interfaces for core member journeys, from understanding health results to navigating ongoing care.

 - Collaborate with product, design, and clinical teams to translate complex information into clear, accessible experiences.

 - Create interactive prototypes to explore ideas, test assumptions, and help the team choose a direction.

 - Build and maintain reusable components and interaction patterns that improve consistency across the product.

 - Own interface quality across responsive layouts, loading and error states, accessibility, and performance.

 - Work with backend and mobile engineers to integrate real data, ship complete experiences, and improve them through feedback and product usage.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - A portfolio of interfaces you have designed and built, demonstrating your personal contribution, technical decisions, and attention to detail.

 - Strong experience with React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend development practices.

 - Excellent visual and interaction design judgment, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, and motion.

 - The ability to explore ideas in Figma or code, explain your decisions, and work constructively through critique.

 - Experience building production interfaces that handle real data, different screen sizes, accessibility needs, and edge cases.

 - Demonstrated ability to own work independently from prototype through release, including testing and debugging code developed with AI tools. An interest in healthcare, wellness, or longevity is a strong plus.


TECH STACK

 - Languages & Frameworks: React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS

 - UI & Components: Tailwind CSS, Storybook

 - Design & Prototyping: Figma, interactive prototypes in code

 - Product & Collaboration: Linear, Notion, Slack


WORK LOCATION & ENVIRONMENT

This is an in-person role based in San Francisco. You will work closely with product, design, clinical, and engineering teammates, with room to explore ideas and responsibility for carrying them through to a polished product.

We believe better health gives people more freedom to do the things that matter to them. Understanding and managing your health should be simpler, more personal, and part of everyday life.

Superpower is the product we’ve always wanted: a thoughtfully designed, all-in-one platform for understanding and improving our health.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Application Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Manufacturing Applications Systems Administrator-CO

Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Manufacturing Applications Systems Administrator to support, maintain, and improve the enterprise applications used across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and production planning.

This role will administer manufacturing platforms such as Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE, DELMIA/Apriso, Manufacturo, and ComplianceQuest (CQ). The application portfolio supports Product Lifecycle Management and Product Data Management (PLM/PDM), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Quality Management Systems (QMS), and Material Requirements Planning (MRP).

The administrator will partner with business process owners, IT teams, and software vendors to keep these systems reliable, secure, and aligned with operational needs. The ideal candidate combines hands-on application administration experience with an understanding of manufacturing processes and a practical approach to troubleshooting and continuous improvement. This is an onsite role supporting our Legacy Space Micro Team in San Diego, CA.

Key Responsibilities

Application Administration and Support

• Administer, configure, maintain, and support manufacturing applications across development, test, and production environments.

• Manage user accounts, roles, permissions, licenses, and access reviews in coordination with IT security and business owners.

• Configure workflows, forms, business rules, notifications, reports, and dashboards to support approved business requirements.

• Monitor application health, scheduled jobs, integrations, and performance; investigate and resolve issues affecting users or production operations.

• Provide advanced application support, document resolutions, and coordinate escalations with software vendors and implementation partners.

• Maintain application documentation, including configurations, support procedures, system dependencies, and troubleshooting guides.

Manufacturing Process Support

• Support PLM/PDM processes involving engineering documents, product structures, bills of materials, revisions, and engineering changes.

• Support MES processes involving work instructions, production execution, work-in-process tracking, genealogy, and traceability.

• Support QMS processes involving document control, nonconformances, corrective and preventive actions, audits, and training records.

• Support MRP processes and associated application dependencies involving material requirements, inventory availability, and production planning.

• Work with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams to translate operational needs into application improvements.

Integration and Data Management

• Monitor and troubleshoot data exchanges among PLM/PDM, MES, QMS, MRP, ERP, and other connected systems.

• Partner with integration specialists and developers to maintain interfaces, resolve synchronization failures, and improve data reliability.

• Support controlled data imports, exports, migrations, and master data maintenance.

• Help establish and maintain data ownership, accuracy, consistency, and traceability across applications.

Change Management, Security, and Reliability

• Plan and coordinate application upgrades, patches, configuration changes, and releases using established change management procedures.

• Develop and execute application test plans, coordinate user acceptance testing, and document results before production deployment.

• Coordinate maintenance windows and communicate changes or outages to affected stakeholders.

• Support audit readiness through appropriate access controls, change records, system documentation, and evidence collection.

• Partners with infrastructure teams and vendors on backup, recovery, and business continuity requirements.

• Support system validation and controlled documentation were required by the organization’s quality or regulatory obligations.

Business Partnership and Continuous Improvement

• Gather requirements, evaluate proposed enhancements, and recommend practical solutions.

• Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve user experience.

• Develop user guides and provide training for end users and application superusers.

• Participate in application implementations, site rollouts, and cross-functional improvement projects.

Required Qualifications

• Requires a minimum of a bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, engineering, manufacturing, or a related field, or combination of lower education combined with equivalent practical experience.

• Five or more years of experience administering or supporting enterprise applications in a manufacturing environment.

• Hands-on experience with one or more PLM/PDM, MES, QMS, MRP, or ERP platforms.

• Working knowledge of manufacturing processes and the relationships among engineering, production, quality, inventory, and planning.

• Experience with application configuration, role-based access, workflow administration, troubleshooting, and change management.

• Familiarity with relational databases, SQL queries, APIs, and application integrations.

• Experience supporting application upgrades, testing, and production releases.

• Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities and communicate effectively with both technical teams and business users.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct administration experience with 3DEXPERIENCE, DELMIA/Apriso, Manufacturo, ComplianceQuest, or similar tools.

• Experience administering multiple manufacturing application platforms or supporting multiple manufacturing sites.

• Familiarity with Salesforce administration, particularly in support of ComplianceQuest.

• Experience with ERP integrations and the flow of bills of materials, routings, work orders, inventory, and quality data.

• Experience with scripting or automation using tools such as PowerShell, Python, or platform-specific utilities.

• Familiarity with single sign-on, enterprise identity management, and application security controls.

• Experience in regulated or quality-controlled manufacturing environments.

• Relevant platform administration certifications or IT service management training.

What Success Looks Like

• Manufacturing applications are reliable and support daily operational needs.

• Support issues are resolved promptly, with recurring problems addressed at their source.

• Application changes are tested, documented, and deployed with minimal operational disruption.

• System access and configurations remain controlled and auditable.

• Data moves accurately between connected systems.

• Business teams receive effective support, useful training, and measurable improvements to their workflows.

Working Conditions

• Regular collaboration with manufacturing floor personnel and engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT teams.

• Occasional support outside normal business hours for production issues, maintenance, or application releases.

The good faith base salary range or this role is $90,000–$130,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range will depend on experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

• Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees

• Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide, including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness, and more! No long-term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll

• 401(k) retirement plan with a 50% company match on contributions up to 8%, supporting long-term financial security

• Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being

• Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources

• The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission-driven environment

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer (iOS)
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

As a Mobile Engineer at Superpower, you will own the quality and development of our iOS experience. You will collaborate with product, design, and engineering to build fast, intuitive experiences that help members understand their health and take action. This is a hands-on opportunity to shape the app’s architecture, build its core features, and take responsibility for the experience from development through App Store release.

You will work across Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit and React Native, Expo, and TypeScript, with strong hands-on expertise in both native iOS and React Native development. You will shape our mobile architecture, build native integrations, and choose the right approach for each experience based on performance, product quality, and development speed.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and build mobile experiences in Swift and React Native for health results, biomarker data, chat, and other core member journeys.

 - Collaborate with product, design, and clinical teams to make complex health information clear and useful.

 - Own mobile architecture, reusable components, and the integration between Swift and React Native, including native capabilities such as HealthKit, authentication, notifications, and media access.

 - Improve app performance, navigation, accessibility, and reliability across devices and network conditions.

 - Own testing, observability, release tooling, and App Store delivery, with careful handling of sensitive health information.

 - Work with web and backend engineers on shared data contracts, reusable logic, and development patterns that help the team ship across platforms.


QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Contract Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT HIGGSFIELD

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re looking for a highly operational, systems-minded Contract Manager to own and scale our commercial contracting processes. Sitting at the intersection of Legal, Finance, and GTM, you’ll help ensure contracts move quickly and accurately while maintaining the right level of process, visibility, and risk management.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys turning complex or manual processes into simple, scalable systems. You’ll manage the day-to-day contracting lifecycle while owning the infrastructure behind it—from intake and approvals to Ironclad workflows, templates, reporting, and automation.

You’ll be successful in this role if you’re highly organized, comfortable operating with autonomy, and constantly looking for ways to make contracting faster and easier for the business.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Commercial Contracting

 - Manage the full lifecycle of commercial agreements, including creator and influencer agreements, agency MSAs, PR and sponsorship agreements, content licensing, referral agreements, contractor and consulting agreements, NDAs, order forms, amendments, and vendor agreements.

 - Own contract intake across Growth, Marketing, PR, Recruiting, Finance, and B2B; route, prioritize, track, and drive requests through completion.

 - Independently draft, review, and negotiate NDAs within approved playbooks and fallbacks.

 - Prepare first drafts and markups of commercial agreements using Higgsfield templates and playbooks, escalating exceptions to Legal with clear recommendations.

 - Conduct final quality checks and coordinate Legal, Finance, and executive approvals before signature.

 - Route approved agreements through Ironclad and DocuSign and ensure executed agreements are properly filed.

 - Manage contracting SLAs, proactively flag delays, and maintain clear visibility into open matters.

Ironclad & Contract Operations

 - Co-own the build and ongoing administration of Ironclad, including intake workflows, approval logic, templates, clause libraries, metadata, permissions, repository structure, and reporting.

 - Translate Higgsfield’s contracting playbooks into standardized clauses, approved fallbacks, escalation rules, and automated workflows.

 - Build and maintain self-service intake workflows and templates across B2B and non-B2B agreements.

 - Maintain permissions, record types, legacy agreements, and repository hygiene so Ironclad remains the single source of truth.

 - Troubleshoot workflow issues and partner with workflow engineers when technical support is required.

 - Build reporting around contract volume, cycle times, SLAs, and bottlenecks.

 - Support integrations and automation across Finance, Security, Slack, AI-assisted review, and other systems.

 - Onboard teams to Ironclad and create lightweight documentation that drives adoption.

Operational Excellence

 - Own matters from intake through execution, filing, and stakeholder communication.

 - Maintain accurate trackers and provide concise, proactive updates without requiring follow-up.

 - Identify gaps in templates, workflows, or processes and take ownership of resolving them.

 - Apply approved templates and playbooks independently while escalating exceptions early.

 - Continuously improve contracting processes through better workflows, automation, reporting, and AI tooling.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years in contract management, legal operations, or commercial operations, ideally at a high-growth technology company.

 - Deep hands-on Ironclad experience building and launching workflows, templates, approvals, permissions, playbooks, and reporting. This is a must.

 - Experience scaling or cleaning up a CLM, including legacy migrations, record consolidation, and workflow rollouts.

 - Ability to independently negotiate NDAs and prepare first-pass commercial agreement markups using established playbooks.

 - Strong working knowledge of commercial agreements and contracting lifecycles; a law degree is not required.

 - Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through in a high-volume environment.

 - Strong judgment around applying playbooks, meeting SLAs, and knowing when to escalate to Legal.

 - Collaborative, clear communicator who works effectively across Legal, Finance, Growth, Recruiting, PR, and leadership.

 - Familiarity with automation and AI tools such as n8n and Claude, with an interest in using technology to scale legal operations.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long-term growth.

• Base Salary: The anticipated salary range for this role is $110,000 - $150,000, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location.

• Equity: In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth. 

• Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally

• Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales.

 

This is a fully remote role based in the United States, with occasional business travel to our San Francisco office required for team meetings, planning sessions, company events, and other in-person collaboration.
