If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address.



To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement https://www.hims.com/global-candidate-privacy-statement.

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Histology (Contract)
jobs.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Mirai Bio is a privately-held, Flagship-founded biotechnology company that is delivering genetic medicines from promise to performance. Mirai was built to solve one of the field’s central challenges: achieving precise, scalable delivery of diverse nucleic acid payloads to specific cells and tissues, particularly beyond the liver. By combining a large and growing proprietary in vivo biodistribution dataset, machine learning-guided lipid nanoparticle optimization, modular targeted particle design, and integrated translation and manufacturing capabilities, Mirai helps partners accelerate development, reduce technical risk, and pursue high-value programs making delivery a strategic advantage. We are seeking collaborative, relentless problem solvers that share our passion for defining the future of genetic medicines together.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Research Associate, Histology contractor to join the Platform Group at Mirai Bio to support laboratory research activities towards development of novel technologies enabling next generation genomic medicines. The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of the technical and equipment needs in a lab as well as significant hands-on experience with standard histology, cell culturing and in vitro cell biology techniques. They will work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Performing laboratory assays and tasks including processing tissues for histology, plate-based reporter assays and additional in vitro assays

• Review data slides to streamline optimization and data analysis of immune histochemistry and immuno florescence readouts

• Help manage external vendors and CRO in support of histology assays

• Developing new assays or optimizing existing ones based on in-depth knowledge of laboratory techniques.

• Analyzing and accurately documenting assay results in an electronic lab notebook or other technical reporting formats

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

• BS or MS in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or related scientific discipline

• BS + 5 years of relevant industry or research experience

• MS + 3 years of relevant industry or research experience

• Previous experience with histology evaluation and in vitro cell based assays is required

• Strong cell culture experience, including experience executing protocols, troubleshooting assays is preferred

• Prior experience working with lipid nanoparticles is a plus

• Proven ability to work independently and cross-functionally with highly skilled teams in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and technical environment

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

• Motivated, curious, and comfortable working with highly technical projects and personnel

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying technical information in a clear and thorough manner

ABOUT FLAGSHIP PIONEERING:

Flagship Pioneering invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health, sustainability and beyond. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated more than 100 companies. Many of these companies have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We recognize that great candidates often bring unique strengths without fulfilling every qualification. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your background and interest in Flagship.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Flagship Pioneering and its affiliated Flagship Lab companies (collectively, “FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to FSP or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

#LI-TL1

The salary range for this role is $38 - $51. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. Mirai Bio currently offers healthcare coverage, annual incentive program, retirement benefits and a broad range of other benefits. Compensation and benefits information is based on Mirai Bio's good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

Privacy Notice for Applicants: When you apply for a role at Flagship Pioneering or one of its portfolio companies, we collect and use personal information you provide (such as your name, contact details, work history, and application materials) to evaluate your application, communicate with you, and comply with legal obligations. Your application data is processed through Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system, and may also be reviewed using AI-assisted screening tools. We do not sell your personal information. California residents have rights under the CCPA/CPRA including to know, delete, and opt out of the sharing of their personal information. If you are located in the EU or UK, we process your data under GDPR and you have rights to access, rectify, and erase your data. To exercise your rights or for questions, contact privacy@flagshippioneering.com.

jobs.title: Senior Designer, Events
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

YOUR MISSION

The Senior Designer, Experiential owns the creative development and direction of True Anomaly’s events experiences.

You develop experiential concepts and creative direction that make complex technology tangible and create a clear, memorable experience of the company. Working from creative and business strategy, you define how True Anomaly shows up physically at events; the spatial form, narrative journey, and environmental expression.

For assigned work, you define the concept, narrative, user journey, visual language and environmental expression, then maintain that creative direction through install and event launch.

Our Principal, Experiential & Environmental Design owns the broader vision and standards for True Anomaly’s physical expression. You work closely with them and apply and extend that overarching direction within events, partnering with Creative Strategy and Business Development on where and why the company should show up, and with production teams that own the operational planning and delivery.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Event Strategy and Creative Partnership

• Partner with Marketing and Creative Strategy to understand the strategic intent behind events: why it matters, who it must reach, and what the audience should believe or feel. Advise on how experiential format and investment level can best serve those objectives.

• Collaborate with Business Development, Recruiting, and Creative Strategy to pressure-test event opportunities and advise on feasibility, format, and creative approach before concept work begins.

Event Concepting & Creative Development

• Develop creative concepts for events and experiential programs, translating strategic intent into spatial and experiential form, from initial idea through final creative direction.

• Define the narrative, user journey, key moments, visual language, spatial expression, and emotional arc of each experience.

• Develop and present concepts, references, sketches, experience frameworks, and recommendations to internal partners and senior leadership.

• Lead creative development across graphic and spatial design, content, motion, interactive elements, demonstrations, branded objects, and environmental details as appropriate.

• Ensure each concept is distinctive to True Anomaly, appropriate to its audience, and grounded in the company's brand strategy and mission.

Design Development, Spaces, and Systems

• Direct internal teams, agencies, fabricators, and production partners through design development; create and review layouts, renderings, drawings, prototypes, materials, graphics, content, and environmental elements.

• Partner with the Events & Styling Lead on furniture, finishes, materials, rentals, styling, and final environmental details.

• Develop repeatable kits of parts, modular experience systems, and event-specific standards that allow the company to move quickly without making every experience feel identical.

• Shape demo rooms and partner with Facilities on spaces that must support hosted events, media moments, recordings, demonstrations, talent programs, and other marketing objectives.

• Review work with leadership at key milestones and maintain the creative through-line from concept through fabrication, installation, and live experience.

Production Partnership

• Build and maintain a trusted network of agencies, designers, fabricators, craftspeople, rental partners, and special vendors that balance creative ambition, executional quality and responsible investment for each project.

• Partner with the Event Producer(s) and/or external production lead from the earliest concept stage so ideas can be delivered on time, within budget, and in keeping with the design intent.

• Design within established budget and schedule parameters. Advise on budget implications of creative decisions, flag scope-versus-budget mismatches early, and recommend creative tradeoffs when budget or schedule constraints require adjustment.

• Provide timely creative decisions, drawing and prototype reviews, approvals, references, content, and specifications needed for production to advance.

• Participate in site visits, production reviews, and key vendor conversations; be on site for priority installations and events to direct creative quality and resolve design questions.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree and 8-11 years of experience developing creative concepts and directing brand events, experiential activations, conferences, demonstrations, executive gatherings, or other live experiences; or Master's degree and 6 years of relevant experience.

• Portfolio demonstrating strong experiential concepting, creative direction, narrative thinking, and final executed work.

• Demonstrated ability to translate business, audience, and brand strategy into distinctive physical experiences.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams and directing agencies, designers, fabricators, content partners, and production specialists.

• Strong understanding of spatial experience, user journey, graphics, materials, objects, content, technology, and live moments.

• Comfort working hands-on across concepting, design development, vendor creative direction, and on-site execution. This is a player-coach role: you'll both direct external partners and execute design work yourself as the project demands.

• Deep knowledge of event production, fabrication, AV, logistics, installation, and venue constraints sufficient to make responsible creative decisions.

• Ability to develop creative work within defined budgets and schedules and to make sound tradeoffs without losing the central idea.

• Excellent presentation, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills, with calm judgment when conditions change.

• Willingness to travel and work outside conventional hours when required by an installation or live

• Experience in technology, aerospace, defense, automotive, industrial design, or another technically complex category is helpful but not required.

• Genuine interest in aerospace, defense, or national security is a meaningful signal. Domain expertise is not required; intellectual seriousness about the mission is.

COMPENSATION

• Base Salary: $130,000 - $235,000

• Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Long Beach, CA. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Hybrid

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us.

jobs.title: Learning Designer
jobs.description:
This role will be based in San Francisco, New York, Omaha, Sunnyvale or Chicago.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

The GTM Enablement team is seeking a Learning Designer with an AI-forward mindset who sees enablement as more than traditional training and course development.

This role is for someone who sees enablement as a driver of performance, not just training. You use AI, experimentation, and rapid prototyping to create engaging learning experiences grounded in adult learning principles and built for real-world application.

You’ll help modernize enablement through AI-assisted workflows, microlearning, gamification, simulations, and just-in-time support. You quickly turn ideas into scalable solutions and partner across teams to expand what works throughout the broader GTME organization.

We’re looking for a curious, self-directed innovator with a builder’s mindset. You thrive on solving complex problems, iterating quickly, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver learning experiences that are instructionally sound and technologically forward-thinking.

Responsibilities

• Champion accessibility and inclusive design standards across learning experiences, ensuring content is usable, scalable, and effective for diverse audiences

• Design and deliver AI-powered learning experiences including microlearning, simulations, games, and performance support resources grounded in adult learning principles

• Rapidly prototype and iterate on new learning approaches, then scale successful solutions across GTME

• Translate business goals and learner needs into practical enablement solutions with measurable impact

• Embed learning into the flow of work through just-in-time support, guidance, and performance aids

• Use AI tools and platforms such as Articulate 360, Copilot, Gemini, and others to accelerate content creation and personalization

• Curate and reuse existing content strategically, identifying when to build new assets versus leverage what already exists

• Measure learning effectiveness and use data and feedback to continuously improve experiences and outcomes

• Partner cross-functionally with stakeholders to align on priorities and co-create impactful learning solutions

• Ensure learning content is accessible, easy to navigate, and designed for reuse across audiences and programs

• Continuously explore emerging AI tools, technologies, and workflows to improve speed, quality, engagement, and business impact

Basic Qualifications:

• Minimum of 2+ years of experience in enablement, learning design, instructional design, game design, interactive experience design, or related fields in a fast-paced environment

• Hands-on experience using AI platforms, content creation tools, authoring tools, or interactive technologies such as Articulate 360, Copilot, Gemini, or similar tools to create engaging digital experiences

• Experience creating and editing multimedia content, including video, audio, graphics, interactive assets, or digital learning materials

Preferred Qualifications:

• BA degree or equivalent practical experience

• Ability to independently lead complex learning, enablement, or interactive experience projects from concept through delivery

• Experience designing games, interactive experiences, simulations, or engagement-driven digital content

• Demonstrated curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset with a passion for experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders

• Experience working in fast-paced, evolving environments with the ability to manage ambiguity and shift priorities effectively

• Familiarity with AI-powered workflows, emerging technologies, and modern content creation approaches

• Passion for creating accessible, engaging, and user-centered experiences that drive real-world application and performance

• Enablement
• Digestable Learning
• Forward Thinking

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.

jobs.title: Youth Employment Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Youth Employment Specialist works to increase the income of young people enrolled in Youth Pathways South LA while they are in the program. The position connects participants to part-time work, early employment, internships and apprenticeships, helps them apply, prepare and get hired, and stays with them through the first months on the job so that the placement holds. The Youth Employment Specialist works with the Career Coach on the career pathways identified for each youth and works closely with the case managers and the Youth Pathways Lead to remove the barriers that stand between a young person and a paycheck.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Key Areas of Responsibility:

• Increase participant income during program participation through part-time and early employment, paid work experience, internships, apprenticeships, benefits enrollment and other sources of income.
• Bridge the gap between youth readiness and the job market, supporting participants through the application, placement and retention process.
• Work with the Career Coach to move each participant along the career pathway identified for them, and with the case managers and Youth Pathways Lead to remove barriers to employment.

Essential Duties:

• Work with each participant to build a simple, current picture of their income, including wages, benefits, stipends and other supports, and set an income goal that is reviewed and updated throughout the program.
• Arrange and coordinate transportation to interviews, orientations, first shifts and work-related appointments, including bus passes, ride share and staff transport where appropriate.
• Participate in case conferencing with the Youth Pathways Lead, case managers, Career Coach and instructor to review participant progress and coordinate employment goals with the rest of the service plan.
• Maintain timely and accurate records of employment activity, placements, wages, hours and retention in Salesforce, and provide the Program Manager with regular reporting against grant employment targets.

• Ability to speak fluent Spanish and English language is preferred.

Experience:

• 2+ years of experience in employment services, job placement, workforce development, staffing or a closely related field, preferably serving youth or young adults.

jobs.title: Integration & Test Engineer (Falcon & Dragon)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

INTEGRATION & TEST ENGINEER (FALCON & DRAGON)

As an Integration & Test Engineer at SpaceX, you will have the opportunity to utilize your knowledge, experience, and creativity to develop novel solutions at the cutting edge of space technology. You will work on launch vehicles and spacecraft that deliver satellites into Earth's orbit, ferry humans to and from the International Space Station, and ultimately extend humanity’s reach beyond the Earth and moon. You will be a vital part of the relationship between our development and production teams. You will provide input into the design and development of new and existing hardware and take a lead role in manufacturing and integration on our current and next-generation vehicles.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Responsible for the build and inspection process for the structural assembly, propulsion assembly, and integration of the Falcon & Dragon vehicles

• Develop, qualify, and refine manufacturing processes to meet all design and business requirements, including safety, quality, efficiency, and delivery

• Collaborate with other engineers, subject matter experts, and technicians to solve large-scale production challenges

• Work with design engineers to evaluate designs for manufacturability and implementation in a rapidly evolving production environment

• Resolve product non-conformances and collaborate with the quality team to implement root cause corrective actions

• Identify, plan, and execute capital equipment, machine, and layout upgrades to meet volume production demand

• Develop and refine floor layouts, capacity models, and product flow analysis to ensure on-time vehicle delivery to manifest

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical, manufacturing, aerospace, materials or industrial engineering

• 1+ years of engineering experience in manufacturing or production (internship and school projects experience qualifies)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Master’s degree in mechanical, manufacturing, aerospace, materials or industrial engineering

• Involvement in a professional engineering society or collegiate design project

• Experience with the build, assembly, or integration of large mechanical assemblies

• Knowledge of metallic manufacturing techniques, processes, and equipment related to welding, metal forming, fastening, drilling, bonding and automation

• Mechanical component and/or tooling design and analysis experience using 3D CAD software

• Experience with design for manufacture and assembly (DFMA)

• Experience transition complex products from R&D to high-volume manufacturing in a fast-paced environment

• Experience writing work instructions and procedures for critical aerospace parts

• Experience in a production environment within the aerospace industry

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay range:
Level I: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00/per year
Level II: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

We're building the internet for space. Help us secure it.

Northwood is deploying a global network of phased array ground stations that will fundamentally change how satellites communicate with Earth. We're talking about real-time, high-throughput space communications infrastructure that government and commercial customers depend on for mission-critical operations. We need a Senior Security Engineer to design robust security frameworks that enable rapid scaling while meeting the most demanding compliance requirements in the industry.



Responsibilities:

 - Build security from the ground up - You're not inheriting someone else's technical debt. Design security architectures for brand-new ground station infrastructure and space communication protocols that don't exist anywhere else.

 - Secure the impossible - Our phased array antennas track hundreds of satellites simultaneously across multiple orbits. Design and implement security controls for distributed systems that span continents and operate where a single failure could impact national security missions.

 - Own the whole stack - From RF protocols to Kubernetes clusters. Deploy enterprise SIEM solutions that can handle terabytes of satellite communications data while maintaining detailed audit trails for the most stringent compliance requirements.

 - Pioneer security for space communications - When you're building infrastructure that doesn't exist anywhere else, the security playbooks don't exist yet. You'll be writing them while serving as primary security liaison for Space Force and other government customers.

 - Lead incident response and threat hunting across a globally distributed ground station network, coordinating with engineering, network operations, and compliance teams to maintain security posture that enables mission success.

 - Create automated compliance pipelines that don't slow down deployment cycles - Build comprehensive security documentation and reporting standards that satisfy FedRAMP and NIST 800-171 requirements without breaking engineering velocity.

 

Basic Qualifications

 - 5+ years of production experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK) - You automate everything and treat security configurations like the critical code they are

 - Ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI clearance

 - Experience conducting security architecture reviews in regulated environments where "good enough" isn't good enough

 - Strong knowledge of NIST 800-171, CUI, and FedRAMP frameworks - You understand the requirements but more importantly, you know how to implement them in modern cloud architectures

 - Familiarity with government cloud environments (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government) and CI/CD deployment pipelines that need to work across air-gapped networks

 - Proficiency in one or more general-purpose languages (Python, Go, Rust, etc.) - You're not just configuring tools; you're building custom security solutions

 - Experience implementing defensive controls for endpoints, SaaS apps, and infrastructure that operates in environments where traditional security assumptions don't apply



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience building large-scale log ingestion and storage pipelines that can handle massive data volumes from distributed ground stations

 - Hands-on experience with SIEM (Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel, Panther) and endpoint security solutions (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) in production environments

 - Strong Linux experience in production environments - Our ground stations run custom distributions

 - Knowledge of DFARS compliance and government contracting security requirements - You've worked where "move fast and break things" meets "don't break national security"

 - Familiarity with EMASS or similar government assessment tools

 - Demonstrated ability to own complex security projects that directly impact national security missions and interface with government customers who trust you with their most sensitive operations



Additional Requirements:

 - This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, Northwood Space reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with optional needs.





Additional Information:

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.title: Product Security Manager
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role

As Product Security Lead, you will own the security of Northwood's software and systems from design through deployment. This is a senior technical leadership role for an engineer with deep expertise across the full product security lifecycle — from threat modeling and secure architecture review to penetration testing, vulnerability management, and the cryptographic foundations that protect mission-critical space communications.

You will embed security into every stage of our software development lifecycle, build and mature our application security program, and ensure that the products Northwood delivers to government and commercial customers meet the most demanding security requirements in the industry. This role partners closely with product and infrastructure engineering teams and reports to the Head of Security.



Responsibilities

Application Security & SDLC

 - Own application security across the full software development lifecycle, ensuring security requirements are defined, validated, and enforced from design through production release.

 - Conduct security architecture reviews and threat modeling for new product features, platform changes, and third-party integrations.

 - Establish and maintain secure coding standards, security review gates, and developer security training programs.

 - Serve as the primary security liaison for product engineering teams, translating compliance and security requirements into actionable engineering guidance.

SAST, DAST & Vulnerability Management

 - Deploy, manage, and continuously improve static application security testing (SAST) and dynamic application security testing (DAST) tooling integrated into development workflows.

 - Own the vulnerability management program end-to-end: discovery, triage, prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting across product and infrastructure systems.

 - Conduct and coordinate penetration testing against Northwood's products and infrastructure, including scoping, execution, findings management, and remediation validation.

 - Build and maintain container security scanning, dependency analysis, and software composition analysis (SCA) pipelines.

CI/CD Security & Secrets Management

 - Integrate automated security validation and policy enforcement into CI/CD pipelines, ensuring security controls do not impede engineering velocity.

 - Own secrets management infrastructure, including deployment, policy configuration, access controls, and audit logging for platforms such as HashiCorp Vault.

 - Implement and enforce controls for secure artifact management, signing, and supply chain integrity across build and deployment pipelines.

 - Review and harden Infrastructure as Code, GitOps workflows, and deployment automation for security misconfigurations and policy violations.

Cryptography & Secure Communications

 - Design and implement cryptographic controls for data at rest, data in transit, and satellite communication protocols, ensuring alignment with NIST standards and government customer requirements.

 - Evaluate and advise on cryptographic library selection, key management architecture, and certificate lifecycle management.

 - Identify and remediate cryptographic weaknesses across product systems, including legacy protocol usage, weak cipher configurations, and improper key handling.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Hire and develop product security engineers as the team scales.

 - Collaborate with network operations, mission management, and compliance teams to maintain a security posture that enables mission success without breaking deployment cycles.

 - Build security documentation, audit evidence, and reporting standards that satisfy FedRAMP, CMMC, and NIST 800-171 requirements.



Basic Qualifications

 - 5+ years in product security, application security, or a closely related security engineering discipline, with demonstrated technical leadership experience.

 - Deep expertise in SAST and DAST tooling, including tool selection, integration into CI/CD pipelines, and results-driven vulnerability remediation programs.

 - Hands-on experience conducting or coordinating penetration testing engagements, including scoping, execution, and remediation validation.

 - Strong applied cryptography knowledge, including symmetric and asymmetric encryption, PKI, key management, and secure protocol design.

 - Experience owning vulnerability management programs, including prioritization frameworks, SLA enforcement, and executive reporting.

 - Proficiency with secrets management platforms such as HashiCorp Vault, including policy design and access control architecture.

 - Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows, including IaC security review and automated security gate implementation.

 - Proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages (Python, Go, Rust, or equivalent).

 - Familiarity with government compliance frameworks including NIST 800-171, CMMC, and FedRAMP.

 - Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance.

 - U.S. citizenship or status as a lawful permanent resident required to conform with ITAR export regulations.



Preferred Qualifications

 - Active TS clearance or higher.

 - Experience with HashiCorp Vault, Terraform, and ArgoCD in production environments.

 - Hands-on experience with container security scanning, admission controllers, and microservices security patterns.

 - Familiarity with software supply chain security frameworks and tooling (SLSA, Sigstore, SBOM generation).

 - Background in aerospace, defense, critical infrastructure, or other regulated industries.

 - Experience with DFARS compliance, ITAR, and government contracting security requirements.

 - Familiarity with eMASS or similar government assessment and authorization tools.

 - CISSP, CSSLP, OSCP, or equivalent professional certification.



Additional Requirements

While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, Northwood Space reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with optional needs.

jobs.description:
We Build Better Communities

Be Part of the Hawthorne Difference!

Hawthorne Cat is a family-owned company that has led its markets for over 60 years in the sale, rental, and servicing of construction machinery and power generation equipment for industries on which our communities depend like agriculture, construction, marine, and government.

Every member of our team plays a significant role in our success.  Hawthorne Cat hires individuals who share our vision of Building Better Communities with our Customers and our values of Passion, Respect, Integrity, Dedication and Excellence (PRIDE).

If you are looking to build your future with an established, thriving company with countless opportunities for growth and advancement, you’ve come to the right place!  At Hawthorne Cat, we’re always looking for exceptionally skilled, hardworking individuals interested in contributing to our success and the success of the communities that we serve.

Our people are our most valuable asset. That’s why at Hawthorne Cat we are committed to a comprehensive employee benefit program that helps our employees stay healthy, feel secure, and maintain a work/life balance.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title:             Master Technician

Reports to:         Service Manager

FLSA Status:       Non-exempt

Division:              HPC

Department:      Service

Union:                  OE

Locations:           Waipahu

POSITION SUMMARY: Without supervision, the Master Technician performs duties as assigned by the Service Manager in the repair, maintenance, and rebuilding of equipment in the service shop or field, in a safe, efficient, and capable manner in the least amount of labor hours possible and without rework.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• The Master Technician is required to complete work within 95% or less of a flat rate time that is established as a target.

• As well as performing mechanical repairs as directed, the Master Technician assists in training personnel and travels to all parts of the HPC territory to assist less skilled technicians in solving problem jobs.

• Must be proficient in the use of test and diagnostic tools and makes adjustments to machines and components. Is capable of troubleshooting mechanical problems in CAT and Allied products.

• Makes warranty recommendations and prepares reports when performing warranty service jobs, resulting in 100% of warranty claims being accepted by the manufacturers.

• Accomplishes work according to preventative maintenance quality standards and within the time allotted.

• Attends all required training classes as directed and obtains passing grades in all.

• Reconditions or overhauls major components to manufacturers specifications and is capable of assembling, adjusting, testing, and ensuring equipment performs to specifications.

• Performs the minimum number of tests necessary to identify the cause of the problem and recommends action to correct the failure or problem.

• Maintains a favorable business relationship with customers, suppliers, and personnel from other HPC departments.

• Understands fluid sampling, including hydraulic, oil, cooling, and fuel systems.

• Uses all diagnostic tools and correctly diagnoses electrical systems, engine components, hydraulic systems, and powertrain systems within 30 minutes.

• Reports all unsafe and equipment deficiencies (other than those in the job assignment) to the supervisor immediately.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

• Must have a high school diploma or equivalent.

• Must have a valid Drivers License with a good driving record.

• Must have PC skills.

• Must have the ability to communicate clearly, both orally and in writing.

• Must be forklift certified or able to be certified within 60 days.

• Must own hand tools that are suitable to perform the work noted above.

• Must have 10 years experience in the repair and maintenance of CAT equipment and has all the experience as outlined in HPC training classes.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Walking: Moves about on foot, often through uneven terrain.

• Hands/arms: Operates equipment and hand and power tools.

• Handling: Seizes, helps, or works with hands.

• Lifting: Raises or lowers miscellaneous equipment parts and tools.

• Reaching: Extends hands and arms in any direction.

• Stooping: Bends body downward and forward by bending at knees or waist.

• Standing: Remains in standing position if required to perform various functions of the job.

• Climbing: In and out of equipment.

• Raising/Lowering: Goes up and down in man lifts.

• Vision: Reads work tickets and parts and service books and operates heavy equipment.

• Talking: Communicates by radio, phone, and in person.

• Hearing: Hears well enough to discern mechanical problems for safety in and around shop and construction sites and to receive communication by radio, phone, and in person.

• Sitting: Sits in equipment and vehicles for extended periods.

• Laying: Lies in prone position under vehicles and equipment for extended periods.

• Lifting: Lifts up to 60lbs. daily, frequent exertion.

ENVIRONMENTAL:

• Noise: Works in conditions with constant or intermittent noise.

• Temp/Weather: Works outside and in shop with variations of temperature and weather.

• Exposure: Subject to foul odors, fumes, and harsh substances.

jobs.title: Substance Use/Behavioral Health Counselor
jobs.description:
The Substance Use Counselor serves as a member of a multi-disciplinary substance use patient care team.  The Counselor provides direct patient and therapeutic counseling services with a focus on substance use and general mental health to individuals, families, and groups. Work performance is reviewed for conformance to policies, procedures, and practices related to substance use and behavioral health service delivery. The Substance Use Counselor will represent the company professionally and positively to enhance and promote the core values and the mission of NATIVE HEALTH, always exercising the utmost discretion, diplomacy, and tact in customer interactions. The SUD Counselor reports directly to the Recovery Service Coordinator for clinical oversight and supervision.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

• Assesses and provides appropriate therapeutic substance use counseling services for individuals, families, and/or groups presenting with problems related to general mental health and/or substance abuse, that are within the scope of the Counselor’s license, education, and skills.
• Provides Substance use and behavioral health related prevention/education services to the community in a cost effective and efficient manner.
• Provides accurate and timely documentation, billing, and program audit support.
• Actively participates in case staffing meetings and peer review sessions.
• Collaborate with the care team and other internal and external health care providers for shared patients to facilitate patient care and follow-up, while promoting the healthcare home mission in all aspects of service delivery.
• Supports the organization as needed

QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE/REQUIREMENTS:

• An Active and unrestricted AZBBHE licensure as a Licensed Master of Social Work (LMSW), Licensed Associate Counselor (LAC), Licensed Associate Marriage and Family Therapist (LAMFT), Licensed Associate Addiction Counselor (LAAC) is required.
• An Active and unrestricted AZBBHE licensure as a Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Professional Counselor (LPC), or Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), or Licensed Independent Addiction Counselor (LIAC) preferred.
• Three years of specialized experience in substance abuse with diverse populations is strongly preferred. Experience working with underserved populations is also highly preferred.
• Bilingual in Spanish is preferred. Fluency evaluation is required.

Standard Employment Requirements

• Must possess a valid and unrestricted Arizona driver’s license (within 30 days of hire if applicant is from out-of-state) with no DUI/DWI or reckless driving convictions in the last five years. No more than two at-fault accidents in the last three years. Must maintain a valid Arizona driver’s license during employment. Must be insurable under NATIVE HEALTH’s liability auto policy.
• Must pass a criminal background check and obtain a Class I Fingerprint Clearance Card within the initial ninety (90) calendar days of employment and retain a valid card while employed with NATIVE HEALTH.
• Must pass substance abuse testing upon employment and submit to random testing during employment.
• Must provide an updated immunization (IZ) record at the time of employment.
• Must have a current (within 12 months) Tuberculosis (TB) skin report upon employment and provide an annual update.
• Must obtain BLS certification within (90) calendar days of employment and maintain certification during employment.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The following factors are essential to this position, and to minimally qualify, applicants must provide evidence in their resumes that they possess these required factors:

• Knowledge of principles, techniques and trends in counseling, psychotherapy, clinical case management, and various treatment modalities.
• Knowledge of principles and techniques of mental health and substance use education, prevention, and crisis intervention.
• Ability to deliver strong clinical services to individuals, families, and/or groups.
• Model professionalism, integrity, and ethical principles at all times.
• Ability to accomplish the quality and quantity of work expected within set limits of cost and time.
• Ability to plan own work and carry out assignments effectively and completely.
• Must have strong listening, written, and oral communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with patients, providers, and staff.
• Ability to establish rapport and gain the confidence of others (providers, case managers, primary care team, patients and associates).
• Must be able to work with confidential material without betraying the trust of patients, families, or the agency- in accordance with HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 regulations, as well as agency policies.
• Ability to assess quality of patient care and make improvements, as needed.
• Knowledge and competence in supporting the cultural, social, and economic backgrounds of a diverse service population with traditionally underserved needs.
• Knowledge of mental health and substance use issues of the diverse populations served.
• Knowledge of existing social and behavioral health resources available for patient care.
• Knowledge of and skills to provide brief intervention counseling focused on adults and/or children with general mental health and/or substance abuse challenges.
• Remains current and timely completes all assigned Relias trainings and other training related to the health promotion and disease prevention of the persons served in the program.
• Proficient with computer-based applications such as MS Office, Adobe, and electronic health record.

Native Health complies with all state and federal requirements, including EEOC requirements.

jobs.title: Associate Solutions Consultant

The role / impact

As an Associate Solutions Consultant, you will play a vital role in supporting Xero's Partner Sales channel to help accounting and bookkeeping practices build stronger businesses and embrace digital strategy. You will work closely with firms to guide them through client onboarding, data migration, and software implementation, ensuring they get the most out of the Xero ecosystem.

By delivering tailored group webinars and one-on-one training sessions, you will empower accountants and bookkeepers to streamline their workflows and activate their subscriptions. Your efforts directly contribute to enabling small businesses to thrive through accessible, modern technology.

The team / how they connect

You will collaborate directly with the post-sales partner consulting team, the Global Migration Team, and local account managers to deliver smooth implementation plans for practice partners. The team works closely together to manage partner relationships, share knowledge, and support firms through every stage of their digital transition. You will also connect with external conversion partners and firm leaders to ensure seamless data migrations and ongoing practice success.

Initially, you will focus on

 - Guiding partners through data conversions and file preparation using specialised migration tools such as GMT, Jet Convert, and Advance Track.

 - Delivering interactive 1:1 and 1:many training sessions and webinars covering Xero, Xero Payroll, Melio, Syft, and Hubdoc.

 - Managing external stakeholder expectations and scheduling virtual and on-site onboarding sessions.

 - Maintaining accurate practice contact details and communication logs within Salesforce CRM while creating self-serve guidance resources for partner queries.

Where and how you can work

This role involves flexible working options alongside a field presence to support partner practices directly. You can expect to travel to up to two cities per week for on-site partner visits (accounting for 50–75% of your time), with virtual connection options available where appropriate when working remotely or from a local office hub.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - You bring a solid understanding of accounting fundamentals, practice workflows, financial reporting, and compliance requirements.

 - You possess clear communication and presentation abilities, with a natural talent for conducting engaging software demonstrations and training.

 - You have experience with cloud accounting platforms and a genuine enthusiasm for the SaaS software space.

 - You bring strong initiative, excellent attention to detail, and the confidence to operate independently when managing client files.

 - You have a proven capability to build rapid, meaningful rapport with internal teammates and external practice partners.

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We don’t just hire for a role; we invest in people. We believe in a Total Package philosophy - which means your value isn't just a single number on a paycheck. While base salary is a core component, we look at your compensation through a holistic lens that includes equity, performance incentives, and world-class benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role in is $79,000 to $89,000 USD 

Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role.

In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation:

 - Variable Pay: Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and 21 days PTO, 10 days of Wellbeing leave, 5 days of Xtra Leave, 1 volunteer day, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave. Further information included on our Xero Perks https://careers.xero.com/inside-xero/benefits-wellbeing/ page.

Xero uses AI to help screen applications based on job-related qualifications. These tools assist our recruiters but do not make automated hiring decisions. A human recruiter reviews all candidates before any hiring action is taken.

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
About Ruggable:

Ruggable is a leading direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand based in Los Angeles, California with an extraordinary track record of high, profitable growth. We pride ourselves on having an extremely loyal customer base and a talented team made up of genuinely caring people who take action and deliver results. We are venture-backed and own a patented washable rug design that's disrupting the home décor industry. Our mission is to empower our customers to live vibrantly with beautiful products that don't compromise on function. If you're passionate about consumer products, e-commerce, and high-growth start-ups, keep reading!

Job Summary: As the Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager, you will lead the development and execution of Ruggable’s global sourcing strategy for inline product. You will strengthen and diversify the supplier base, identify and onboard new suppliers and manufacturing capabilities, and build strategic partnerships that support the company’s growth, margin, quality, innovation, and supply-chain objectives.  You will own vendor management and relations, establishing performance expectations, driving continuous improvement, and addressing issues that may affect cost, quality, capacity, lead time, service, or delivery. As a strategic partner within Operations, you will collaborate with Product Development, R&D, Merchandising, Creative, Quality, Planning, and other teams to value engineer products, identify alternative materials and manufacturing solutions, and support successful commercialization. You will also lead counter- and dual-sourcing initiatives, evaluate new markets and capabilities, monitor global sourcing conditions, and develop solutions that improve competitiveness and reduce supply-chain risk.

What You’ll Do:
● Own strategic vendor relationships across Ruggable’s global supplier base for inline product, serving as a key point of contact and fostering partnerships grounded in transparency, accountability, performance, and mutual growth
● Develop and execute global sourcing, supplier diversification, and risk-mitigation strategies aligned with company, product, margin, and supply-chain objectives
● Set vendor expectations and manage performance across cost, quality, innovation, capacity, lead time, delivery, responsiveness, and service, using business reviews and corrective action plans to drive improvement
● Identify, evaluate, qualify, negotiate with, and onboard suppliers, factories, mills, and manufacturing regions that expand capabilities, improve competitiveness, and address capacity or assortment needs
● Lead counter-sourcing and dual-sourcing strategies for key and best-selling categories to improve cost, flexibility, continuity, and resilience
● Determine optimal factory and country placement based on product requirements, supplier capabilities, manufacturing technology, quality, capacity, cost, tariffs, lead times, logistics, and delivery needs
● Develop sourcing strategies for fabrics, yarns, raw materials, and components that balance quality, innovation, cost, speed, and supply security
● Identify opportunities to nominate or consolidate raw material suppliers when doing so creates strategic, quality, or cost advantages
● Partner with Product Development and R&D to commercialize innovative products, evaluate alternative materials and processes, and value engineer products to achieve target costs and margins without compromising performance or quality
● Lead negotiations covering costing, payment terms, MOQs, capacity, lead times, tooling, raw materials, and other commercial terms
● Analyze costs, prices, margins, commodities, and market conditions to identify savings opportunities, margin risks, and negotiation leverage
● Monitor tariffs, duties, geopolitical developments, raw material trends, manufacturing capacity, logistics, and regional supply-chain conditions, recommending sourcing actions as needed
● Partner cross-functionally to execute sourcing strategies and onboard new suppliers, regions, materials, and manufacturing capabilities
● Develop tools, reporting, and operating practices that improve vendor visibility, accountability, speed, and reliability
● Identify and address production, costing, capacity, quality, compliance, and delivery risks, coordinating corrective actions with vendors and internal stakeholders
● Support time-to-market initiatives by streamlining sourcing, development, commercialization, and vendor processes
● Conduct supplier business reviews and factory visits to assess capabilities, performance, capacity, opportunities, and strategic fit
● Lead and mentor direct reports and/or overseas sourcing teams, setting priorities and supporting professional development
● Manage in-region contractors (India, China sourcing associates)
● Support special projects and strategic sourcing initiatives as assigned

What You’ll Need to Have:
Required:
● Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Textiles, or a related field. Equivalent relevant industry experience may be considered
● 7+ years of progressive global sourcing experience, including responsibility for an internationally distributed supplier and manufacturing base
● Demonstrated success managing strategic vendor relationships, including negotiations, performance management, corrective actions, and supplier development
● Deep knowledge of international factories, mills, manufacturing capabilities, raw materials, logistics, tariffs, duties, and global supply chains
● Experience in textiles, home décor, rugs, floor coverings, or related soft-goods manufacturing and sourcing
● Strong understanding of product development and commercialization, including T&A calendars, critical path management, costing, production planning, capacity, and delivery execution
● Proven ability to develop sourcing strategies that improve cost, margin, quality, speed, capacity, and supply-chain resilience
● Strong commercial acumen, including cost analysis, value engineering, supplier negotiations, and margin management
● Excellent negotiation, analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and communication skills
● Ability to identify risks, develop practical solutions, and influence internal and external stakeholders
● Experience managing multiple complex suppliers, projects, and priorities with strong attention to detail
● Experience managing and developing direct reports, overseas teams, and/or cross-functional teams
● Proficiency in Microsoft applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
● Ability to work evenings as needed with international suppliers and teams
● Ability and willingness to travel internationally for supplier meetings, factory visits, market research, trade shows, and sourcing initiatives

Preferred:
● Established relationships within a qualified global supplier and manufacturing network
● Airtable proficiency
● Knowledge of regulatory and social compliance, product testing, and quality assurance standards
● Highly analytical and data-driven approach to sourcing strategy and decision-making
● Strong understanding of the home textiles industry, particularly rugs and floor covering

Compensation:
● $120,000-135,000 per year base salary based on experience
● An annual bonus percentage that varies based on level of role
● Employer matching (up to 3% of base salary) for company sponsored 401K plan

At Ruggable, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Ruggable is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Auto Painter - Haines City, FL
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Auto Painters with a minimum of 1 year of professional automotive painting experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As a Painter, you’ll be expected to prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of paint roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see other roles available to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Paint Prepper (min 6 months professional experience): prepare vehicles for cosmetic paintwork, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing

• Entry-Level Painter (min 1 year professional experience): prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

• Mid-Level Painter (min 3 years professional experience): match/mix paint color and use water-based paint to paint the vehicle inside our paint booths

• Experienced Painter (min 5 years professional experience): painting (base coats, tri-coats, solid, metallic, and clear coats), blending adjacent panels, and paint correcting vehicles.

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: (743) Event Coordinator/Virtual Event Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Summary

Arlo Solutions (Arlo) is an information technology consulting services company that specializes in delivering technology solutions. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future.

Position Description:

We are seeking an experienced Event Coordinator / Virtual Event Specialist to support the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Office of Acquisitions in planning and running large-scale virtual, hybrid, and in-person events. The primary focus is HHS's inaugural two-day Industry Day/Summit in the Washington, DC metro area, with about 500 on-site attendees and 1,200 virtual attendees. The role may also support other OA events, such as the Acquisition Workforce Training Conference, leadership forums, and town halls. This role owns the virtual and hybrid parts of the attendee experience. That includes platform setup and registration, live streaming, virtual engagement, day-of technical troubleshooting, and post-event data. The ideal candidate has personally run large virtual audiences and stays calm when technology fails in real time.

Location:  This position requires candidates who live within commuting distance of Washington, DC. Relocation and local travel expenses will not be reimbursed.

Key Responsibilities:

Virtual and Hybrid Event Platform Management

• Configure, administer, and maintain the online event management platform (Stova preferred) for virtual, hybrid, and in-person attendees, including the branded event site, mobile app (iOS/Android), and email campaigns.

• Build and manage registration for all participant types (attendees, speakers, staff, volunteers), and track registration, session interest, and attendance accurately.

• Manage the speaker and session submission, review, and approval workflow within the platform.

• Set up and run live streaming of plenary and breakout sessions for virtual attendees in real time.

• Configure two-way engagement tools, including polls, chat, and Q&A, and monitor them during sessions as directed.

• Coordinate in-room cameras, microphones, virtual meeting links, and dedicated bandwidth with AV and production vendors and Government IT.

• Make sure all plenary sessions are recorded, and the recordings are delivered to the Government.

• Set up and deploy post-event surveys and evaluations, and track engagement hours for continuous learning documentation. Pre-Event Planning and Readiness

• Contribute to the integrated event plan, run-of-show, and operations plan, especially the virtual and hybrid workstreams, milestones, dependencies, and risks.

• Take part in kickoff and planning meetings and maintain action-item and decision logs.

• Plan and lead technical rehearsals, dry runs, platform tests, and speaker tech checks before each virtual or hybrid event.

• Develop and maintain contingency procedures for platform or AV outages, speaker changes, registration problems, and schedule changes.

• Coordinate with Government event leads, facilities, security, AV/IT staff, speakers, and vendors on technical and logistical readiness.

• Make sure virtual event materials and communications are accessible and conform to Section 508. Day-of Event Execution

• Serve as the primary virtual and hybrid operations lead during live events. Manage platform operations, participant access, breakout sessions, screen sharing, presentation sequencing, and session timing.

• Troubleshoot technical issues for virtual attendees and speakers in real time.

• Support on-site coordination as needed, including registration and check-in, badge troubleshooting, speaker transitions, room readiness, and attendee flow.

• Act as liaison between HHS staff, speakers, the emcee, and the AV/production team so the in-room and virtual experiences stay in sync.

• Escalate decisions, changes, security concerns, and anything requiring Government direction to the designated Government point of contact (COR or event lead).

Responsibilities and/or Success Factors:

Post-Event Support (continued from above)

• Compile attendance, registration, engagement, and survey data from the platform to support post-event summaries and briefings.

• Contribute to lessons learned and after-action reports, focusing on virtual and hybrid performance and recommendations.

• Organize final event files, recordings, and records so they are editable by the Government and transferred to the Government-designated repository.

Required Qualifications:

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience planning and running virtual and hybrid events, including at least one event with 1,000 or more concurrent virtual attendees.

• Experience supporting federal agency events, especially HHS or other civilian agencies.

• Direct experience with Stova (formerly Aventri). Demonstrated hands-on administration of enterprise event platform, Stova, including registration setup, mobile apps, email campaigns, and attendee reporting.

• Proven experience running live streaming, virtual breakout sessions, and audience engagement tools such as polls, chat, and moderated Q&A.

• Advanced proficiency with virtual meeting platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Zoom/Zoom for Government, and Webex.

• Experience working with AV and production vendors on hybrid setups (cameras, microphones, encoders, streaming feeds).

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues calmly and quickly under live-event pressure.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work with senior executives, speakers, vendors, and attendees.

• Must live in the Washington, DC metro area and be able to work on-site in DC or nearby locations as events require.

• Must be legally eligible to work in the United States.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal background investigation.

• Must be available for occasional early-morning, evening, or extended hours around event dates.

Minimum Qualifications Including Certificates:

• Bachelor's degree and at least 5 years of event coordination or event management experience, or a high school diploma and at least 8 years of related experience.

Desired Qualifications:

• Certified Meeting Professional (CMP), Digital Event Strategist (DES), or similar certification.

• Working knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements for virtual events and digital materials, including captioning and accessible presentation formats.

• Experience with Industry Days, acquisition or procurement conferences, or Government-industry engagement events.

• Familiarity with tracking engagement or continuing education hours through event platforms.

AAP Statement
